scripts.text:
[Metz]
Hm...?
Can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
嗯...？
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I'm sorry I made you wait,
but I had some research to finish and it took longer than I expected. Now, before I tell you more about the job, I want to test your competency.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
抱歉讓你久等了，
我手頭有些研究沒做完，花的時間比預想的要長。
現在，在告訴你更多關於任務的事情之前，
我想先測試一下你的能力。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I don't know if you realize
it, but I'm offering a golden
opportunity for the adventurer
who works for me. So don't
hesitate to see Arian.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你可能沒意識到，
我正在為為我工作的冒險者
提供一個千載難逢的機會。
所以，不要猶豫，
去見阿里安吧。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Dearles...?
Ah yes, he's one
of my shadier friends.
He's difficult to find
and he's only truly kind
to a select few, so...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
迪爾萊斯...？
啊，是的，
他是我比較神秘的朋友之一。
他很難找到，
而且只對少數人真正友善，所以...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Congratulations~
You managed to pass
all of the tests! You seem
to be the perfect person
to carry out this special
assignment!
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
恭喜~
你通過了所有的測試！
你看起來是執行這項特殊任務的
完美人選！

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Ah, you've come
just in the nick of time!
I just found someone who
may be capable of restoring
the Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
啊，你來得正是時候！
我剛剛找到了一位
可能能夠修復星淚石的人。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Keep up the good work.
I'm sorry that I don't have
have much information for
you to follow, but someone
with your abilities should
be able to find a way.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
請繼續努力。
抱歉我沒有太多資訊
供你參考，
但以你的能力，
應該能找到辦法的。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Amazing...! You've
managed to restore
the Sobbing Starlight!
Now, I recently learned that
this stone can lead you to
an ancient place...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
太棒了...！
你成功修復了星淚石！
最近我得知，
這塊石頭可以指引你
前往一個古老的地方...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Now that the
Sobbing Starlight
is restored, we need
to find someone who can
break the seal on the
gem's message...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
既然星淚石
已經修復，
我們需要找到一個人
來解開寶石上的封印...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Great...!
You were able to get the
text in the gem printed on a
Record of Ancient Language?
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
太好了...！
你成功將寶石中的文字
印在了古代語言的文書上？

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Frank Franklin has lived
in seclusion and only a few
people are aware of his skill.
But I can assure you that his
knowledge of ancient languages
is unrivaled by any mortal.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
弗蘭克·富蘭克林
一直隱居，
只有少數人知道他的技藝。
但我可以向你保證，
他在古代語言方面的知識
無人能及。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
So far, I've learned
from my research that
the gem's message has
details about a certain
location and an item that
serves as some kind of key...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
目前，
根據我的研究，
寶石上的資訊
包含了一個特定地點的詳細資訊，
以及一件作為某種鑰匙的物品...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I get it now!
The 'skyscraper'
in this text refers to
the Geffen Tower!
Alright, let's see...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我明白了！
這段文字中的“摩天大樓”
指的是吉芬塔！
好的，讓我們看看...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Angrboda...?!
According to legend,
her soul was split into
pieces and placed behind
seals created by the gods!
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
安格爾伯達...？！
根據傳說，
她的靈魂被分裂成碎片，
並被放置在由眾神創造的封印之後！

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Fascinating...
This was made with
a material outside of
Midgard! See this
blue lens? That must be
its incredible power source!
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
真令人著迷...
這是用米德加爾特之外的材料製成的！
看這個藍色透鏡？
那一定是它強大的能量來源！

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Ah, you're finally
here. I've been waiting
to speak with you. First,
let me thank you again
for all of your help.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
啊，你終於來了。
我一直在等你，想和你談談。
首先，
再次感謝你的所有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
You failed?
It's disappointing,
but I know that you
did your best. Let
me thank you for
all your work.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你失敗了？
這令人失望，
但我知道你已經盡力了。
讓我感謝你的所有工作。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I'm sorry...
But I'm taking
back the Sobbing
Starlight from you.
Apparently, you weren't
worthy of the task...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
很抱歉...
但我必須收回你的星淚石。
顯然，你並不配勝任這項任務...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Thank you so much
for helping me make
my dream come true.
can work on another
project together.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
非常感謝你幫助我實現了夢想。
我們可以一起著手下一個專案了。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Although you need everlasting patience in an archaeological excavation, the feeling you get when you find something makes
all those long hours of study and research worth it.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
雖然考古發掘需要永恆的耐心，但當你發現寶物時的那種感覺，會讓所有漫長的研究和探索都變得值得。

scripts.text: [Metz]
scripts.translation: [梅茨]

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Hm...?
Shouldn't you leave
for Morocc to see Arian?
You better hurry in case
somebody else applies
for this little job.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
嗯...？
你不該去莫洛克見阿里安嗎？
最好快點，萬一有人搶先申請了這個小工作呢。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I'm impressed that
you managed to get
Arian's approval! Oh,
and how's Daewoon?
He's a character, isn't he?
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你能獲得阿里安的認可，真讓我印象深刻！
哦，對了，大雲怎麼樣？
他真是個有個性的人，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I'm not surprised
that Daewoon likes
you. Ah, but Jore is
always busy. Still, if you
know his schedule, you
should be alright.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
大雲喜歡你，這並不讓我驚訝。
啊，不過喬爾總是很忙。不過，如果你瞭解他的日程，應該就沒問題了。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Jesqurienne is
a brilliant woman.
Although I worry a
little bit about her
overconfidence, she's
a good friend of mine.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
傑斯庫莉恩是一位傑出的女性。
雖然我有點擔心她過於自信，但她是我的一位好朋友。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Ah, Bakerlan~
I've heard that he's
been quite busy lately.
But that's how all big
businessmen are, I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
啊，貝克蘭~
聽說他最近很忙。
不過我想，所有大商人都是這樣的吧。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Although I've made
some progress, I still
haven't found an artisan
capable of restoring the
Sobbing Starlight. Please
give me a little more time.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
雖然我已經取得了一些進展，但我仍然沒有找到能夠修復星淚石的工匠。
請再給我一點時間。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
The Wizard we're looking
for isn't in Geffen? Hm, at least we know he's near Comodo. Now,
while you investigate that lead, I'll continue to gather more
information on this gem...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我們要找的巫師不在吉芬？嗯，至少我們知道他在克魔島附近。
現在，當你調查這條線索時，我會繼續收集關於這顆寶石的更多資訊...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I'm sure the town
where the rejected
live means something,
but I'm unable to figure
out the answer to this
little riddle...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我想被拒絕者居住的城鎮一定有什麼含義，
但我無法解開這個小小的謎題...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I think you're
almost there. All
of our efforts will
soon come to fruition!
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我想你已經快成功了。
我們所有的努力很快就會結出碩果！

scripts.text:
[Metz]
This is it...!
You've brought me,
'The Sign!' I've finally
proven its existence!
Please let me handle
this and come back later~
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
就是這個...！
你帶給我了“標示”！
我終於證明了它的存在！
請讓我先處理一下，稍後再回來~

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I'm sorry, but I'm
still examining the
artifact you've lent to
me. Would you please
give me some more time?
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
很抱歉，我還在檢查你借給我的文物。
請再給我一點時間好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Have you visited
Engel Howard yet?
He's the only one
who can unlock the
Sign's power for you...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你去見過恩格爾·霍華德了嗎？
只有他能為你解鎖標示的力量...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Have you visited
Engel Howard yet?
He's the only one
who can unlock the
the Sign's power for you...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你去見過恩格爾·霍華德了嗎？
只有他能為你解鎖標示的力量...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I guess I can't
really blame you
since I didn't provide
you with that much help...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我想我確實不能怪你，
畢竟我沒有給你提供太多幫助...

scripts.text: I've been following these signs and...
scripts.translation: 我一直在追蹤這些標示...

scripts.text: I was just passing by...
scripts.translation: 我只是路過...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Great...!
Welcome to my
humble lodgings.
Hmm, let me see...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
太好了...！
歡迎來到我簡陋的住所。
嗯，讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Uh, it pains me to say this, but I don't think you qualified to help me out. Once you gain enough experience though, I'll be happy to have you on board~
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
雖然很遺憾，但我覺得你目前還不足以勝任這份工作。
不過，等你積累足夠的經驗後，我會很樂意讓你加入的~

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Hey, I think you might
be well suited for the job!
But do you think you could come back later? I've got my hands full with some other business.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
嘿，我覺得你很適合這份工作！
不過，你能稍後再來嗎？我現在正忙著處理其他事務。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Oh right, would you tell
me your name? {0}?
Okay then, I'll remember that.
Talk to you later, alright?
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
對了，能告訴我你的名字嗎？{0}？
好的，我會記住的。
那下次再聊，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Oh really?
I see, I thought you
were an applicant for
the position I'm offering
to brave adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
哦，是嗎？
原來如此，我還以為你是來應聘
我面向勇敢冒險者釋出的職位呢。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
The job I'm offering is
pretty risky and not just
anybody can handle it.
You'll actually go through
a series of tests conducted
by my trusted friends.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我提供的這份工作風險很大，
並非任何人都能勝任。
你需要通過我幾位可靠朋友
進行的一系列測試。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Now, the first person
you must visit is ^FF0000Arian^000000
in Morocc. Please speak
to him and he'll give you
all the details about his
examination... I hope.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
首先，你必須去見^FF0000阿里安^000000，
他在莫洛奇。請與他對話，
他會告訴你關於他那場考試的所有細節...我希望如此。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Once you're finished with
the test, Arian will tell you
what to do next. Afterwards,
come back to me so that we
can finally talk business.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
當你完成測試後，阿里安會告訴你
接下來該做什麼。之後，
請回到我這裡，這樣我們
終於可以談正事了。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Ah, almost forgot.
Arian won't talk to anybody
unless he knows them or
receives a message from me.
So if he's snubbed you in the past, just understand that's his way.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
啊，差點忘了。
除非阿里安認識對方，
或者收到我的訊息，否則他不會跟任何人說話。
所以如果以前他對你愛答不理，請理解那是他的作風。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
And just so you know,
it's not a good idea to
judge Arian by his looks.
He's more than meets
the eye, you know.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
順便告訴你，
不要以貌取人，尤其是阿里安。
他的實力遠超外表給人的印象，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
It certainly doesn't
help that he's hopelessly
addicted to gambling...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
而且，他無可救藥地沉迷於賭博...
這確實對他沒什麼幫助。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
By now, you must have
six Sobbing Starlight pieces.
I'm sure that you want to know
more about these fragments.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
到現在為止，你應該已經收集了六塊星淚石碎片。
我相信你一定想知道更多關於這些碎片的事情。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I remember last summer,
I found the wholly formed
Sobbing Starlight north
of Mount Mjolnir during
one of my expeditions...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我記得去年夏天，
在一次探險中，我在雷神之錘山以北
發現了一塊完整的星淚石...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Although it was in perfect
shape, once it was exposed
to the air, it began to crack
and shattered into the pieces
you now hold in your hand.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
雖然它當時完好無損，
但一旦暴露在空氣中，
它就開始出現裂紋，
最終碎裂成了你手中持有的這些碎片。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Now, an ordinary artisan
can't put the Sobbing Starlight
back together. This mysterious stone has some strange properties. But it's imperative for me to get this stone reassembled.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
現在，普通的工匠無法將星淚石重新拼合。
這塊神秘的石頭有著奇特的屬性。但我必須將這塊石頭重新組裝起來。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Once restored, a strange
pattern can be seen within
the Sobbing Starlight. I guess
that the pattern is a message
written in an ancient language.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
一旦復原，就能看到星淚石內部
有一種奇怪的圖案。我想，
那是一種用古代語言寫成的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Would you let me borrow
the pieces for a second?
I'll show you something
quite interesting...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
能把碎片借給我一下嗎？
我要給你看一樣非常有趣的東西...

scripts.text:
^3355FFOnce you hand the pieces
of the Sobbing Starlight to
Metz, he pulls out a seventh
piece. Once gathered, they
begin to emit a strange light.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF當你把星淚石的碎片交給梅茨後，
他拿出了一塊第七塊碎片。當它們聚集在一起時，
開始散發出奇異的光芒。^000000

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Since the pieces still
respond to each other,
I believe that it's possible
for the Sobbing Starlight
to be restored to its
original form.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
既然碎片之間仍然能相互感應，
我相信星淚石有可能
被恢復到它原本的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
We're still seeking
an artisan of great
skill for this task. Once
know right away. For now,
please hold on to these pieces.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我們仍在尋找一位技藝高超的工匠來完成這項任務。
一旦找到，我會立刻通知你。在此之前，
請保管好這些碎片。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
His name is
^FF0000Engel Howard^000000,
a legendary Blacksmith
in Midgard. I don't
know where he is, but maybe
his family in Geffen may know.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
他的名字是
^FF0000恩格爾·霍華德^000000，
米德加爾特的一位傳奇鐵匠。我不知道他在哪裡，
但也許他在吉芬的家人會知道。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Unfortunately, that's all
the information that I have
to give you for now. You'll
have to investigate this lead
on your own, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
很遺憾，目前我能提供的資訊就只有這些了。
{0}，你得自己去調查這條線索。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
While you work things
out with Engel Howard
and his family in Geffen,
I'll continue my research
on the Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
在你與恩格爾·霍華德及其在吉芬的家人商談期間，
我會繼續研究星淚石。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
That's why we need to
know what the message in
the Sobbing Starlight means.
First, we need a Wizard that
is skilled in unlocking the
messages stored in gems...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
這就是為什麼我們需要知道星淚石中的資訊意味著什麼。
首先，我們需要一位擅長解讀寶石中封存資訊的巫師...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Hmm. It would probably
be best to visit the Wizards
on the top floor of the Geffen
Tower. There's someone I know
there who might just be up for
this task...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
嗯。
最好去拜訪吉芬中央塔頂層的巫師。
我在那裡認識一個人，他可能正好願意接受這個任務...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
For now, please visit
the Wizards at the top
floor of the Geffen Tower.
I know that one of them is
capable of getting the gem's
text on to paper...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
現在，請去拜訪吉芬中央塔頂層的巫師。
我知道其中一位有能力將寶石上的文字轉錄到紙張上...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Just as I thought.
This language isn't
one I recognize. It's
probably ^333333too^000000 ancient.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
正如我所料。
這種語言我不認識。
它可能^333333太^000000古老了。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Fortunately, I know
one person who may
be able to translate this.
If he's not able to do it...
We'll have to give up.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
幸運的是，我認識一個人，他可能能翻譯這個。
如果他也不行...
我們就只能放棄了。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Bring this Record
of Ancient Language
to a man named Frank.
I hope he'll be able to
understand what it says...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
把這份古代語言記錄帶給一個叫弗蘭克的人。
希望他能讀懂上面寫的內容...

scripts.text: Who is Frank?
scripts.translation: 弗蘭克是誰？

scripts.text: Where is he?
scripts.translation: 他在哪裡？

scripts.text: I see.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Frank Franklin has lived
in seclusion and only a few
people are aware of his skill.
But I can assure you that his
knowledge of ancient languages
is unrivaled by any mortal.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
弗蘭克·富蘭克林
一直隱居，
只有少數人知道他的技藝。
但我可以向你保證，
他在古代語言方面的知識
無人能及。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I suppose his interest
in history is what drives
him in work. Still, I've
heard that he doesn't like
meeting people. I hope you
can convince him to help us...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我想，他對歷史的興趣是他工作的動力。
不過，我聽說他不喜歡見人。
希望你能說服他幫助我們...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
It's said that
Frank Franklin lives
on the Alberta Sunken Ship
where he devotes his time
to his research. He may not
always be home though...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
據說弗蘭克·富蘭克林住在艾爾貝塔的沉船上，
他在那裡專心致志地做研究。不過他可能並不總是在家...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Good luck, then.
I hope that you can
find a way to get Frank
Franklin to help us...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
祝你好運。
希望你能找到辦法讓弗蘭克·富蘭克林幫助我們...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I suppose his interest
in history is what drives
him in work. Still, I've
heard that he doesn't like
meeting people. I hope you
can convince him to help us...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我想，他對歷史的興趣是他工作的動力。
不過，我聽說他不喜歡見人。
希望你能說服他幫助我們...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
While I investigate,
please try to have Frank
Franklin translate the
message in the Record of
Ancient Language. Keep up
the good work, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
在我調查期間，
請試著讓弗蘭克·富蘭克林翻譯古代語言記錄中的資訊。
繼續加油，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Hmm...
''The town where the
rejected are left behind.''
What does that mean
and where could it be...?
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
嗯...
“被遺棄者留下的城鎮。”
這是什麼意思，又會在哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
You'll need a stout,
heavy or really sharp
weapon. Of course, I'm
told that such weapons
are truly rare...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你需要一把堅固、沉重或非常鋒利的武器。
當然，我聽說這種武器非常稀有...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Supposedly, normal
Blacksmiths can't even
forge those kinds of rare
weapons. But if you manage
to get one, you might have a
chance of breaking the seals.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
據說普通的鐵匠甚至無法鍛造這種稀有武器。
但如果你能弄到一把，你就有可能打破封印。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Of course, I'm worried
that may be violating the
will of the gods by releasing
Angrboda, but we've already
gone this far...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
當然，我擔心釋放安格爾伯達可能會違背神的意志，
但我們已經走到這一步了...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I've found that the runes
around the lens control some
kind of seals placed at the Geffen Tower and Geffen Fountain. But with this in your hands, the seals should be broken...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我發現透鏡周圍的符文控制著放置在吉芬中央塔和吉芬噴泉上的某種封印。
但只要你拿著這個，封印應該就能被打破...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I... I think
you can even use this
to enter Valhalla. There
may be even other applications
using the power of this item...
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我...我覺得你甚至可以用這個進入英靈殿。
利用這件物品的力量，可能還有其他用途...

scripts.text:
[Metz]
I can only think of
one person who can
handle working with
this: Engel Howard,
Midgard's best
Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
我只想到一個人能處理這個：
恩格爾·霍華德，米德加爾特最好的鐵匠。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Thanks to you, my wish
of proving the existence
of the Sign has finally been
fulfilled. Its power is now
yours to do as you wish.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
多虧了你，我證明“標示”存在的願望終於實現了。
它的力量現在歸你所有，隨你處置。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
You may have had your doubts,
but I'm happy enough to confirm that the Sign really exists. Thanks again, and I hope you stop by and chat from time to time.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
你或許曾心存疑慮，
但我很高興能確認“標示”確實存在。
再次感謝，希望你有空常來坐坐，聊聊天。

scripts.text:
[Metz]
Although I need to
take back the Sobbing
Starlight, I hope you
accept this as a token
of my gratitude. Good luck
on your travels, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
雖然我要收回“哭泣星光”，
但請收下這份禮物，以表我的謝意。
旅途愉快，冒險者。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've freed up more inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在的物品欄太滿了。
請騰出一些空間後再來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Metz]
......
Farewell.

[Metz]
Well then...
Good luck on
your journeys,
brave {0}.
scripts.translation:
[梅茨]
那麼...
祝旅途愉快，
勇敢的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Welcome to the
Brayde Estate. How
may I be of service?
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
歡迎來到佈雷德莊園。
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Ah, Master {0}.
Welcome. How may I be
of service today?
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
啊，{0}大人。
歡迎。今天有什麼可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
I recall that
Master Arian visited
the master a while ago.
They spent all night
discussing something
related to the master's work.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
我記得阿里安大人
不久前曾拜訪過主人。
他們徹夜長談，
似乎在討論與主人工作相關的事情。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Sometimes I worry
about Mistress Elle.
She's one of the most
beautiful girls in Prontera,
but does not have a boyfriend.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
我有時會擔心艾勒小姐。
她是普隆德拉最美的女孩之一，
卻還沒有男朋友。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Many travellers have
begun to visit the master
lastly. Apparently, they've
been led here by the sign
boards we've posted.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
最近有很多旅行者
開始拜訪主人。
聽說他們是看到我們張貼的告示才來的。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
It's most curious,
but Elle seems to
consider that unrefined
Jesqurienne as her rival.
Women are truly difficult
for me to understand...
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
真是奇怪，
艾勒小姐似乎把那個粗魯的傑斯庫莉恩
視為自己的對手。
女人真是讓我難以理解...

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Avarice knows no bounds.
The pastime of gambling
seems to best represent
mankind's greed.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
貪婪是沒有止境的。
賭博這種消遣，
似乎最能體現人類的貪婪。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Bakerlan is a young,
brilliant man. Although
he inherited his company,
it takes talent to continue
his father's successes.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
貝克蘭是個年輕有為的傑出人物。
雖然他是繼承家業，
但要延續父親的輝煌，也需要非凡的才華。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Oh, congratulations~
You finally passed all
of the tests. I know they
must have been incredibly
taxing and challenging.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
哦，恭喜~
你終於通過了所有測試。
我知道那一定非常辛苦且充滿挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Although humans make
mistakes, there are those
times when failing cannot
be an option.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
雖然人類會犯錯，
但有些時候，失敗是不被允許的。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
There will always
be situations where
you won't be getting
any second chances.
Anyways remember that.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
總會有一些情況，
讓你沒有第二次機會。
無論如何，請記住這一點。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text: I'm here to see Metz.
scripts.translation: 我要見梅茨。

scripts.text: Gimmie your cash!
scripts.translation: 快把錢交出來！

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
If you do not have
any business to conduct
with Master Metz, please
leave immediately.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
如果您沒有要見梅茨大人的正事，
請立即離開。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Very good, {0}
Please wait a moment
while I consult with
the master in his study.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
非常好，{0}。
請稍候，我去書房請示一下梅茨大人。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
My apologies,
but I insist that
you leave the premises
^FF0000immediately^000000.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
非常抱歉，
但我堅持要求您
^FF0000立刻^000000離開這裡。

scripts.text: Who is Arian?
scripts.translation: 阿里安是誰？

scripts.text: What is Metz doing?
scripts.translation: 梅茨在做什麼？

scripts.text: How is Elle?
scripts.translation: 艾勒怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Ah yes, Arian.
I consider him to be
a man of few words. The
words he does choose to
use are rather harsh and
brutish, you might say.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
啊，是的，阿里安。
我覺得他是個沉默寡言的人。
他偶爾說出的話，
往往相當嚴厲和粗暴。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Although I've served
the Brayde family for years,
I'm unfamiliar with Master
Metz's work. My apologies, but
I simply cannot even begin to fathom his research...
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
雖然我侍奉佈雷德家族多年，
但並不熟悉梅茨大人的工作。
很抱歉，
我甚至無法想像他的研究內容...

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Ah, Mistress Elle
has been working here
since she was a very young
girl. She is almost like
a granddaughter to me.
Ha ha-^333333*Ahem*^000000
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
啊，艾勒小姐
從小就在這裡工作了。
她對我來說就像孫女一樣。
哈哈——^333333*咳咳*^000000

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Goodness, it sounded
dreadfully serious. The
term, 'ancient power' is
usually not mentioned
quite often in conversation.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
天哪，聽起來
非常嚴肅。
“古代力量”這個詞，
通常很少在對話中被提及。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Many men have given her
a great deal of attention, but
she always manages to reject
every single suitor...
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
許多男士都對她
給予了極大的關注，
但她總是能拒絕
每一位追求者...

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Take heed and
do not let anyone
else take the opportunity
the master has presented
away from you.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
請留心，
不要讓任何人奪走
梅茨大人給予您的機會。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Winning or losing, some
gamblers always seem to find
some reason to continue when
it's smarter to stop. Then again, the mind usually doesn't take precedence over the heart...
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
無論輸贏，
有些賭徒總會在該停手的時候
找到繼續的理由。
不過，理智通常無法戰勝情感...

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
It's amazing that Bakerlan
is also managing to expand
his business even further.
Of course, Master Metz has
had a role in Bakerlan's
success...
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
令人驚訝的是，
貝克蘭的生意
竟然還在進一步擴大。
當然，梅茨大人
在貝克蘭的成功中
也起到了作用...

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
Master Metz has informed
me that he wishes for you
to restore find someone
to restore the Sobbing
Starlight. I wish you luck
in that endeavor.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
梅茨大人通知我，
他希望您找到人
來恢復哭泣的星光。
祝您在那項任務中好運。

scripts.text:
[Vandez]
There will always
be situations where
you won't be getting
any second chances.
Anyways remember that.
scripts.translation:
[範德斯]
總會有一些情況，
讓你沒有第二次機會。
無論如何，請記住這一點。

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Wh-what are you
doing in Master Metz's
room? Please leave
immediately!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
你...你在梅茨大人的房間裡
做什麼？
請立刻離開！

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Oh...?
{0}?
Is there anything that
I can help you with?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哦...？
{0}？
有什麼我可以幫您的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I'm not so busy
nowadays, but I was
working hard for a while
so my body aches. Oh, what
am I saying? Please ignore
that--! Ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我現在不太忙，
但之前工作很努力，
所以渾身痠痛。哎呀，
我在說什麼呢？請忽略剛才的話——！呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Guys never understand
what a girl really wants!
They're always too afraid
of showing their interest~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
男生永遠不懂
女生真正想要什麼！
他們總是太害怕
表現出自己的興趣~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
^333333*Phew....*^000000
I'm so tired, even
though I didn't work
that much today. Some
days I feel exhausted
for no reason at all...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
^333333*呼....*^000000
我好累，
雖然今天並沒有
做很多工作。有些日子
我會無緣無故地感到疲憊...

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Jesqurienne?
Well, she's beautiful
and talented. She's actually
really great. That's why...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
傑斯庫莉恩？
嗯，她美麗又有才華。
她其實真的很棒。正因為如此...

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Have you been
in Comodo before?
It's such a beautiful
place with so many
things to do!
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
你以前去過克魔島嗎？
那裡風景優美，
有很多有趣的事情可以做！

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I remember that
there was a lady
working for Master
Bakerlan named Seylin.
I hear she's from some
distant country...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我記得有一位叫賽琳恩的女士，
她在貝克蘭師父那裡工作。
聽說她來自一個遙遠的國家...

scripts.text:
[Elle]
La la la~~
Oh, hello.
Long time no see.
La la la~~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
啦啦啦~~
哦，你好。
好久不見。
啦啦啦~~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Ah~ Hello!
Nice to see
you again~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
啊~ 你好！
很高興再次見到你~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Lately, there've
been too many guests
visiting Master Metz.
Why can't they leave their
dirt outside of the manor?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
^333333*嘆氣...*^000000
最近，
來拜訪梅茨師父的客人太多了。
為什麼他們不能把外面的灰塵
留在宅邸外面呢？

scripts.text: You wanna have coffee sometime?
scripts.translation: 有空一起喝杯咖啡嗎？

scripts.text: Tell me about Metz.
scripts.translation: 告訴我關於梅茨的事。

scripts.text:
[Elle]
...?
*Blush~*
Oh~ A-are you
asking me out
on a date?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
...？
*臉紅~*
哦~ 你...你是在
約我出去約會嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Weeeell~
Do I have the time
to go out with you or
not? Hm, maybe if
you're really nice
to me, , {0}.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嗯~
我有沒有時間
和你出去呢？嗯，
如果你對我很好的話，
{0}，也許我會考慮。

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Umm....
I don't know
what to say?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嗯....
我不知該說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
He's my employer and
I have an opinion of him,
but if I told you, it might
look unprofessional. But
if you have time later, I just
might tell you. Ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
他是我的僱主，
我對他有一些看法，
但如果我告訴你，
可能會顯得不專業。不過，
如果你以後有空，
我可能會告訴你。呵呵~

scripts.text: You have nice skin, Miss Elle.
scripts.translation: 艾勒小姐，你的皮膚真好。

scripts.text: Tell me about Metz.
scripts.translation: 告訴我關於梅茨的事。

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Eh...?
Why, thank you!
Maybe it's because
I don't go out too
often. You have nice
I don't go out too, {0}~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
誒...？
哎呀，謝謝誇獎！
也許是因為我
不太常出門吧。你也是，
{0}，不太常出門~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Umm....
I don't know
what to say?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嗯....
我不知該說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
He's my employer and
I have an opinion of him,
but if I told you, it might
look unprofessional. But
if you have time later, I just
might tell you.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
他是我的僱主，
我對他有一些看法，
但如果我告訴你，
可能會顯得不專業。不過，
如果你以後有空，
我可能會告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Well, even when they
do ask me on dates, I never
accept their proposals that
easily. Hmph, there's not
too many boys I like out
there, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嗯，即使有人
約我出去，我也不會
輕易答應他們的提議。哼，
反正我也沒遇到幾個
讓我喜歡的男生。

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I should take
the day off and
rest. If I had some
refreshment, that
would be perfect...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我應該請個假
休息一下。如果能喝點
提神的東西，
那就完美了...

scripts.text: Why don't you take this?
scripts.translation: 不如你喝這個？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Oh, you didn't
need to do this,
but that you soooo
much! Ahhhhhhh~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哦，你不用
這麼做的，
但你真是太好了！啊~~~~~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I consider her
my rival! She might
be smarter than me,
but maybe I can become
more beautiful than her...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我把她
視為我的對手！她可能
比我聰明，
但我也許可以
變得比她更漂亮...

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I like gambling in
Comodo, but I think
it's a little addictive.
I've even seen people
who seem to live for it...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我喜歡在克魔島賭博，
但我覺得這有點
讓人上癮。
我甚至見過
似乎以此為生的人...

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I've seen her
once and I think
she has a unique
style of beauty. Well,
different than mine or
Jesquienne's anyway...
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我見過她一次，
我覺得她有一種
獨特的美。嗯，
反正和我或者
傑斯奎恩都不一樣...

scripts.text: What's up?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text: What happened?
scripts.translation: 發生了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Oh...?
Oops...!
Do I really
look that excited?
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
哦...？
哎呀...！
我看起來
真的很興奮嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elle]
I just started
going out with someone!
He's a tall handsome boy
and I'm so in love with
him and he's so....
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
我剛開始和一個人約會！
他是個高個子帥哥，
我超級喜歡他，
他那麼...

scripts.text:
^3355FFElle continued
talking about how
much she loves her
new boyfriend, even
after you leave the room.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF艾勒繼續
談論她有多愛
她的新男友，
即使你離開了房間。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Umm....
Yes, something
very good happened
to me. Ho ho ho ho!
But it's a secret~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
嗯....
是的，發生了一件
非常好的事。呵呵呵呵！
但是這是個秘密~

scripts.text:
[Elle]
Er, I'm sorry, but I heard that something bad happened to you. But don't worry, maybe you'll have better luck next time~
scripts.translation:
[艾勒]
呃，對不起，我聽說你遇到了一些不好的事。但別擔心，也許下次你的運氣會好一些~

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've freed up more inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在的物品欄太滿了。
請騰出一些空間後再來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Who the hell
are you, jerkface?
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
你他媽是誰，混蛋？

scripts.text: Metz sent me here.
scripts.translation: 梅茨派我來的。

scripts.text: Who are you then?
scripts.translation: 那你又是誰？

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Oh yeah...?
Well, I'm sending you
back! No way I'm fallin'
for that trick, chump!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
哦是嗎...？
我要把你送回去！
我才不會上你的當，蠢貨！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Wha...?
^0000FF{0}^000000?
Yeah, okay. Metz did
mention something about
about you. You're here
for the test, right?
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
什...？
^0000FF{0}^000000？
好吧。梅茨確實
提到過你。你是來
參加測試的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Alright, this
test is simple.
I tell you to bring me
a bunch of items and
you go get them.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
好了，這個
測試很簡單。
我讓你去拿一堆物品，
你就去拿。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
I know you jerkward adventurers
are always talking and you share the answers for any test some dude is givin' out. 'Course, it doesn't help that I use the same test
every frickin' time...
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
我知道你們這些混蛋冒險者
總是在聊天，而且你們會分享
任何測試的答案。當然，
這也沒用，因為我每次都用
同樣的測試...

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Now, you gotta bring and only
have the item I ask you for when you come to me. If you know that I'll be asking for something later and you happen to have it, I'll straight up ^FF0000jack it^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
現在，你來的時候必須只帶著
我讓你拿的物品。如果你知道
我稍後會要什麼，而你恰好有，
我會直接^FF0000搶走它^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
The first item?
Gimme ^FF0000100 Fluff^000000.
Bring that and I'll
tell you what to
bring next.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
第一個物品？
給我^FF0000100個絨毛^000000。
帶著它來，我會
告訴你接下來
要拿什麼。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
......
Your mom.
Now get the
hell outta here!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
......
你媽的。
現在給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Hey. What the hell's wrong
with you? Hurry and get me
^FF0000100 Fluff^000000, ya slacker.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
嘿。你他媽怎麼了？
快點給我弄^FF0000100個絨毛^000000，你這懶鬼。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Alright, that looks like
enough Fluff. Now, go and
get me ^FF000050 Poison Spores^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
好了，絨毛夠了。
現在去給我弄^FF000050個毒魔菇芽孢^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Hey. What part of 'Get me
^FF000050 Poison Spores^000000 or I'll
kick your ass,' don't
you understand?
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
嘿。哪部分沒聽懂？
“給我弄^FF000050個毒魔菇芽孢^000000，
不然我揍你。”

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
It's about time you
got here with those
Poison Spores. Now, go
and get ^FF000030 Scorpion Tails^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
你總算帶著毒魔菇芽孢來了。
現在去給我弄^FF000030條蠍子尾巴^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
What, your mom drop you on the
head right after you were born?
Stop bein' stupid and get me
^FF000030 Scorpion Tails^000000, nimrod.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
怎麼，你媽生你的時候
把你頭摔地上了？
別犯傻了，去給我弄
^FF000030條蠍子尾巴^000000，蠢貨。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Damn, you sure took your
sweet time bringing over this
over this crap. Okay, now bring
^FF000020 Rotten Bandages^000000.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
該死，你磨蹭這麼久
才把這破玩意兒拿來。
行，現在去弄
^FF000020個腐爛繃帶^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Is it really that hard to get
^FF000020 Rotten Bandages^000000? Cuz if it
is, then you must really blow.
Now hustle it up, punk!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
弄^FF000020個腐爛繃帶^000000
有那麼難嗎？
要是難，那你肯定
是個廢物。
快點，朽魔！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
You brought the bandages.
Okay short stuff, go and get
me ^FF000015 Little Evil Horn^000000. What
are you waiting for, a memo?
Get outta here~!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
繃帶帶來了。
好吧，矮子，去給我弄
^FF000015個小惡魔角^000000。
怎麼，等備忘嗎？
滾出去~！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
I don't get it.
You don't have the
^FF000015 Little Evil Horn^000000
I told you to get.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
我不明白。
你沒帶我說過的
^FF000015個小惡魔角^000000。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
My grandma coulda grown
out her beard in the time
it tookyou to come back.
Now hurry it up and get
me ^FF000010 Coral Reefs^000000!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
等你回來的這段時間，
我奶奶都能把鬍子留長了。
快點去給我弄
^FF000010個珊瑚^000000！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
I see, so it's my
fault for not telling you
not to bring your crap face
back without 'em. ^333333*A-hem*^000000
Don't bring your crap face here without 15 Little Evil Horns!!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
我明白了，是我沒告訴你
沒帶東西就別把那張
臭臉帶回來。^333333*咳*^000000
沒帶15個小惡魔角就別把那張臭臉帶回來！！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
I don't care how pretty
they are or if you're ruining
the ecosystem! When I say
''bring ^FF000010 Coral Reefs^000000,'' you
better have them! All the
fish can die for all I care.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
我不管它們多漂亮，
也不管你是不是在破壞生態！
我說“弄^FF000010個珊瑚^000000”，
你就得給我弄來！
魚死光了我也無所謂。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Finally you're back.
Gimme a sec to count
all this stuff so I can make
sure you're not trying to
cheat. God help you if you
try to pull a fast one on me...!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
你終於回來了。
給我點時間數一下
這些東西，確保你沒想
作弊。你要是敢耍我...
上帝保佑你...！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Alright. Go talk
to the guy to my left.
The dude at the counter.
What's-his-face, Ganaan.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
好了。去跟我左邊
那個人說話。
櫃檯後面的那個傢伙。
叫什麼來著，加南。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Alright. Go talk
to the guy to my left.
The dude at the counter.
What's-his-face, Ganaan.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
好了。去跟我左邊
那個人說話。
櫃檯後面的那個傢伙。
叫什麼來著，加南。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
You wanna leave me
alone now and gimme
a little personal space?!
I need a break from looking
at your ugly mug, you know?
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
你現在能不能
讓我一個人待會兒，
給我點私人空間？！
我需要休息一下，
不想再看你那張醜臉了，懂嗎？

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Let's see...
I'm looking at your
answers and they totally
suck. Take the test again
and do it right this time!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
讓我看看...
我看你的答案，
簡直爛透了。重新考一次，
這次給我答對！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Geez...
You're givin' Ganaan
a hard time. You hear
me? That's my job!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
天哪...
你在給加南
找麻煩。你聽到了嗎？
那是我的工作！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
Alright. The answers
you gave Ganaan tell me
you're not a total dumbass.
Now you're supposed to go see Daewoon in Payon. And don't forget to show him this Star thingee.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
好了。你給加南的答案
告訴我你不是個
徹底的白痴。
現在你應該去斐揚找大雲。
別忘了給他看這個星星東西。

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...........
Payon...?
Daewoon?
Any of it ring a bell?
Cuz it really oughtta!
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...........
斐揚...？
大雲？
這些名字有印象嗎？
你應該有的！

scripts.text:
[Arian]
...
Shaddup and
lemme alone!
I'm thinking about
solving world hunger
here! Or somethin' like that.
scripts.translation:
[阿里安]
...
閉嘴，
讓我一個人待會兒！
我正在思考
如何解決世界飢餓問題！
或者類似的事情。

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
The weather here in
Morocc is too hot for me.
I'm having a hard time just
trying to live here. Do you
know a nice and cool place
where I can work?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
這裡摩洛哥的天氣
對我來說太熱了。
我很難在這裡生活。
你知道哪裡
又涼快又能工作嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
Oh, Arian sent you to me,
right? I'm sorry, but he takes
a little getting used to. Even
though I still have to get used
to his... mannerisms.
scripts.translation:
[加南]
哦，是阿里安派你來的吧？
抱歉，他這人有點難相處。
雖然我也還在適應他的...舉止。

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
Hm...?
Arian is the one
who's grading your
test. But I understand.
If you failed, I'd want
to avoid him too...
scripts.translation:
[加南]
嗯...？
阿里安是負責批改你試卷的人。
但我理解你的心情。
如果我不及格，我也想躲著他...

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I wish the weather'd
cool down, even just a little.
While I'm asking for miracles,
I may as well wish for a billion kajillion zeny. And maybe a yacht.
scripts.translation:
[加南]
^333333*嘆氣...*^000000
真希望天氣能涼快一點，哪怕只是一點點也好。
既然都在許願了，不如順便許個願，想要億萬Zeny。再要一艘遊艇也不錯。

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
Anyway, since he thinks it's
boring, Arian put me in charge
of the quiz portion of your test. Please carefully choose an
answer when I ask you a
question. Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
總之，因為阿里安覺得無聊，
所以讓我負責你考試的問答部分。
當我提問時，請仔細選擇一個答案。
準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
Now, the first question.
Let's say that you just
found yourself on a deserted
island. What is the very first
thing that you should do?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
現在，第一題。
假設你發現自己被困在了一座荒島上。
你首先應該做什麼？

scripts.text: Look for fresh water.
scripts.translation: 尋找淡水

scripts.text: Just wait for rescue.
scripts.translation: 等待救援

scripts.text: Forage for food.
scripts.translation: 尋找食物

scripts.text: Explore the island.
scripts.translation: 探索島嶼

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
The second question is...
You happen to be stuck in
a narrow place inside some
collapsed building. What
do you plan to do first?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
第二題是...
你被困在一棟倒塌建築的狹窄縫隙裡。
你打算先做什麼？

scripts.text: Scream for help.
scripts.translation: 大聲呼救

scripts.text: Stay quiet.
scripts.translation: 保持安靜

scripts.text: Wait for death to come.
scripts.translation: 等待死亡降臨

scripts.text: Find a way out.
scripts.translation: 尋找出路

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
Now, the third question.
You're on some dungeon
expedition with your friends,
but you got lost somehow.
How do you handle it?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
現在，第三題。
你和朋友們正在探索地下城，
但不知怎麼迷路了。
你會怎麼處理？

scripts.text: Try to find my friends.
scripts.translation: 嘗試尋找朋友

scripts.text: Find a way out.
scripts.translation: 尋找出路

scripts.text: Stay put.
scripts.translation: 留在原地

scripts.text: Continue exploring the dungeon.
scripts.translation: 繼續探索地下城

scripts.text:
[Ganaan]
Here's the fourth question.
You're with your friends inside
a mansion with no exit. What do
you do first when a murder happens inside the mansion?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
這是第四題。
你和朋友們在一座沒有出口的豪宅裡。
當豪宅裡發生謀殺案時，你首先會做什麼？

scripts.text: Wait for the case to get solved.
scripts.translation: 等待案件偵破

scripts.text: Try to find my friends first.
scripts.translation: 先嚐試尋找朋友

scripts.text: Find a way out.
scripts.translation: 尋找出路

scripts.text: Solve the murder case on my own.
scripts.translation: 獨自解決謀殺案

scripts.text: Kill the others before they kill me.
scripts.translation: 在他們殺我之前先殺了他們

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
The fifth question is...
You hear that the end of
the world is in one week.
So what do you do during
this final week?
scripts.translation:
[加南]
第五題是...
你聽說世界將在一週後終結。
那麼在這最後一週裡，你會做什麼？

scripts.text: Wait to see the end.
scripts.translation: 等待結局的到來

scripts.text: Plant an apple tree.
scripts.translation: 種一棵蘋果樹

scripts.text: Look to move to a different world.
scripts.translation: 尋找前往其他世界的方法

scripts.text: What else? Save the world.
scripts.translation: 還能做什麼？拯救世界

scripts.text: What else? Go on a crime spree.
scripts.translation: 還能做什麼？大肆犯罪

scripts.text:
[Gaanan]
Oh! We're done!
Okay, let me give
these answers to Arian.
Sooo... Talk to him and
he'll let you know how
you did.
scripts.translation:
[加南]
哦！我們問完了！
好了，讓我把這些答案交給阿里安。
那麼...去和他談談，
他會告訴你你的表現如何。

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
Have you heard?
Payon's most eligible
bachelor is back home!
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
你聽說了嗎？
斐揚最搶手的單身漢
回家了！

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
He was a little brat
back when he was a kid,
but now he's grown up to
be the manliest of men!
No wonder all the ladies
just can't resist him!
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
他小時候還是個調皮搗蛋的小鬼，
但現在他成長為一個
最有男子氣概的男人！
難怪所有的女士們
都對他無法抗拒！

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
Heh heh...
With this beautiful
face and charming figure...
I'm gonna seduce him.
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
嘿嘿...
有著這張英俊的臉龐
和迷人的身材...
我要去勾引他。

scripts.text: Who are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說誰？

scripts.text: You're freaking me out!
scripts.translation: 你嚇到我了！

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
You don't know
Daewoon, the most
beautiful man in all
of Payon and maybe
even the world?
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
你不知道大雲嗎？
他是整個斐揚，
甚至可能是全世界
最英俊的男人？

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
He left home to become stronger
when he was just a boy. I had no idea he would come back as such 
a fine specimen of a man...
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
他小時候就離家去變強了。
我沒想到他會以如此
完美的男人形象回來...

scripts.text: I'd like to meet this Daewoon.
scripts.translation: 我想見見這位大雲

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
Oh, I see~
You plan to ask him
to show you some fighting
pointers, do you? You men
are all the same: not as
cool or tough as Daewoon!
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
哦，我明白了~
你打算讓他
教你一些戰鬥技巧，是嗎？
你們男人都一樣：
都不如大雲帥氣和強悍！

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
Oh, I see~
Interested, are you?
Well, you'll have to get
in line. So many women
and only one Daewoon...
^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
哦，我明白了~
你感興趣了？
那你得排隊了。這麼多女人，
卻只有一個大雲...
^333333*嘆氣*^000000

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
Anyway, Daewoon
is staying in the annex
to the Payon Castle. If you
want to see him for yourself,
why don't you go there?
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
總之，大雲
住在斐揚城堡的附屬建築裡。
如果你想親自見見他，
不妨去那裡看看？

scripts.text:
[Hagin]
Freaking you out?
Excuuuuse me~!
I'll have you know that
a flower's life is brief.
I better snag Daewoon
while I still can~
scripts.translation:
[哈金]
嚇到你了？
對不起了啦~！
要知道，花兒的壽命是很短暫的。
我得趁現在趕緊把大雲追到手~

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Welcome to the
Payon Castle annex
where Master Daewoon
is staying.
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
歡迎光臨斐揚城堡附屬建築，
大雲師父就住在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Welcome.
Are you another
visitor for Master
Daewoon?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
歡迎光臨。
您也是來拜訪
大雲師父的客人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Greetings.
Welcome to the
Annex to Payon Castle.
Have you come here to
see Master Daewoon?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
您好。
歡迎來到斐揚城堡附屬建築。
您是來見大雲師父的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maid]
Welcome to the
Payon Castle Annex.
Master Daewoon is
currently lodging here.
Have you come to see him?
scripts.translation:
[女僕]
歡迎光臨斐揚城堡附屬建築。
大雲師父目前住在這裡。
您是來見他的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
Please refrain
from attacking
the servants.
scripts.translation:
[侍從長]
請不要攻擊僕人。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
Although you may recognize
us as monsters, we have
all been properly hired and
faithfully serve our master,
Daewoon. So there's no
need to feel uneasy.
scripts.translation:
[侍從長]
雖然你們可能把我們看作魔物，
但我們都是正式受僱的，
並且忠實地侍奉著大雲師父。
所以不必感到不安。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
Master Daewoon~!
Please try this too!
It's Tiger Foot Skin soup,
boiled with nine kinds of
exotic, potent herbs.
scripts.translation:
[侍從長]
大雲師父~！
請嚐嚐這個！
這是虎皮湯，
用九種珍稀強效草藥熬製而成。

scripts.text:
[Chamberlain]
It's famous for easing
sores and fatigure, preventing
cold and ^333333*Ahem*^000000 enhancing male vigor. Now, open wide, master~
scripts.translation:
[侍從長]
它以緩解疼痛和疲勞、預防感冒以及^333333*咳咳*^000000增強男性活力而聞名。來，張嘴，師父~

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Mwah ah hah!
Feasting and merriment,
wine, women and song!
I could ask for nothing more!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
哇哈哈！
美酒佳餚，歌舞昇平！
我還能奢求什麼呢！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
The most scrumptious
delicacies are all mine to
taste! And I'm not just talking about the food. Mwah ah hah!
I'm the king of the world!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
最美味的珍饈都歸我品嚐！
而且我說的可不只是食物。哇哈哈！
我才是世界之王！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh, a visitor?
I'm sorry, but I believe
you're an uninvited guest~
You'll have to forgive me
if I wish to spend my time with maidens as opposed to men.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
哦，有客人？
抱歉，我想你是不請自來的吧~
請原諒我，比起男人，
我更願意把時間花在美女身上。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh, a visitor?
I'm sorry, but I believe
you're an uninvited guest~
No matter, a beauty is a beauty, whether or not I know her name.
Come and drink with me~
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
哦，有客人？
抱歉，我想你是不請自來的吧~
沒關係，美人就是美人，
不管我認不認識她。
來，陪我喝一杯~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure...
But first, would you
take a look at this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧...
不過首先，你能看看這個嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou carefully take
out the small, lucid
jewel that Arian gave
you and reveal it to
Daewoon's roving eyes.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你小心翼翼地拿出阿里安給你的那顆晶瑩剔透的小寶石，
展示在大雲四處游移的目光前。^000000

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Eh? Why that's...
I see now, Arian must
have sent you! Oh you
should have said so
at the very beginning~
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
咦？那是...
我明白了，阿里安派你來的！
你一開始就該說清楚嘛~

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
My apologies~
Lately I've been attracting
all sorts of strange attention like some kind of teen celebrity. I've gotten used to being too careful in screening out the dangerous sort.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
抱歉~
最近我像某些青少年明星一樣，
總是吸引各種奇怪的關注。
我已經習慣了小心翼翼地篩選掉那些危險的人。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Now then.
Do you have any
idea what that jewel
you're holding actually is?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
那麼。
你知道你手裡拿的
那顆寶石到底是什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Kind of?
scripts.translation: 有點印象？

scripts.text: How the hell would I know?
scripts.translation: 我怎麼會知道？

scripts.text: No, but would you tell me?
scripts.translation: 不，但你能告訴我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh...!
You must be much
smarter than I expected.
So tell me, what do you
understand about this jewel?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
噢...！
看來你比我想像的聰明多了。
那麼告訴我，
你對這顆寶石有什麼瞭解？

scripts.text: It's handy.
scripts.translation: 挺方便的。

scripts.text: I actually don't know...
scripts.translation: 其實我不太清楚...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Mmm...?
Handy? If you truly
understood, I don't
think you'd describe this
jewel as merely 'handy.'
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
嗯...？
方便？如果你真的瞭解它，
我想你不會只用“方便”
來形容這顆寶石。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Really?
Mm. At least you
admit it. *Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
真的嗎？
嗯。至少你還承認了。*嘆氣*

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
...
A rather crass way
of speaking, but perhaps
you picked it up from Arian.
In any case, let me explain.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
...
說話雖然有點粗魯，
但也許你是跟阿里安學的。
不管怎樣，讓我解釋一下。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Didn't Arian tell you
anything? I appreciate
your honesty. And I don't
mind chatting a while, I much
prefer speaking to honest people rather than foolish know-it-alls.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
阿里安沒告訴你什麼嗎？
我很欣賞你的誠實。
我不介意聊一會兒，
比起那些愚蠢的自以為是的人，
我更喜歡和誠實的人交談。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
That ^31009CSobbing Starlight^000000
is no mere jewel. It is a key
item for unlocking some incredible power. I believe Metz happened to obtain a piece, though I am
unsure how...
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
那顆^31009C星淚石^000000
並不是普通的寶石。
它是解鎖某種驚人力量的關鍵物品。
我相信梅茨恰好獲得了一塊碎片，
雖然我不確定是怎麼得到的...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Metz has asked me and
some other friends who
hold the fragments of the
Sobbing Starlight to entrust
them to someone worthy of
finding the power it leads to.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
梅茨請求我和其他持有星淚石碎片的朋友，
將碎片託付給一個有資格找到其背後力量的人。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Of course, we all agreed
and now you're here for me
to judge whether or not you're
qualified for this task. Now,
are you ready for my test?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
當然，我們都同意了，
現在你在這裡，
我要判斷你是否具備完成這項任務的資格。
那麼，
你準備好接受我的測試了嗎？

scripts.text: I'M READY! YEEAH!
scripts.translation: 我準備好了！耶！

scripts.text: I'll do my best!
scripts.translation: 我會盡力的！

scripts.text: To hell with this!
scripts.translation: 去他的！

scripts.text: Fine. Let's get it over with.
scripts.translation: 好吧。快點結束吧。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Ooh~
Such unbridled
enthusiasm usually
does more good than harm.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
噢~
這種毫無保留的熱情，
通常利大於弊。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Mwah ah hah!
That's exactly what
I wanted to hear! That
kind of quiet and careful
confidence will help you
in the future, you'll see~
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
哇哈哈！
這正是我想聽到的！
這種安靜而謹慎的自信，
將來會幫到你，你會看到的~

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
E...
Excuse me?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
呃...
抱歉？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
How can you be
so ridiculous at
at time like this?
Either mind your manners
or don't take this test at
all! ^333333*SLAP--!!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
在這種時候，
你怎麼能這麼荒唐？
要麼注意你的禮儀，
要麼就別參加這個測試了！^333333*啪--！！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Hmm. That kind of half-hearted
attitude won't get you very far on your adventures. Still, so long as you don't get overly negative, you should have a decent chance of surviving your challenges.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
嗯。這種半心半意的態度，
在冒險中走不遠。不過，
只要你不變得過於消極，
你應該有不錯的機會應對挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Now, Metz expects me to ask
some rather serious questions,
but that really isn't my style. For this test, why don't we just talk?
Just answer me honestly and
light heartedly, alright?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
梅茨希望我提出一些相當嚴肅的問題，
但這真的不是我的風格。
這次測試，我們不如就隨便聊聊吧？
只要誠實地、輕鬆地回答我就好，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
So...
Do you have a lot
of friends that you can
constantly party with?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
那麼...
你有許多可以經常一起組隊的
朋友嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text: I prefer soloing.
scripts.translation: 我更喜歡單刷。

scripts.text: I am lonely.
scripts.translation: 我很孤獨。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh, that's great~!
To have many friends
is a priceless blessing.
Friends bring us joy and
aid when we find ourselves
suffering from difficulties.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
噢，那太棒了~！
擁有許多朋友是無價的福分。
當我們陷入困境時，
朋友會帶給我們快樂和援助。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Wouldn't you
agree that being
really close friends
with someone can be
a life long benefit?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
你不覺得與某人成為非常親密的朋友，
是一輩子的受益嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Well, everybody
needs to be alone once
in a while. And there are
some battles you must
fight all on your own.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
嗯，每個人偶爾都需要獨處。
而且有些戰鬥，
你必須獨自面對。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Also, if you never
deal with other people,
you may grow selfish or
needy. It's better to go
out and meet people,
don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
另外，如果你從不與人打交道，
可能會變得自私或依賴他人。
我覺得走出去多認識人會更好，
你不覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
You don't have any
friends at all? Well,
you better learn how
to get along with others
as soon as you can...!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
你完全沒有朋友嗎？好吧，
你最好儘快學會如何與他人相處...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Now, what's your opinion
on purposely getting lots
of monsters to follow you
around. I believe this is
called ''Mob Training...''
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
那麼，你對故意引來大量魔物
跟著自己這件事有什麼看法？
我想這被稱為“刷怪訓練...”

scripts.text: Awesome~!
scripts.translation: 太酷了~！

scripts.text: I hate people who do that.
scripts.translation: 我討厭那樣做的人。

scripts.text: I do it sometimes...
scripts.translation: 我有時候會這樣做...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
But...
Wouldn't that be really
rude to anyone else hunting
on that same map? I think
it would even interfere with
someone else's gameplay...
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
但是...
這對在同一張地圖上打怪的其他人
來說不是很沒禮貌嗎？
我覺得這甚至會干擾
其他人的遊戲體驗...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Perhaps you should try
to consider other people's
feelings. Mob Training seems
to only be good at getting other
people angry with you...
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
也許你應該試著體諒他人的感受。
刷怪訓練似乎只會讓其他人對你生氣...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Really?
I do too!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
真的嗎？
我也一樣！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Just the other day, I've
heard some ruffians boasting
of their mob training activities. But personally, I feel they were compensating for their own shortcomings.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
就在前幾天，我聽到一些惡棍
吹噓他們的刷怪訓練活動。
但就我個人而言，我覺得他們是在
掩飾自己的不足。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Such behavior truly
bothers me. Although I have
spent years in developing an
unflappable personality, I find
myself irked when encountering
such troublemakers.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
這種行為真的讓我很困擾。雖然我已經
花了很多年培養自己沉穩的性格，
但遇到這種搗亂者時，
我還是會感到惱火。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
When you face obstacles
in your own training, never give in to weakness. Assert yourself and find the determination to overcome your tribulations with honor!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
當你在訓練中遇到障礙時，
絕不要向軟弱屈服。堅定自己，
找到克服苦難的決心，
並以榮譽戰勝它們！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
At least you're honest.
But let me say that I cannot
condone that sort of weak willed behavior. True strength can only
be found through honor.
Remember that.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
至少你很誠實。
但我要說，我無法容忍
那種意志薄弱的行為。真正的力量
只能通過榮譽獲得。
請記住這一點。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
In the face of overwhelming
odds, do not despair. After all, what is achievement if it is not earned without difficulty? The greater the challenge, the
greater the glory.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
面對壓倒性的劣勢，不要絕望。畢竟，若沒有艱辛的付出，何談成就？挑戰越大，榮耀便越輝煌。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Even if you are having hard time,
try to take a firm stand.
One day, you will realise how strong you have become.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
即使你正身處困境，也要努力站穩腳跟。
終有一天，你會意識到自己變得多麼強大。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
And...
Don't ever partake in
mob training again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
還有...
以後絕對不要再進行刷怪訓練了，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Anyway, I'm sure you're
aware of the War of Emperium
in which mighty guilds all across Midgard battle for guild castle dominion. It's actually quite popular, really.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
總之，我相信你一定聽說過攻城戰。
那是米德加爾特各地強大的公會為了爭奪公會城堡控制權而進行的戰鬥。
實際上，這項活動非常受歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Now imagine that both of us
are in the midst of a heated guild war. The sounds of explosions and earth shaking magic spells are all we can hear. At any time, we can
be lost in that mindless chaos.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
現在想像一下，我們正處於激烈的公會戰之中。
耳邊只有爆炸聲和撼動大地的魔法咒語聲。
隨時都可能迷失在那片混亂之中。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Finally, through incredible
good fortune, we manage to
infiltrate the enemy guild castle and reach their Emperium. If we destroy that Emperium, that castle will belong to our guild.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
最終，憑藉不可思議的好運，我們成功滲透進敵方公會城堡，並抵達了華麗金屬所在地。
如果我們摧毀那個華麗金屬，這座城堡就將歸屬我們的公會。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
However...! This is
no ordinary Emperium!
It is a masterful sculpture
of a gorgeous Priestess!
Answer me, adventurer!
Would you still destroy it?!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
然而...！
這可不是普通的華麗金屬！
它是一座精美絕倫的女祭司雕像！
回答我，冒險者！
你還會摧毀它嗎？！

scripts.text: Destroy it!
scripts.translation: 摧毀它！

scripts.text: I can't destroy such beauty...
scripts.translation: 我無法摧毀如此美麗的東西...

scripts.text: I'd close my eyes, then destroy it.
scripts.translation: 我會閉上眼睛，然後摧毀它。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Hmm. You have a truly
strong will. Then again,
perhaps you lack a true
appreciation for beauty.
Even in Emperium form, how
could you harm a Priestess?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
嗯。你有著非常堅定的意志。
不過，也許你缺乏對美的真正鑑賞力。
即使是華麗金屬形態，你怎能傷害一位女祭司呢？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Hmm. You have a truly
strong will. Then again,
perhaps you cannot appreciate
a Priestess's beauty in the
way that a man would.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
嗯。你有著非常堅定的意志。
不過，也許你無法像男子那樣欣賞女祭司的美。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Ah yes! I felt you would answer that way! We must cherish and protect what is beautiful in this world. I would never be able to harm a Priestess, even in
statue form...
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
啊，沒錯！我就知道你會這樣回答！
我們必須珍惜並保護這個世界上的美好事物。
即使是雕像形態，我也絕不會傷害一位女祭司...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Interesting...!
Although you cherish
the beauty of the Priestess,
your loyalty to your guild
proves stronger. A most
admirable attitude!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
有趣...！
雖然你珍視女祭司的美，
但你對公會的忠誠更為強烈。
這是一種非常令人欽佩的態度！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
But yes, if it were
me, I would protect that
Priestess shaped Emperium
until the end of the guild war.
Mwah ah hah~!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
不過，如果是我的話，我會保護那座女祭司形態的華麗金屬，直到公會戰結束。
哇哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
While we're on the topic
of guilds, let me present
another guild related scenario. Let's say that you joined a very popular guild with many allies,
as well as formidable enemies.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
既然提到了公會，讓我再給你講一個與公會相關的場景。
假設你加入了一個非常受歡迎的公會，那裡有許多盟友，
也有強大的敵人。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Now, during one of your.
hunts, you happen to meet
a member of one of your enemy guilds. The two of you are the only people on that map. Suddenly, he finds himself in mortal danger!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
現在，在一次狩獵中，你恰好遇到了敵方公會的一名成員。
那張地圖上只有你們兩個人。突然，他陷入了致命的危險！

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
This enemy guild member
begins to yell for help. Now,
would you give your enemy
the help that he needs?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
這名敵方公會成員開始大聲呼救。
那麼，你會向你的敵人伸出援手嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, of course!
scripts.translation: 是的，當然！

scripts.text: I'd pretend not to hear anything.
scripts.translation: 我會假裝沒聽到。

scripts.text: I'd make fun of him, then run off.
scripts.translation: 我會嘲笑他，然後跑開。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Ah, you would help him!
Good, good. I'm glad to see
that you understand that such pettiness should not get in the way of doing what is good and right.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
啊，你願意幫助他！
很好，很好。很高興看到你能明白，
這種小氣不該妨礙你去做正確的事。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
True, you're not really
obligated to help your
enemy. Besides, you may
hurt his feelings once he
realizes that he's had to
depend on his rival for help.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
確實，你並沒有義務幫助你的敵人。
而且，當他意識到自己不得不依賴對手的幫助時，
他的自尊心可能會受到打擊。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Even though he is
your enemy, I still
believe it's important
that you treat him with
respect. Where is your honor?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
儘管他是你的敵人，但我認為尊重他依然很重要。
你的榮譽感在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Well, there's one
last thing I want to
know about you. It's the
most important question
in the world once you
think about it.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
好了，關於你，我還有最後一件事想知道。
一旦你仔細想想，這就是世界上最重要的問題。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
...
......
Do you enjoy life?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
...
......
你熱愛生活嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
I'm glad.
When you don't live
with zeal, it's easy to
forget your goals and your
purpose for living. Don't have
any? Then make some up.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
很好。
如果你不充滿熱情地生活，很容易忘記你的目標和生存的意義。
沒有目標嗎？那就去創造一些吧。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
I hope you always enjoy
life as much as you can.
As for me, I'm always happy
with my wine, women and song~
Mwah ah hah~!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
我希望你能儘可能享受人生。
至於我，只要有美酒、美女和歌聲，我就很快樂~
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
I understand.
People cannot be happy
all the time. Sometimes
it's easy to forget your
goals and purpose in life.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
我理解。
人不可能一直快樂。
有時候，很容易忘記人生的目標和意義。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
But you know what? If you
have just one dream, one goal
to strive towards, things shall get better. If you think you don't have dreams, look back to your past. What you remember may surprise you.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
但你知道嗎？如果你有一個夢想，一個值得奮鬥的目標，一切都會好起來的。
如果你覺得自己沒有夢想，那就回顧一下過去。你回憶起的往事可能會讓你驚訝。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
It's important to look forward,
but first you must find what is truly precious to you before you can define your happiness. That's why I think it's good to experience new things as well as reflect.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
向前看很重要，但首先你必須找到對你真正珍貴的東西，才能定義你的幸福。
所以我認為，體驗新事物和反思同樣重要。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Now, what's precious to me?
Three things, actually...
Wine. Women. And song!
Though, if I had to rank them,
women would top that list.
Mwah ah hah~!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
那麼，對我來說什麼是珍貴的呢？
其實是三樣東西...
美酒、美女和歌聲！
不過，如果非要排個名，美女可是排在第一位的。
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Well, I must say that I've
grown quite fond of you. Of
course, it helps that we have so much in common. Mwah ah hah~!
It was an honor to meet you~
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
嗯，我得說，我對你挺有好感的。
當然，這也得益於我們有這麼多共同點。Mwah ah hah~!
很高興認識你~

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh yes! Your next test
examiner is ^CE0000Sir Jore^000000, also
known as the Ghost of Al de Baran. Although he's always sick, he has great passion for his research.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
哦對了！你的下一位考官是^CE0000喬爾爵士^000000，
也被稱為艾爾帕蘭的幽靈。雖然他總是病懨懨的，但他對研究有著極大的熱情。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Alright, then.
Good luck in
Al de Baran~!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
好了，那麼。
祝你在艾爾帕蘭好運~!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
It pains me to say this,
but I do not think you're
worthy of holding my fragment
of the Sobbing Starlight. But
I am willing to give you
another chance~
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
說這話讓我很痛心，
但我覺得你不配持有我這塊星淚石碎片。
不過，我願意再給你一次機會~

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
You know, after talking with
you for a while, I now feel fairly comfortable with leaving you this piece of the Sobbing Starlight. Somehow, I think you're strong enough to get all the pieces.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
你知道嗎，和你聊了一會兒後，我現在覺得把這塊星淚石碎片交給你挺放心的。
不知為何，我覺得你足夠強大，能夠集齊所有碎片。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
I hope you will pass the rest of the test
and acquire the power.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
希望你能通過剩下的測試，並獲得那份力量。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh yes! Your next test
examiner is ^CE0000Sir Jore^000000, also
known as the Ghost of Al de Baran. Although he's always sick, he has great passion for his research.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
哦對了！你的下一位考官是^CE0000喬爾爵士^000000，
也被稱為艾爾帕蘭的幽靈。雖然他總是病懨懨的，但他對研究有著極大的熱情。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Alright, then.
Good luck in
Al de Baran~!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
好了，那麼。
祝你在艾爾帕蘭好運~!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
It pains me to say this,
but I do not think you're
worthy of holding my fragment
of the Sobbing Starlight. But
I am willing to give you
another chance~
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
說這話讓我很痛心，
但我覺得你不配持有我這塊星淚石碎片。
不過，我願意再給你一次機會~

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
I wonder...
Someone should have
passed Arian's test by now.
I can't wait to see who was
actually able to impress him...
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
我在想...
現在應該有人通過阿里安的測試了吧。
我迫不及待想看看，究竟是誰能讓他印象深刻...

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Mwah ah hah~!
I couldn't be happier!
What more do I need?
Gourmet food, fine wine,
nubile women...!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
Mwah ah hah~!
我再快樂不過了！
我還需要什麼？
美食、美酒、美女...!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
I'm sorry, but 
no price can make
me change my mind.
You... You've failed.
I'm sorry, friend.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
很抱歉，
無論出多少錢，我都不會改變主意。
你...你失敗了。
抱歉，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh~! It's you!
It has been a while since
we last conversed. Now that
you've accessed the power
behind the Sobbing Starlight,
do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
哦~！是你啊！
我們好久沒聊過了。
既然你已經獲得了星淚石背後的力量，
感覺如何？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Ah, how great~!
Just remember that
power can be addictive.
Even if you don't agree,
it's still wise to avoid
greedy tendencies, yes?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
啊，真棒~！
不過要記住，
力量是會讓人上癮的。
即使你不認同，
保持克制、避免貪婪也是明智之舉，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Please make good use of
the power you have obtained.
I am counting on you to be
responsbile and to never lose
that smile on your face, okay?
Mwah ah hah~!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
請善用你獲得的力量。
我指望你能負責任，
並且永遠保持臉上的笑容，好嗎？
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Eh...?
That's quite a surprise.
Perhaps Metz didn't know
enough about it? Still, I'm
sorry to hear you don't like it.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
誒...？
真是令人驚訝。
也許梅茨對它的瞭解還不夠？
不過，聽到你不喜歡它，我還是很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
But in the end, keep in mind
that you must have learned some great lesson from this experience. Anyway, please do your best to use the power responsibly, okay?
Mwah ah hah~!
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
但歸根結底，請記住，
你肯定從這次經歷中學到了重要的教訓。
總之，請負責任地使用力量，好嗎？
Mwah ah hah~!

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Hm...?
Weren't you on
your way to find
^CE0000Sir Jore^000000 in Al de Baran?
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
嗯...？
你不是正要去艾爾帕蘭找^CE0000喬爾爵士^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Oh, having trouble
finding him, are you?
Well, he's fairly shy, but
I'm sure he's hiding some
place in that town.
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
哦，找不到他嗎？
嗯，他有點害羞，
但我確信他正躲在鎮上的某個地方。

scripts.text:
[Daewoon]
Ah, I feel so...
Satiated. The food was 
stupendous and the women
have been even more so.
Servants! Fan me please~
scripts.translation:
[大雲]
啊，我感覺好...
飽了。食物美味極了，
女人們更是如此。
僕人們！給我扇扇子~

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Uwah~!
Stop reading my
research monograph!
Put that back now!
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
哇~！
別讀我的研究手稿！
馬上放回去！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...

[Sir Jore]
...
......
...No!
Look what
you made me do!
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
...
......
...不！
看你把我逼成什麼樣了！

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
I've been fiddling
with this sample for
five hours. And now
it's ruined! ^333333*Sob*^000000
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
我花了五個小時擺弄這個樣本。
現在全毀了！^333333*嗚咽*^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
^333333*Sob*^000000
I came to this town
so I could focus on
my research without
any interruptions. So
why are you here?
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
^333333*嗚咽*^000000
我來這個城鎮是為了能專心研究，
不受打擾。那你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text: Daewoon sent me.
scripts.translation: 大雲派我來的。

scripts.text: Oops, sorry. Later~
scripts.translation: 哎呀，抱歉。回頭見~

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
O-oh!
That's right.
You're here to be
tested for the piece
of the Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
哦-哦！
對啊。
你是來接受星淚石碎片測試的。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
So...
Er. Then, what...
W-what's your name?
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
那麼...
呃。那麼，你...
你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text: {0}, thanks.

[Sir Jore]
N-nice to meet you.
My name is Jore. Just
a normal person who loves
research. S-sorry if I seem
a little nervous! I'm actually
quite... shy around people.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
幸...幸會。
我叫喬爾。只是一個熱愛研究的普通人。
抱歉...我看起來有點緊張！其實我...在人前很害羞。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Oh no...!
If you were able to
find me, there will be
others! When would I get
the time to do my research?!
N-no! I h-h-hate people!!
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
糟糕...！
既然你能找到我，肯定還會有別人！
我什麼時候才能專心做研究啊？！
不...不！我...我討厭人類！！

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Still, I did promise
M-M-Metz and he is my
friend. So I must accept
some guests. Even if hundreds
of them knock on my door...
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
不過，我答應過梅茨，他是我的朋友。
所以我必須接待一些客人。
哪怕有幾百個人來敲門...

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
But first of all,
I'm going to need
a new research sample.
I think it's only fair that
you get it for me since you
made me ruin the last one.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
但首先，
我需要一個新的研究樣本。
既然你弄壞了上一個，
我覺得讓你去弄一個新的才公平。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
N-now, d-don't worry.
The items are actually
quite easy to get. It's
five hours part that's
hard. Now, let's see...
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
現...現在，別擔心。
這些材料其實很容易獲取。
難的是那五個小時。讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Just bring me
10 Empty Test Tubes,
10 Green Herbs and
2 Yggdrasil Leafs.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
請給我帶來
10個空試管，
10株綠色藥草和
2片天地樹葉子。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
You see, l-lately I've
been studying Biology. 
I think the secret to life
can be found in the Leaf of
Yggdrasil. They can be used
to revive the dead, after all.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
你看，最近我
一直在研究生物學。
我覺得生命的秘密
就藏在天地樹葉子中。
畢竟，它們可以用來復活死者。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Oh, and make sure to
bring those things to me
me before I go to bed at
precisely 10:00 PM PST.
I do have a regular sleeping
schedule, you know.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
哦，還有，記得在
晚上10點整我睡覺之前
把這些東西帶給我。
你知道的，我有固定的作息。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
I spent five hours
observing the changes
in that research sample.
All of that hard work lost!
^333333*Wah~!*^000000
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
我花了五個小時
觀察那個研究樣本的變化。
所有的辛苦都白費了！
^333333*哇~！*^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Ah! Th-thank you for
bringing what I need.
Now I can continue my
research. Oh, and see if
you're worthy of obtaining
the Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
啊！謝...謝謝你
帶來了需要的東西。
現在我可以繼續研究了。
哦，順便看看你是否
有資格獲得星淚石。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Now, for your assignment.
Have you ever heard about
the ^CE3131Stone of Sage^000000? Rumors about
it have been spreading around, but no one has confirmed the truth about it, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
現在，關於你的任務。
你聽說過^CE3131賢者之石^000000嗎？
關於它的傳聞四處流傳，
但沒人證實過真相，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Although I have no clue
what the Stone of S-S-age
may actually be, I have a gut
feeling that I need it to bring
my Biology research to the next step. This is how you'll help me.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
雖然我不知道賢者之石
到底是什麼，但我有一種直覺，
我需要它來讓我的生物學研究
更進一步。這就是你需要幫我的地方。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
I need you to investigate
this Stone of Sage by finding
a father and daughter who were
famous for being great Alchemists. They vanished deep into a forest, but I believe they know something.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
我需要你調查這塊賢者之石，
去找一對著名的鍊金術士父女。
他們消失在了森林深處，
但我相信他們知道些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Please bring m-me
10 Empty Test Tube,
10 Green Herb and
2 Leaf of Yggdrasil
so that I can make a
new research sample.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
請給我帶來
10個空試管，
10株綠色藥草和
2片天地樹葉子，
這樣我才能製作新的研究樣本。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
I want you to find two
Alchemists, a father and
daughter, who have gone into
seclusion deep in some forest
so that I can learn more about
the Stone of Sage.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
我要你找到兩位鍊金術士，
一對父女，他們隱居在森林深處，
這樣我才能瞭解更多關於賢者之石的事。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Of course, this will
possibly further my
research, but it's also
how I'll judge whether or
not you're qualified for my
piece of the Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
當然，這可能會
推進我的研究，
但這也是我判斷你是否
有資格獲得星淚石碎片的方式。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
The mystery of life.
The desire to discover its
secrets drives me through
all the research and sacrifice.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
生命的奧秘。
想要揭開其秘密的渴望
驅使我進行所有的研究和犧牲。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
I-I'm not that confident in
my abilities, but I do believe that everything in this world is created by certain rules. Still, would I be punished by God for trying to create life he did not intend?
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
我...我對自己的能力並不自信，
但我相信這個世界的一切都是由特定的規則創造的。
不過，如果我試圖創造上帝未曾打算的生命，我會受到懲罰嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
But I can't stop now.
One of these days, someone
will reveal the secret of life.
Why not me? That knowledge
would make humans greater
than any other race...
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
但我現在不能停下。
總有一天，有人會揭示生命的秘密。
為什麼不能是我？
那種知識會讓人類超越其他任何種族...

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Ah, you've returned.
So, did you learn what
exactly is the Stone of Sage?
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
啊，你回來了。
那麼，你弄清楚賢者之石
到底是什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I'm not sure,
but I was told that it's
red and can cure people.
But it might be something
we're already familiar with.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，我不太確定，
但有人告訴我它是紅色的，
而且能治療人。
不過它可能只是
我們熟悉的東西。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
That's all...?
Maybe it was nothing
but a rumor after all.
A-anyway, please tell me
what you think it might be.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
就這些...？
也許那只是
一個謠言罷了。
不...不管怎樣，請告訴我
你覺得那可能是什麼。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
What...! Huh.
Perhaps I should just
forget about the Stone of
Sage and just research.
Still, I'm so ashamed of
relying on a rumor...
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
什...！啊。
也許我應該
忘掉賢者之石，
專心做研究。
但我還是很羞愧，
竟然依賴一個謠言...

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Thank you very much
for helping me. Now I can
go back to my studies and
hope that nobody bothers me.
But that'll never happen.
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
非常感謝你的幫助。
現在我可以回去研究，
希望沒人打擾我。
但這永遠不會發生。
^333333*嘆氣...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
W-well, you've earned this
piece of the Sobbing Starlight.
For the next piece, you must visit ^0063FFLady Jesqurienne^000000 in Geffen, the city of magic. Since she travels often, she's probably in the Inn.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
那...那麼，你贏得了
這塊星淚石碎片。
下一塊碎片，你需要去吉芬，
那座魔法之城，拜訪^0063FF傑斯庫莉恩女士^000000。
因為她經常旅行，所以可能在旅店內。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
O-o-okay then.
Good luck getting
all the pieces of 
Sobbing Starlight,
{0}. Farewell~
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
好...好吧。
祝你在收集星淚石碎片時
好運，{0}。再見~

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Err...?
I don't think
I quite understood
you. What did you say?
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
呃...？
我覺得我
沒太聽懂。
你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Now you must visit
^0063FFLady Jesqurienne^000000 in
Geffen. Good luck
passing her test.
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
現在你必須去吉芬，
拜訪^0063FF傑斯庫莉恩女士^000000。
祝你在她的測試中
好運。

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
H-how is this supposed
to work? Like this? No!
No, that's not right!
Think, Jore, think...
What's the answer?!
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
這...這該怎麼運作？
像這樣嗎？不！
不對，不是這樣！
想想，喬爾，想想...
答案是什麼？！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a tense man
holding test tubes between
his fingers, standing in a pile
of books. He seems to be in
agony for some reason.
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現一名神情緊繃的男子，
手指間夾著試管，站在書堆之中。
不知為何，他似乎正飽受痛苦。

scripts.text: Speak to him.
scripts.translation: 對話

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me...

^3355FFToo preoccupied with
his thoughts, this strange
man is unable to hear you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這個奇怪的男子
太專注于思考，
聽不見你的話。^000000

scripts.text: Try again.
scripts.translation: 再試一次

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[{0}]
EXCUSE ME!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下！

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
...!
Oh, h-h-hello.
Sorry, but I'm kind of
busy right now. Yes, yes,
would you come back at
precisely 5:00 PM PST?
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
...！
哦，你...你好。
抱歉，我現在有點忙。
是的，是的，
你能在下午5點整
再來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
Let's see...
Now if I recalibrated
the faust exhaust, then
the bioneutron analyzer
would need to be adjusted
for cytoplasmic balance...
scripts.translation:
[喬爾爵士]
讓我看看...
如果我重新校準了
排氣裝置，
那麼生物中子分析儀
就需要調整
細胞質平衡...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to leave
him alone and let him
continue mumbling to
himself and playing
with his test tubes.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你決定讓他一個人待著，
讓他繼續自言自語
並擺弄他的試管。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou decide to leave
him alone and let him
continue mumbling to
himself and playing
with his test tubes.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你決定讓他一個人待著，
讓他繼續自言自語
並擺弄他的試管。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sir Jore]
...z...z...Z

[Piru Piru]
Oh, I'm sooo tired~
But we can't sleep yet.
*Sob* Master, can't we
just call it a day already?
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
啊，我好累~
但我們還不能睡。
*抽泣* 師父，我們
能不能今天就結束？

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Everyday we study and
take notes and test and
experiment and record
results and... Horrible!
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
每天我們都在學習、
做筆記、測試、
實驗、記錄結果...太可怕了！

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
....Zzz...Zzz...
Zzz....Zzz......
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
...Zzz...Zzz...
Zzz....Zzz......

scripts.text: What do you do in here?
scripts.translation: 你們在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: About vanished Alchemists
scripts.translation: 關於失蹤的鍊金術士

scripts.text: What is the Stone of Sage?
scripts.translation: 什麼是賢者之石？

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
My master, Sir Jore,
is researching a way to
create artificial life! Still,
it's not easy and we haven't
accomplished anything yet...
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
我的師父，喬爾爵士，
正在研究創造人工生命的方法！
不過，這並不容易，
我們目前還沒有取得任何成果...

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
It doesn't help that my
master spends all of his
time on research. He hasn't
been taking care of himself
and is losing a lot of weight.
I'm really worried about him.
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
更糟糕的是，
師父把所有時間都花在了研究上。
他完全不顧自己的身體，
體重掉得很厲害。
我真的很擔心他。

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Oh, the father and daughter
who were both Alchemists, right? Did you know they vanished because they invented the monster potion summoning skill?
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
哦，你是說那對
都是鍊金術士的父女吧？
你知道他們是因為
發明了召喚魔物的藥劑技能
才失蹤的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Their discovery caused
such great hysteria in the
scientific community. In the
end they had no choice but
to live in seclusion deep
in the ^CE3131forest to the south^000000.
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
他們的發現
在科學界引起了巨大的恐慌。
最終，他們別無選擇，
只能隱居在^CE3131南方的森林深處^000000。

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
They devoted their lives
to their research, just like
my master. If he makes a major
breakthrough, we'll have to
disappear like they did...
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
他們像我的師父一樣，
將生命奉獻給了研究。
如果師父取得了重大突破，
我們就得像他們一樣
消失得無影無蹤了...

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Hmm? Well, I wouldn't
know anything about that.
In fact, I'm always staying
in this lab, so I never hear
any rumors or news outside.
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
嗯？
關於那個，我什麼都不知道。
事實上，我一直待在這個實驗室裡，
所以從來沒聽說過
外面的傳聞或新聞。

scripts.text: What do you do in here?
scripts.translation: 你們在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
My master, Sir Jore,
is researching a way to
create artificial life! Still,
it's not easy and we haven't
accomplished anything yet...
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
我的師父，喬爾爵士，
正在研究創造人工生命的方法！
不過，這並不容易，
我們目前還沒有取得任何成果...

time on research. He hasn't
