I'm really worried about him.
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
更糟糕的是，
師父把所有時間都花在了研究上。
他完全不顧自己的身體，
體重掉得很厲害。
我真的很擔心他。

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Although my master and I are the only ones who use this lab, we do have a set working schedule. We work from 10 AM to 5 PM and have our free time from 5 PM to 10 PM, which is when Master goes to bed.
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
雖然只有我和師父
使用這個實驗室，
但我們還是有固定的工作日程的。
我們從上午10點工作到下午5點，
下午5點到晚上10點是休息時間，
師父通常在這個時候睡覺。

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Of course, Master
is happy if he can
just do more research.
In any case, please visit
us after 5 PM if you have
any business with us.
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
當然，如果師父能
繼續做研究，他會很高興。
總之，如果您有事情要找我們，
請在下午5點之後再來。

scripts.text: Wake her up
scripts.translation: 叫醒她

scripts.text: Leave her sleep
scripts.translation: 讓她繼續睡

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Wh-wha...?
Why do you gotta
wake me up? Come back
after 10:00 AM tomorrow, kay?
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
什...什麼...？
為什麼要叫醒我？
明天上午10點以後再來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Piru Piru]
Zzzz.....Zzzzz...
scripts.translation:
[皮魯皮魯]
Zzzz.....Zzzzz...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou catch a glimpse
of a girl heading directly
into a deep forest. You decide
to follow her and see if you can
learn more.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你瞥見一個女孩
徑直走進了森林深處。
你決定跟著她，
看看能否瞭解更多。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou catch a glimpse
of a girl heading directly
into a deep forest. You decide
to follow her and see if you can
learn more.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你瞥見一個女孩
徑直走進了森林深處。
你決定跟著她，
看看能否瞭解更多。^000000

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
La la la~
La la la~
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
啦啦啦~
啦啦啦~

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
Hmmm...?
The Stone of Sage...
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
嗯...？
賢者之石...

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Hello darling.
What did you do today?
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
你好，親愛的。
你今天做了什麼？

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Oh...!
You scared us!
Roaring like some
animal! What do you
think you were doing?
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
噢...！
你嚇到我們了！
像野獸一樣咆哮！
你在幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Sometimes I miss
being an alchemist.
But then again, a man
of my brilliance and genius
would put all those newbie
scientists to shame~
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
有時候我會懷念
當鍊金術士的日子。
不過話說回來，
像我這樣才華橫溢的天才，
肯定會讓那些新手
科學家自愧不如~

scripts.text: [Gordon]
scripts.translation: [戈登]

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
I played Hide-and-Seek
with a white bear and a
blue bear, father.
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
我和一隻白熊
還有一隻藍熊
玩了捉迷藏，爸爸。

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Darling...
Aren't you tired
of playing with the
animals? We've lived
in this forest for so long...
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
親愛的...
你不覺得
和動物玩膩了嗎？
我們在這片森林裡
已經住很久了...

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
Don't worry father, I understand. For now, this is the only place where we can relax and live inpeace. I think we deserve to rest after accomplishing our goals...
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
別擔心，爸爸，我懂。
至少現在，這裡是
我們唯一能放鬆
和平生活的地方。
我想在達成目標後，
我們值得休息一下...

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Thank you, Pluer.
I have no regrets about
our work, but sometimes
I do wish for a more
carefree life for you...
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
謝謝你，普勒爾。
我對我們的工作
沒有遺憾，但有時候
我也希望能讓你
過上更輕鬆的生活...

scripts.text: Roar~!
Excuse me.
scripts.translation: 打擾一下

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
No no no!
Summon Flora!
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
不不不！
生物調撥！

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Great Schott!
Summon... Marine Sphere!
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
偉大的肖特！
生物調撥...氣泡蟲！

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Eh?! Don't you know
how dangerous this place
is? What are you doing
here in the middle of
this forest?
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
咦？！你不知道
這裡有多危險嗎？
你在這森林深處
做什麼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I think
I've been looking for
you. I've been sent on
an errand to find these
two famous Alchemists.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，我一直在
找你們。我受命
尋找這兩位
著名的鍊金術士。

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Mm...?
Well, we're retired
now, but I suppose it'd
do no harm if you had
something to ask us...
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
嗯...？
好吧，我們現在
已經退休了，但如果你
有什麼想問的，
問我們也無妨...

scripts.text: Ask about Stone of Sage
scripts.translation: 詢問賢者之石

scripts.text: Ask about Alchemy
scripts.translation: 詢問融合試驗

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Stone of Sage?
Huh. To be honest,
I don't know anything
about it at all. I guess
its existence is pretty
much just a rumor, really.
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
賢者之石？
嗯。說實話，
我對此一無所知。
我想它的存在
基本上只是個傳說。

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
All I've heard is that
the Stone of Sage might
be a catylst to transmute
materials into gold. If it
really existed, it would be
the ultimate alchemic item.
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
我只聽說賢者之石
可能是將材料
轉化為金的催化劑。
如果它真的存在，
那將是終極的
鍊金物品。

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
However, I've also heard
it's red, can make humans
immortal and can cure any
sort of disease or ailment.
Just where do these rumors
come from? It's crazy...
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
不過，我也聽說
它是紅色的，能讓人
長生不老，還能治癒
任何疾病。
這些傳聞是從哪來的？
太瘋狂了...

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Now, I even hear that some
people are working on trying
to create the stone themselves.
If they succeed, it'll have a huge effect on the entire world!
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
現在，我甚至聽說
有些人正在嘗試
自己製造這塊石頭。
如果他們成功了，
將對整個世界
產生巨大影響！

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
I'm sorry that you've gone
through the trouble of finding
us for this kind of information. We're retired after all, so we
may be out of the loop.
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
很抱歉你費心
來找我們打聽這些。
畢竟我們已經退休了，
可能訊息不太靈通。

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
Although we're retired, we
would be much interested in
knowing if someone does manage
to create such a stone. If that
happens, would you tell us?
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
雖然我們退休了，
但如果有人真的
製造出了這樣的石頭，
我們還是很想知道的。
如果發生了這樣的事，
你會告訴我們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Now let me guide you
on a safe path back out
of this maze. I've lived here
quite a while, so I can find
the exit with my eyes closed.
Farewell, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
現在讓我指引你
一條安全的路離開這個迷宮。
我在這裡住了很久了，
閉著眼睛都能找到出口。
再見了，冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
I hope you understand that
my father and I devoted and sacrificed so much for our work. Finally, we discovered a way to summon monsters using potions.
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
我希望你能理解，
我和我父親為我們的工作
付出了巨大的心血和犧牲。
最終，我們發現了
一種使用藥水召喚魔物的方法。

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
However, too many Alchemists
hounded us for our information
once we announced the results
of our research. It was more
than we could handle...
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
然而，當我們公佈
研究成果後，
太多的鍊金術士
為了獲取資訊而糾纏我們。
這超出了我們的承受能力...

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
I'm sorry, but if you have any
questions about Alchemy, there
are many qualified researchers and practitioners out there. We came to this forest to find peace...
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
很抱歉，如果你對融合試驗
有任何問題，
外面有很多合格的研究員
和從業者。我們來到這片森林
是為了尋找平靜...

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Hah hah hah~
Did you forget
what you were
going to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
哈哈~
你忘了
你要問什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually, I think
I've been looking for
you. I've been sent on
an errand to find these
two famous Alchemists.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實，我一直在
找你們。我受命
尋找這兩位
著名的鍊金術士。

問我們也無妨...

[戈登]
很抱歉你費心
來找我們打聽這些。
畢竟我們已經退休了，
可能訊息不太靈通。

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
Although we're retired, we
would be much interested in
knowing if someone does manage
to create such a stone. If that
happens, would you tell us?
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
雖然我們退休了，
但如果有人真的
製造出了這樣的石頭，
我們還是很想知道的。
如果發生了這樣的事，
你會告訴我們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Now let me guide you
on a safe path back out
of this maze. I've lived here
quite a while, so I can find
the exit with my eyes closed.
Farewell, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
現在讓我指引你
一條安全的路離開這個迷宮。
我在這裡住了很久了，
閉著眼睛都能找到出口。
再見了，冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
I hope you understand that
my father and I devoted and sacrificed so much for our work. Finally, we discovered a way to summon monsters using potions.
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
我希望你能理解，
我和我父親為我們的工作
付出了巨大的心血和犧牲。
最終，我們發現了
一種使用藥水召喚魔物的方法。

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
However, too many Alchemists
hounded us for our information
once we announced the results
of our research. It was more
than we could handle...
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
然而，當我們公佈
研究成果後，
太多的鍊金術士
為了獲取資訊而糾纏我們。
這超出了我們的承受能力...

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
I'm sorry, but if you have any
questions about Alchemy, there
are many qualified researchers and practitioners out there. We came to this forest to find peace...
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
很抱歉，如果你對融合試驗
有任何問題，
外面有很多合格的研究員
和從業者。我們來到這片森林
是為了尋找平靜...

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Hah hah hah~
Did you forget
what you were
going to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
哈哈~
你忘了
你要問什麼了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pleur]
D...
D...Daddy!!
scripts.translation:
[普勒爾]
爸...
爸...爸爸！！

scripts.text:
[Gordon]
Heh heh~
Am I being
too arrogant?
scripts.translation:
[戈登]
嘿嘿~
我是不是
太傲慢了？

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Bartender~?
Give me another drink.
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
調酒師~？
再給我來一杯。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
It amuses me that
you think that you'd
stand a chance against
me in a Quiz Challenge.
Ho ho ho ho ho~!
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
你覺得你能在問答挑戰中
贏過我，
這讓我覺得很有趣。
呵呵呵呵呵~！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Bwahahahaha!
You should have known
from the beginning that you
never had a chance! Of course,
I did, but you know, I guess you had to learn for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
你一開始就該知道
你根本沒有機會！當然，
我有機會，但你知道，
我想你得自己體會一下。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
What...?
I... I...
I don't b-believe it.
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
什...？
我...我...
我...我不相信。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ooooh...
My head...
Oh...! It's you...!
So did you find Dearles?
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
噢...
我的頭...
噢...！是你...！
那麼，你找到迪爾萊斯了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
OoOooOhh~
Sooooo dizzy.
Maybe I drank
too much again~
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
噢噢噢~
好...好暈。
也許我又
喝太多了~

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ahhhhhh~
Hm? Why hello there,
you fine speciman of a man~
I'm Jesqurienne. You've heard
of me, haven't you? Aren't you surprised to see me?
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
啊~
嗯？你好呀，
你這位優秀的男士~
我是傑斯庫莉恩。你聽說過
我，對吧？見到我是不是很驚訝？

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ahhhhhh~
Hm? Why hello there,
you precious, adorable girl~
I'm Jesqurienne. You've heard
of me, haven't you? Aren't you surprised to see me?
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
啊~
嗯？你好呀，
你這位可愛迷人的女孩~
我是傑斯庫莉恩。你聽說過
我，對吧？見到我是不是很驚訝？

scripts.text: I've never heard of you.
scripts.translation: 我從未聽說過你。

scripts.text: Oh gosh, it's Jesqurienne!
scripts.translation: 天哪，是傑斯庫莉恩！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ho ho ho~!
Surely you
must be joking~
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
呵呵呵~！
你肯定
在開玩笑吧~

scripts.text: You got me, you got me.
scripts.translation: 你贏了，你贏了。

scripts.text: Nope. Doesn't ring a bell.
scripts.translation: 不。沒聽說過。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ohohohohoho~!
I knew it! I knew it!
Then again, there's little
that a famous genius like
myself does ^333333not^000000 know!
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
哦呵呵呵呵呵~！
我就知道！我就知道！
不過話說回來，像我這樣
舉世聞名的天才，
^333333不知道^000000的事情可不多呢！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Gah--!
My glass is
already empty?
Bartender, another
drink please~
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
哎呀——！
我的杯子
已經空了？
調酒師，再來
一杯吧~

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
...
......
Now I understand.
You've been living
under a rock for all
this time, haven't you?
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
...
......
現在我明白了。
你一直
住在石頭底下，
對吧？

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
But I guess someone
as simple minded as you
wouldn't recognize a famous,
brilliant genius once you
saw her, wouldn't you?
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
不過我想，像你這樣
頭腦簡單的人，
就算見到了著名的
天才，
也不一定能認出來，
不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ohohohohoho~!
I knew it! I knew it!
Then again, there's little
that a famous genius like
myself does ^333333not^000000 know!
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
哦呵呵呵呵呵~！
我就知道！我就知道！
不過話說回來，像我這樣
舉世聞名的天才，
^333333不知道^000000的事情可不多呢！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Gah--!
My glass is
already empty?
Bartender, another
drink please~
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
哎呀——！
我的杯子
已經空了？
調酒師，再來
一杯吧~

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Anyway, I'm so proud
of my supreme intelligence!
I may be somewhat obsessive
about studying, but that's just another reason to admire me~
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
總之，我為自己
超凡的智慧感到自豪！
我可能對研究有點
痴迷，但這正是
值得你崇拜我的理由~

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
The Wizard and Sage
exams? No problem~
Even the Alchemist test
was fairly simple. So far
I haven't met anyone
smarter than me~
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
巫師和賢者的
考試？小菜一碟~
連鍊金術士的
測試也相當簡單。到目前為止，
我還沒遇到過
比我更聰明的人~

scripts.text: ^333333Stuck-up chick.^000000
Take it easy on the drinks...
scripts.translation: 少喝點酒吧...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
What...?
What did you say?
No one has ever
said anything like
that to me before!
H-how dare you...
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
什...？
你說什麼？
從來沒有人
對我說過
這種話！
你...你怎麼敢...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Prove that you can
hold a candle to my
superior intellect and
I'll be willing to accept
your little insult! It's time
for a Quiz Challenge!
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
證明你的智慧
能與我相提並論，
我就願意接受
你的小小侮辱！
是時候進行
問答挑戰了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Quiz... Challenge?
Like a trivia game?
But who's going to
ask us the questions?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
問答...挑戰？
就像知識問答遊戲？
但是誰
來出題呢？

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Did someone say
''Quiz Challenge?''
I believe I can be
of assistance.
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
有人提到
“問答挑戰”嗎？
我想我可以
幫上忙。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Professor Aaron?
Ho ho~ If he's asking
the questions, it looks
like your chances of
beating me are zero!
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
亞倫智者？
呵呵~ 如果由他
出題，
看來你打敗我的
機率是零了！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ho ho ho~
Plenty of people have
told me not to drink so
much. But once I start
I can't stop. I love to
drink that much!
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
呵呵呵~
很多人
都勸我少喝點。但一旦開始
我就停不下來。我這麼
愛喝酒！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
And...
Sometimes I'd rather
look at the world through
these hazy eyes. See things
the way I want to see them...
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
而且...
有時候我寧願
透過這朦朧的雙眼
看世界。以我
想要的方式看...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Professor Aaron
is waiting for you
to ask him to begin.
And I'm waiting for the
moment when you realize
you have no hope of winning!
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
亞倫智者
正等著你
邀請他開始。
而我在等待
你意識到
自己毫無勝算的那一刻！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
I'd insult you if it weren't for the fact that you embarassed yourself enough during the Quiz Challenge. As a matter of fact, I'll even forgive you for wounding my pride earlier.
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
要不是你在問答挑戰中
已經出夠了醜，
我早就侮辱你了。事實上，
我甚至原諒你
之前傷害了我的自尊。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Can you believe it?
Even drunk I can beat
you in a test of intelligence!
Bwahaha! I can't believe how
simple minded you are...!
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
你能相信嗎？
即使喝醉了，
我也可以在智力測試中
打敗你！
哇哈哈！我真不敢相信
你有多笨...

scripts.text: I can't let you win!
scripts.translation: 我不能讓你贏！

scripts.text: Darn it...
scripts.translation: 該死...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
You're a slow learner,
aren't you? Well, I welcome
your ''challenge'' anytime!
Bwah hah hah hah hah~!
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
你學得真慢啊，不是嗎？
不過，我隨時歡迎你的“挑戰”！
哇哈哈哈哈哈~！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Just now you realize
how pitiful your intellect
is compared to mine? Ho ho ho!
There's hope for every fool!
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
現在你才意識到，
你的智力與我相比有多可憐嗎？
呵呵呵！
每個傻瓜都有希望！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
I lost...
M-maybe you were right.
I am arrogant after all...
I should stop drinking so
much. Travel around and
broaden my knowledge...
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
我輸了...
也許...也許你是對的。
我終究還是太傲慢了...
我應該少喝點酒，
多出去走走，
開闊一下眼界...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
You're the only
one who has been
able to beat me in
a battle of minds.
W-who are you...?
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
你是唯一
能在智力對決中
打敗我的人。
你...你是誰...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
{0}...
I will remember that.
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
{0}...
我會記住這個名字的。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Here...
My old friend, Metz, told
me to give this to someone
who is worthy. I was going
to keep it, but I suppose
you're its true owner...
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
拿著...
我的老朋友梅茨
讓我把這個交給
一個值得的人。
我本來打算自己留著的，
但我想，你才是它真正的主人...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
If you want to know more about the Sobbing Starlight, find a man named ^3131CEDearles^000000. It may be hard to find him since he wanders from place to place, but it might help to know that he loves gambling...
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
如果你想知道更多關於星淚石的事，
去找一個叫^3131CEDearles^000000的人。
他到處流浪，可能很難找到，
但如果你知道他喜歡賭博，
或許會有幫助...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Good luck finding
Dearles. I'm taking
this loss pretty badly,
so I think I'll stay here
and have another drink.
Farewell, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
祝你好運找到迪爾萊斯。
這次失敗讓我很難受，
我想我會留在這裡再喝一杯。
再見，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Hmm...
He's addicted to
gambling, so maybe you
can find him some place
where you can do that...
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
嗯...
他沉迷於賭博，
所以也許你可以在
那些能賭博的地方找到他...

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Alright, before
we begin, let me
tell you the rules...
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
好吧，
在開始之前，
讓我告訴你規則...

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
1. Which NPC is
not relevant to the
Blacksmith Job Quest?
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
1. 哪個NPC與鐵匠轉職任務無關？

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
1. Which item is not
relevant to the creation
of a Counteragent?
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
1. 哪個物品與製作反物質無關？

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
1. Choose the
monster that is
a different size
than the others.
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
1. 選出與其他魔物體型不同的那一個。

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
[Jesqurienne]
Heh heh...
The first question
is always too easy!
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
[傑斯庫莉恩]
嘿嘿...
第一題總是太簡單了！

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
[Jesqurienne]
Huh...?
How can I not know
the answer to this?!
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
[傑斯庫莉恩]
咦...？
我怎麼會不知道這道題的答案？！

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Goodness...!
Either these beer
goggles are on too tight,
or you're the most gorgeous
woman I've seen in my life!
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
天哪...！
要麼是我這副防風皮革眼鏡戴得太緊了，
要麼你就是我這輩子見過最美麗的女人！

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
I'm going to give you
ten multiple choice questions.
Since this is an impromptu
exhibition bout, I'm going to
use questions that I use
in teaching my class.
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
我會給你十道選擇題。
既然這是一場即興的展示賽，
我會使用我在課堂上
常用的題目。

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
Alright...
I'm almost finished
compiling the questions.
We're ready to go when
you're ready to begin!
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
好了...
我快把題目整理好了。
當你準備好開始時，
我們就開始吧！

scripts.translation: 拜蘇利斯特

scripts.translation: 維克貝恩

scripts.translation: 卡勒波迪藥水

scripts.translation:

呵呵...

scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
咦...？
我怎麼會不知道這道題的答案呢？！

[Aaron]
2. Choose the skill
related to the Priest's
B.S. Sacramenti from the

scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
2. 從列表中選出與牧師技能“聖餐”相關的技能。

scripts.translation: 沉默之術

scripts.translation: 格洛麗亞

scripts.translation: 恢復

2. Choose the material that

scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
2. 選出與製作白色纖細藥水無關的材料。

scripts.translation: 藥缽

scripts.translation: 魔女之星沙

[Aaron]
2. Choose the item that is

[亞倫]
2. 選出鐵匠製作短劍所必需的物品。

scripts.translation: 鋯石

scripts.translation: 黃玉

scripts.text: Cursed Ruby
scripts.translation: 詛咒紅寶石

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Ho ho ho ho~!
I know the answer.
Any fool should know
this. But do you?
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
呵呵呵~！
我知道答案。
傻瓜都知道這個。但你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Oh...
I knew the answer
to this just yesterday!
Why can't I think of it now?!
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
噢...
我昨天還知道這道題的答案呢！
為什麼現在想不起來了？！

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
3. Choose the
property that is
unrelated to the
Mage's Bolt type skills.
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
3. 選出與魔法師“箭矢”類技能無關的屬性。

scripts.translation: 水

scripts.text: Earth
scripts.translation: 地

scripts.text: Fire
scripts.translation: 解僱

scripts.text: Wind
scripts.translation: 風

scripts.text:
[Aaron]
3. What is the
Bunny Band's DEF
and its added ability?
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
3. 兔耳髮圈的防禦力是多少？
它有什麼附加效果？

3. Choose the prefix or

trying to keep up.

[傑斯庫莉恩]

想要追上我肯定很讓人沮喪吧。

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]

scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
嗯...？
你作弊了？！
你的分數竟然和我一樣，
這絕對不可能！

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
I don't understand.
You have a higher sco--
I don't-- How can yo--
Why is this happening?
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]

我不...你怎麼...--
為什麼會這樣？

how your score is

{0}:
{1} points!

{0} points!

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Bwahahaha!
I win! I knew it!
Ho ho ho ho ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
哇哈哈哈！
我贏了！我就知道！
呵呵呵呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
Tied?!

I'll admit, you're much
smarter than I thought...
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
打平？！
好吧，我有點驚訝。
我承認，你比我
想像中聰明多了...

scripts.text:
[Jesqurienne]
No...!
I can't...
Believe this...
scripts.translation:
[傑斯庫莉恩]
不...！
我不...
敢相信...

scripts.text:

for playing!

[Aaron]

take it easy on the
alcohol. I do have classes

還要上課...

[Aaron]
Ah, yes. Your
sense of style, your
magnificent body. Everything
about you is beautiful! Not just that, but you're also intelligent!
scripts.translation:
[亞倫]
啊，是的。你的品味，你那完美的身材。你的一切都那麼迷人！不僅如此，你還很有智慧！

[Aaron]

classes, but I'm also
a Quiz Challenge moderater
master in my spare time~
You're truly a jewel...

[亞倫]
我可是很清楚的！
我不僅教書，
業餘時間還是問答挑戰的
主持人兼大師~
你真是顆瑰寶...

not again! When's
my lucky streak
gonna start?

[迪爾萊斯]

該死，

什麼時候才能開始？

[Dearles]

bring the money?

[迪爾萊斯]

you come during the night.

''tomorrow night,'' I mean,
come and talk to me at nighttime! Don't you know anything about shady dealings?! Pfft! Adventurers...

[迪爾萊斯]

“明天晚上”，
意思是晚上來找我！

Alright! I want you to
bring me a bunch of items!
Yeah, I know, you're a real
pro at this, but let me set
you straight before you blow
this off as a piece of cake...
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
好吧！我要你
給我帶一堆東西！
沒錯，我知道
你很擅長這個，
但在我把它當成
小蛋糕之前，
讓我先給你講講規矩...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Ah, so is this
the stuff you brought?
Lemme take a look-see...
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
啊，這就是
你帶來的東西？
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey, you gotta
finish Part Two of
my test. I'm gonna send
you to Lamadin now...
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
嘿，你得
完成我測試的
第二部分。我現在
要派你去拉馬丁那裡...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
You failed Part Two,
the rhythm portion of
my freakin' test?! If you
wanna try again, you're
welcome to another chance...
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
你竟然沒通過
我測試的第二部分，
節奏部分？！
如果你想再試一次，
我允許你再給一次機會...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Alright, Lamadin
tells me you passed.
Not the best performance,
but it's good enough.
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
好吧，拉馬丁
告訴我你通過了。
表現不算最好，
但足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Lamadin tells me
you passed. Since you
did so good, I'm gonna
give you ^333333some^000000 of your money
back. Not all, but most of it.
Isn't that reward enough?
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
拉馬丁告訴我
你通過了。既然你
表現這麼好，我會
還給你^333333一些^000000錢。
不是全部，但大部分。
這個獎勵還不夠嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Whaaaaaaaaaat are
you doing back here?
Fine, since we know each
other, I'm borrowing some
cash. You know, for old
time's sake. ^FF0000Yoink!^000000
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
哇啊啊啊
你回這裡幹什麼？
好吧，既然我們
認識，我借點
現金。你知道的，
為了舊情。^FF0000拿走！^000000

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Whaaaaaaaaaat are
you doing back here?
I got nothin' for you and
you obviously have nothing
for me! Now lemme gamble!
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
哇啊啊啊
你回這裡幹什麼？
我沒什麼給你的，
你顯然也沒東西給我！
現在讓我去賭博！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey, why are you
still talkin' to me?
You finished my test.
It's over. Not get outta
here before I jack some
more of your cash!
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
嘿，你為什麼
還跟我說話？
你完成了我的測試。
結束了。趁我
再搶你點錢之前
趕緊滾！

scripts.text: [Dearles]
scripts.translation: [迪爾萊斯]

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey, you've got that look
like you want something from
me. Hah! You are poor!
It also looks like you're low on cash~! Well, this is what guys like me to do to shameless
moochers like you!
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
嘿，你看起來
像是有事求我。
哈！你很窮！
看起來你現金也不多了~！
這就是像我這樣的人
對待像你這種
厚臉皮乞討者的方式！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey, you've got that look
like you want something from
me. It also looks like you got zeny to spare! I think I'll help myself and borrow some of your cash!
^FF0000Yoink!^000000
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
嘿，你看起來
像是有事求我。
看起來你還有富餘的Zeny！
我想我會
借點你的現金！
^FF0000拿走！^000000

scripts.text: Excuse me...
scripts.translation: 打擾一下...

scripts.text: Just pass by.
scripts.translation: 只是路過

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
What is it?!
I'm not in the mood
for chatting with complete
and total strangers, so
get to the point~!
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
什麼事？！
我可沒心情
跟完全陌生的傢伙
閒聊，所以
有話快說~！

scripts.text: Oh, nothing.
scripts.translation: 哦，沒什麼。

scripts.text: I'm here for Metz...?
scripts.translation: 我是來找梅茨的...？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Wha...? You bother
me and make lose this
game for nothing? For that,
I'll freakin' beat you to near
freakin' death! Bam bam bam!
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
什...？你打擾我
讓我白白輸掉這局？
為此，我非把你
揍個半死不可！
砰！砰！砰！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Oh. You're here for
the Sobbing Starlight, huh? If you wanna take my test, there's *ahem* a fee of 30,000 zeny. So take it or leave it, capish?
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
哦。你是來找
星淚石的，是吧？
如果你想參加我的測試，
有*咳*一筆30,000 Zeny的費用。
所以要麼接受，要麼走人，懂嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
I'll have nothing
to do with you if you
can't pay up. Just think
of the fee as a preliminary
for my test. You know, to
weed out the riffraff.
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
如果你付不起錢，
我就跟你沒關係了。
就把這筆費用當作
我測試的預付款吧。
你知道，為了
篩掉那些雜魚。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Crap...!
I'm almost broke!
But I gotta win all
my cash back! How can
I raise more money fast
without actually working...
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
該死...！
我快破產了！
但我必須
贏回我所有的錢！
怎麼才能在不動用
勞動力的情況下
快速搞到更多錢...

scripts.text: Here you are...
scripts.translation: 給你...

scripts.text: Not yet...
scripts.translation: 還沒...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Ummm.......
When I say 30,000 zeny,
I mean 30,000 zeny! I'll let
you off on account of you looking like you're not smart enough to know how to count. But pull this
on me again and I'll...!
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
嗯......
我說30,000 Zeny，
就是30,000 Zeny！
看在你看起來
不夠聰明，不知道
怎麼數數的份上，
我就放過你一次。
但如果你再敢
這樣對我...！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Ummm.......
Heh heh~
That's thirty grand,
alright! Okay, come back
to me tomorrow night and
we'll start your test...
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
嗯......
嘿嘿~
那是三萬塊，
沒錯！好吧，明天晚上
再來找我，
我們就開始你的測試...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Huh...?
Alright, but you
better hurry. I can
change my mind at
any time, you know!
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
嗯...？
好吧，但你
最好快點。
我隨時
都可能改變主意，
你知道的！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
You're wondering how
a guy like me is pals with
Metz, but that's none of your
business. I guess I gotta keep
this promise to him, so when
you're ready, say the word.
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
你在想像我這樣的
傢伙怎麼跟梅茨
是朋友，但這
不是你的事。
我想我得
遵守對他的承諾，
所以當你準備好了，
說一聲就行。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
I'm not gonna give you an
exact list of items I want. Oh
no, what you gotta do is bring
me artsy crafts. This test is
gonna judge your appreciation
for... Craftsmanship~
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
我不會給你
一份確切的物品清單。
哦不，你要做的是
給我帶來藝術品。
這個測試
將評判你對...工藝的鑑賞力~

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Since I'm seeing whether
or not you got good taste,
variety is the important thing
here. So don't bring freakin'
a hundred of the same object.
Just one of each kind'll do.
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
既然我在看
你有沒有好的品味，
多樣性是這裡
最重要的。所以別帶來
一百個同樣的東西。
每種只要一個就夠了。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
What are you
standin' around
waiting for? Bring
those collection items!
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
你站在那裡
等什麼？
帶來那些
收藏品！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Nice, nice~
These'll sell for--
Er, I'm glad to say
that you pass for now.
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
不錯，不錯~
這些能賣到--
呃，我很高興
說你暫時通過了。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
I think you're ready
for the next step. Now,
I'm gonna send you to
Lamadin for Part Two
of my test. Yeah, I know...
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
我覺得你準備好
進入下一步了。現在，
我要派你去
找拉馬丁進行
我測試的第二部分。
是的，我知道...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hmm... Some of this
stuff looks good, but
there isn't enough variety
here that proves your eye for
craftsmanship. Come back
with more stuff, alright?
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
嗯... 這些東西
有些看起來不錯，但
這裡的多樣性不足以
證明你對工藝的鑑賞力。
帶更多東西回來，
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hmm...
All the stuff you're
carrying? Worthless junk!
Go and find stuff that was
skillfully crafted, okay?
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
嗯...
你攜帶的所有東西？
都是無用的垃圾！
去找到那些
精心製作的東西，
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
And by crafts I don't mean
potions, weapons, equipment,
none of that. Just think of, well, stuff you'd show off in your rooom and you'll be on the right track. Remember, variety!
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
而且我說的工藝
不是指藥水、武器、裝備，
都不是。想想，嗯，
你會在房間裡展示的東西，
你就在正確的軌道上了。
記住，多樣性！

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Maybe later.
scripts.translation: 稍後再說

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Okay...
Just keep in mind
that Part Two was 
supposed to be
the easy part...
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
好吧...
只要記住
第二部分
本來應該是
簡單的那部分...

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
What...?
Alright, but you
really shouldn't give
up. I mean, Part Two is
supposed to be ridiculously
easy. I made it that way...
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
什...？
好吧，但你真的
不應該放棄。
我是說，第二部分
本來應該是
簡單到離譜的。
是我把它設計成那樣的...

scripts.text:
Alright, Lamadin
tells me you passed.
Not the best performance,
but it's good enough.
scripts.translation:
拉馬丁告訴我你通過了。
表現不算最好，
但已經足夠好了。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Alright, take this chunk
of Sobbing Starlight and
go find someone named,
um, ''Bakerlan'' in Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
好了，拿著這塊
星淚石，
去找艾爾貝塔
一個叫
“貝克蘭”的人。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Well, that's it.
There's no reason
for you to ever see
me again. But yeah,
good luck with that
Sobbing Starlight business.
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
好了，就這樣。
你再也沒有理由
見到我了。不過嘛，
祝你在星淚石
的事情上好運。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Alright, take this chunk
of Sobbing Starlight and
go find someone named,
um, ''Bakerlan'' in Alberta.
scripts.translation:

好了，拿著這塊
星淚石，
去找艾爾貝塔
一個叫

There's no reason

me again. But yeah,
good luck with that
Sobbing Starlight business.
scripts.translation:

好了，就這樣。
你再也沒有理由
見到我了。不過嘛，
祝你在星淚石
的事情上好運。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey, you've got that look
like you want something from
me. It also looks like you're low on cash~! Well, this is what guys like me to do to shameless
moochers like you!
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
嘿，你那個表情
看起來像是想從我這
得到什麼。而且看起來
你手頭也不寬裕~！
哼，像我這樣的人
就是專門對付
像你這種厚臉皮
白吃白喝的人的！

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Hey, you've got that look
like you want something from
me. It also looks like you got zeny to spare! I think I'll help myself and borrow some of your cash!
^FF0000Yoink!^000000
Giggle giggle..
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
嘿，你那個表情
看起來像是想從我這
得到什麼。而且看起來
你還有不少Zeny！
我想我就
借一點你的錢吧！
^FF0000拿走！^000000
嘻嘻嘻...

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: I want to take Part Two again.
scripts.translation: 我想再考一次第二部分。

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Fine, fine.
Geez, why do
these guys always
come and bother me?
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
行吧，行吧。
天哪，為什麼
這些人總是
來打擾我？

scripts.text:
[Dearles]
Wha...?
Part Two
was really
that fun? Fine,
knock yourself out.
scripts.translation:
[迪爾萊斯]
什...？
第二部分
真的那麼
有趣嗎？好吧，
儘管去考吧。

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
Welcome to
Part Two of Dearles'
exam where your sense
of rhythm will be tested~
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
歡迎來到迪爾萊斯
考試的第二部分，
這裡將考驗你的
節奏感~

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
Please click on the
Chat Room to enter the
Standby Room. When it's
your turn, the test will begin!
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
請點選
聊天室進入
候考室。輪到你的時候，
測試就會開始！

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
Let's see...
You're {0}?
Oh, what a shame!
You failed this time.
But don't you worry...
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
讓我看看...
你是{0}？
哎呀，真遺憾！
你這次沒通過。
不過別擔心...

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
Let's see...
You're {0}?
Congratulations!
You passed the test!
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
讓我看看...
你是{0}？
恭喜！
你通過了測試！

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
Let's see...
You're {0}?
Congratulations!
You got a perfect
score on this test!
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
讓我看看...
你是{0}？
恭喜！
你在這項測試中
獲得了滿分！

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
H-how did you
find your way here?
This is private property,
owned by Mister Dearles.
Please leave immediately!
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
你...你是怎麼
找到這裡的？
這是迪爾萊斯先生
的私人領地。
請立刻離開！

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
Please click on the
Chat Room to enter the
Standby Room. When it's
your turn, the test will begin!
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
請點選
聊天室進入
候考室。輪到你的時候，
測試就會開始！

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
The top left pole
means 'Up,' and there
are a total of four marks
designated as Upper, Lower
Left and Right. Hitting each
mark will produce a sound.
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
左上角的杆
代表“上”，
總共有四個標記，
分別指定為上、下、
左和右。擊中每個
標記都會發出聲音。

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
During the test,
you must hit the marks
according to the given
instructions in order to
play music. Nifty, huh?
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
在測試過程中，
你必須按照給定的
指令擊中標記，
以演奏音樂。很巧妙，
對吧？

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
I'm in charge of grading
your performance and determining your qualification. Please do your best and come back to me when
you finish the test. Good luck~
Please do your best.
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
我負責評分
並決定你是否合格。請盡力
完成測試，結束後
回來找我。祝你好運~
請盡力表現。

[Lamadin]

means 'Up,' and there

designated as Upper, Lower
Left and Right. Hitting each

總共有四個標記，

在測試過程中，

指令擊中標記，
以演奏音樂。很巧妙，
對吧？

your performance and determining your qualification. Please do your best and come back to me when
you finish the test. Good luck~
Please do your best.
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
我負責評分
並決定你是否合格。請盡力
完成測試，結束後
回來找我。祝你好運~
請盡力表現。

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
You're welcome to
try again whenever
you want, alright?
Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
你隨時都可以
再試一次，好嗎？
謝謝~

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
I'll send a message to
Mister Dearles right away,
so please go speak to him
again. Once again, great job~
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
我會立刻
給迪爾萊斯先生
發訊息，
所以請再去和他
對話一次。再次，
幹得漂亮~

scripts.text:
[Lamadin]
I'll send a message to
Mister Dearles right away,
so please go speak to him
again. He may even give
you a reward since you
did such a great job~
scripts.translation:
[拉馬丁]
我會立刻給迪爾萊斯先生髮訊息，
所以請再去和他對話一次。
既然你表現得這麼出色，
他說不定還會給你獎勵呢~

scripts.text:
[Exit]
Would you like to go out?
scripts.translation:
[出口]
您想要離開嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Exit]
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[出口]
再見。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Umm...well then...
I shall take the action for Prontera...
And for Juno...
Awww....
Gosh, this is such a pain in the ass...
Mumble mumble...
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
嗯...那麼...
我將為普隆德拉採取行動...
還有朱諾...
哎呀...
真是讓人頭疼...
嘟嘟囔囔...

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Gosh.....
I do not know what I should do about Juno...
?
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
真是的.....
我不知道該拿朱諾怎麼辦...
？
你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Hmm...? You've
finished all of the
tests up until Dearle's
challenge? Prove it to me
with your pieces of the
Sobbing Starlight...
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
嗯...？你已經
完成了直到迪爾萊斯
挑戰之前的所有測試？
用你的星淚石碎片
向我證明吧...

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Please speak to my
steward for all matters
related to the delivery
that you must complete
for my test.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
關於你必須為我的測試
完成的送貨事宜，
請去和我的管家對話。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Ah yes, Mahatra tells
me that you've completed
the delivery. Well, um, he now
has another assignment for
for you to complete. So
please talk to him again.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
啊，是的，瑪哈特拉告訴我
你已經完成了送貨。嗯，
他現在還有另一個任務
要交給你完成。所以
請再和他對話一次。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
You have not finished yet.
Why don't you go finish them first?
I am a busy businessman.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
你還沒完成呢。
為什麼不去先完成它們？
我是個忙碌的商人。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Ah, I was informed about you.
Well, although you have your goal,
that does not necessarily mean to help that kid.
Metz must have an eye for a right person, I assume.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
啊，我已經收到關於你的訊息了。
嗯，雖然你有你的目標，
但這並不意味著要幫助那個小孩。
我想梅茨一定看人很準。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Umm....
Did I see you wrong? Or did Metz do?
...I do not have any more business with you.
Take care now.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
嗯....
是我看錯你了？還是梅茨看錯了？
...我和你再沒什麼事要談了。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
How is it going?
In fact, we want to do it on our own...
but we are too preoccupied with our works...
I hope you will keep up the good work.
I am also curious what that stone is.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
進展如何？
其實，我們想自己去做...
但我們太忙於工作...
希望你能繼續保持好的表現。
我也很好奇那塊石頭是什麼。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text: Mr. Metz sent me.
scripts.translation: 梅茨先生派我來的

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Hmm...
I am pretty busy at this moment. So please do not interrupt me any further.
If you are looking for a job,
please inquire of my steward.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
嗯...
我現在很忙。所以請不要再打擾我了。
如果你在找工作，
請去問我的管家。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Ah....
He did?....Hmmm..
Unfortunately I am kind of busy...
will you please come back later?
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
啊....
他說了嗎？....嗯...
不幸的是，我有點忙...
請你稍後再來好嗎？
謝謝。

scripts.text: Give me a minute...
scripts.translation: 給我一分鐘...

scripts.text: Here...
scripts.translation: 給你...

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Well, you better
come back soon. I'm
a busy businessman, so
my time is quite precious.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
嗯，你最好快點回來。我是個
忙碌的商人，所以我的時間
非常寶貴。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Hmm, I suppose you
still haven't completed
all the tests. These aren't
enough pieces of the Sobbing
Starlight, you know...
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
嗯，我想你
還沒完成所有的測試。這些
星淚石的碎片還不夠，你知道嗎...

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Ah, now I see that
you speak the truth.
Alright, we can begin my test.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
啊，現在我看出來
你說的是實話了。
好吧，我們可以開始我的測試了。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
First, I wish for you to make
a delivery. The object I want you to deliver is expensive and must be handled with care. Don't lose it or you will fail. Now, speak to my steward for more information.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
首先，我希望你
完成一次送貨。我要你送的東西
很貴重，必須小心處理。弄丟了你就
會失敗。現在，去和我的管家對話
以獲取更多資訊。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Hm? It's not possible for
you to have this many pieces
of the Sobbing Starlight!
These must be fakes. How
dare you! Leave me!
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
哼？你不可能擁有這麼多星淚石的碎片！
這些肯定是贗品。你竟敢如此！
給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
Well, I wanted to assign you some various tasks
on my own plan, but recently I am very busy
to take care of tradings with Kunlun and Amatsu.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
嗯，我原本想按照自己的計劃
給你安排各種任務，
但最近我忙於處理與崑崙和櫻花城的貿易事務。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
I found Seyling while I was trading with Amatsu few years ago.
I introduced her brother to the royal family of Prontera, too.
But anyways,
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
幾年前我在與櫻花城進行貿易時發現了賽琳恩。
我也把她哥哥介紹給了普隆德拉的皇室。
不過話說回來，

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
I want to test you longer, but
I am too busy for that. Also I don't think it is good for you.
Let's finish the test now.
You are qualified enough already.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
我想繼續對你進行更長時間的測試，
但我實在太忙了。而且我覺得這樣對你也不好。
我們就此結束測試吧。
你已經足夠合格了。

scripts.text:
[Bakerlan]
There you go.
I am the last one who tested your qualification.
Now bring all of the stone pieces to Metz.
He will tell you what you need to do next.
scripts.translation:
[貝克蘭]
去吧。
我是最後一個測試你資格的人。
現在，把所有石頭碎片交給梅茨。
他會告訴你接下來該做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I'm sorry, but I'm
busy cleaning the manor
right now so I don't have
time to talk. Oh, and would
you please wipe your shoes
on the mat before coming in?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
抱歉，我現在正忙著打掃宅邸，
沒時間聊天。哦，對了，
進來之前請記得在墊子上擦擦鞋。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Leibech...?
I remember that he's
a regular customer who
orders the strangest things.
Last I heard, he was traveling
near Mount Mjolnir.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
萊貝赫...？
我記得他是個常客，
總是訂購一些奇怪的東西。
我最後聽說他正在雷神之錘山附近旅行。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Ooooh...
What am I going
to do?! Oh-- You
startled me!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢噢噢...
我該怎麼辦啊？！
噢——你嚇我一跳！

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Oh dear...
What can I do
about this...?

[Seylin]
Hello there~
Oh, have you
changed your mind
about helping me?
I'll repay you,
of course.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
你好呀~
噢，你改變主意
願意幫我了嗎？
當然，我會報答你的。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Hello there~
So have you decided
yet? If you help me,
I'll be sure to pay
you back somehow.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
你好呀~
那你決定了嗎？如果你幫我，
我一定會想辦法報答你的。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I know that you might
be able to find Vigorgra
in the Alchemist's Guild
in Al de Baran. Aside from
that, I don't know much...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
我知道你可能能在艾爾帕蘭的鍊金術士公會
找到加油藥水。除此之外，
我就不知道了...

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, you know where
you can get Vigorgra?
That's great news!
Oh, when you have it,
bring to me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢，你知道哪裡能買到加油藥水？
真是個好訊息！
噢，等你拿到後，
記得帶給我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Hurray~!
You brought the
Vigorgra! I hope
my brother will
be happy with this!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
萬歲~！
你帶加油藥水來了！
希望我哥哥會喜歡這個！

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Would you please
deliver the Vigorgra
and my letter to my brother
Maruin in the Prontera Castle?
And wish him 'Happy Birthday~'
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
請幫我把加油藥水和我的信件
送到普隆德拉王宮，
交給我哥哥馬魯因。
並祝他“生日快樂~”

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Thanks so much
for your help again!
I want you to have this
as a token of my gratitude.
You really are a kind person~
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
非常感謝你的再次幫助！
我想把這個送給你，
作為我的一點心意。
你真是個善良的人~

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh no~!
Please don't
drag your muddy
feet over the carpet!
Would you please leave?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢不~！
請不要拖著沾滿泥巴的腳
踩在地毯上！
請你離開好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Although the master isn't
a messy person, he's pretty
unorganized. I wish he'd make
it easier for me to tell which
papers are documents and 
which ones are trash...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
雖然主人不是個邋遢的人，
但他挺不講究整理的。我真希望他能
讓我更容易分辨哪些是檔案，
哪些是廢紙...

scripts.text: [Seylin]
scripts.translation: [賽琳恩]

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Yes, that was where
his last order was sent
to. Hm, I wonder. Do you
think he could have been
heading towards the
Schwarzwald Republic?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
是的，他最後的訂單就是寄往那裡的。
嗯，我在想。你覺得他
是不是正前往修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國？

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I'm sorry, but
I was just thinking
about something. I hope
I didn't bother you. ^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
抱歉，
我剛才只是在想事情。
希望沒有打擾到您。^333333*嘆氣*^000000

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I'm sorry, but
I was just thinking
about something. I hope
I didn't bother you. ^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
抱歉，
我剛才只是在想事情。
希望沒有打擾到您。^333333*嘆氣*^000000

scripts.text: Ignore her.
scripts.translation: 無視她

scripts.text: Excuse me, but Mahatra sent me...
scripts.translation: 打擾了，是瑪哈特拉派我來的...

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, it's no use
worrying about
something I can do
nothing about. I better
get back to work...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢，
擔心我也幫不了忙的事
是沒用的。我還是
回去工作吧...

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Mister Mahatra
sent you to me?
Hm? Does he need
me for anything?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
瑪哈特拉先生
派您來的？
嗯？他有什麼
需要我幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: Actually, he wants me to help you.
scripts.translation: 其實，他想讓我來幫您。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, how very kind!
Yes, yes, I could use
some help right now!
You see, it'll be my brother's
birthday, but I'm so busy with
work that I can't see him.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢，真是太好了！
是的，是的，我現在
正需要幫忙呢！
您看，我哥哥的生日快到了，
但我工作太忙，
沒法去看他。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
The last time I saw him,
he looked so tired and weak
so it's worrying me. Now, I've
heard there's some new medicine
called ^FF0000Vigorgra^000000. I don't know much about it, but it should help him!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
上次見他時，
他看起來又累又虛弱，
這讓我很擔心。我聽說
有一種叫^FF0000加油藥水^000000的新藥。
我不太瞭解它，
但它應該對他有幫助！

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Do you think you could
find that medicine and
bring it to me? If you don't
want to, I understand. Plus,
I don't know if the master
would approve of this...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
您能幫我
找到那種藥，
然後帶給我嗎？如果您
不願意，我也理解。而且，
我也不確定主人
會不會同意...

scripts.text: I can't do it.
scripts.translation: 我做不到。

scripts.text: Let me think about it.
scripts.translation: 讓我考慮一下。

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 當然，為什麼不呢？

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, really?
Alright, I can
understand. I'm
very sorry to bother
you with my problems.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢，是嗎？
好的，我
理解。很抱歉
用我的麻煩事
打擾您了。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh okay.
Take your time.
If you can help
me, I'd really
appreciate it~
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢，好的。
您慢慢考慮。
如果您能
幫幫我，
我會非常感激的~

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, thank you so much!
Now, I remember hearing
that you can find Vigorgra
somewhere in Al de Baran.
Somebody in the Alchemist
Guild makes it, I think.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢，太感謝您了！
我記得聽說
可以在艾爾帕蘭
找到加油藥水。
好像是鍊金術士公會
裡的某個人做的。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I'm sorry, but I don't
know much about the medicine.
Well, aside from the fact that
it makes men feel young again.
So that must be good, right?
Thanks again for your help~
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
抱歉，我對這種藥
瞭解不多。
嗯，除了它能讓男人
重獲青春這一點。
那肯定很好，對吧？
再次感謝您的幫助~

scripts.text:
Hello there~
Oh, have you
changed your mind
about helping me?
I'll repay you,
of course.
scripts.translation:
您好~
噢，您改變主意
願意幫我了嗎？
當然，我會
報答您的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh really?
I'm sorry, I...
I just thought
that maybe...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢，是嗎？
抱歉，我...
我只是覺得
也許...

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, thank you so much!
Now, I remember hearing
that you can find Vigorgra
somewhere in Al de Baran.
Somebody in the Alchemist
Guild makes it, I think.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢，太感謝您了！
我記得聽說
可以在艾爾帕蘭
找到加油藥水。
好像是鍊金術士公會
裡的某個人做的。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I'm sorry, but I don't
know much about the medicine.
Well, aside from the fact that
it makes men feel young again.
So that must be good, right?
Thanks again for your help~
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
抱歉，我對這種藥
瞭解不多。
嗯，除了它能讓男人
重獲青春這一點。
那肯定很好，對吧？
再次感謝您的幫助~

scripts.text:
Hello there~
So have you decided
yet? If you help me,
I'll be sure to pay
you back somehow.
scripts.translation:
您好~
您決定好了嗎？如果您
幫幫我，
我一定會想辦法
報答您的。

scripts.text: Um, I'm still thinking.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我還在考慮。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh okay.
But please hurry~
My brother's birthday
is coming up soon!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢，好的。
但請快點~
我哥哥的生日
快到了！

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh, thank you so much!
Now, I remember hearing
that you can find Vigorgra
somewhere in Al de Baran.
Somebody in the Alchemist
Guild makes it, I think.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢，太感謝您了！
我記得聽說
可以在艾爾帕蘭
找到加油藥水。
好像是鍊金術士公會
裡的某個人做的。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
I'm sorry, but I don't
know much about the medicine.
Well, aside from the fact that
it makes men feel young again.
So that must be good, right?
Thanks again for your help~
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
抱歉，我對這種藥
瞭解不多。
嗯，除了它能讓男人
重獲青春這一點。
那肯定很好，對吧？
再次感謝您的幫助~

scripts.text:
I know that you might
be able to find Vigorgra
in the Alchemist's Guild
in Al de Baran. Aside from
that, I don't know much...
scripts.translation:
我知道您可能
能在艾爾帕蘭的
鍊金術士公會
找到加油藥水。
除此之外，我
不太瞭解...

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Once you get it,
would you bring
the Vigorgra to me?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
拿到之後，
能把加油藥水
帶給我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Oh! Would you please
bring this Vigorgra to my
brother? His name is Maruin
and he's working over at
the Prontera Castle.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
噢！能麻煩您
把這瓶加油藥水
帶給我哥哥嗎？
他叫馬魯因，
正在普隆德拉王宮
工作。

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
Ah, I almost forgot!
I just finished writing
him this letter, so would
you also make sure he gets
this? Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
啊，我差點忘了！
我剛給他寫了
這封信，所以
也請確保他
收到好嗎？
太感謝您了！

scripts.text:
[Seylin]
So how have you been?
Is everything okay with you?
I hope you have a lot of good
experiences in your adventures~
scripts.translation:
[賽琳恩]
最近過得怎麼樣？
一切都還好嗎？
希望您在冒險中
能有很多美好的
經歷~

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Welcome to
Prontera Castle.
Please be careful
and avoid getting lost.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
歡迎來到
普隆德拉王宮。
請小心，
別迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Welcome to
Prontera Castle.
Please be careful
and avoid getting los--
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
歡迎來到
普隆德拉王宮。
請小心，
別迷--

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Oh hey, how's
it going? Thanks
again for helping
out my sister, we
really appreciate it.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
嘿，最近
怎麼樣？再次
感謝幫助
我妹妹，我們
真的很感激。

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Oh man...
I'm so tired~!
Enervated, even~
If I only had some
kind of refreshment...
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
天哪...
我好累~！
簡直精疲力竭~
要是能有點
什麼提神的東西...

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Oh man...
I'm so tired~!
Enervated, even~
If I only had some
kind of refreshment...
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
天哪...
我好累~！
簡直精疲力竭~
要是能有點
什麼提神的東西...

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
What's that?
You're here for
my sister? Um, did
something happen...?
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
那是？
你是來找我
妹妹的？嗯，
發生什麼事了...？

scripts.text: Oh no, she sent you a birthday gift.
scripts.translation: 不，她讓你送生日禮物。

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Birthday...?
What are you sm--
OH. It is my birthday.
Ha! I completely forgot!
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
生日...？
你在說什麼--
噢。今天是我的生日。
哈！我完全忘了！

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Thanks for coming
all the way out here
to deliver my present!
Wow, I wonder what she
got for me this year?
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
謝謝你大老遠
跑來送我的禮物！
哇，不知道她
今年給我買了
什麼？

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Th-this is--!
Oh. Snap. That's right.
She's been worried about
me being tired lately. But
does she even know what
Vigorgra is supposed to...?
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
這...這是--！
噢。糟糕，我想起來了。
她最近一直擔心
我太累了。但她
知道加油藥水
是用來...什麼的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Never mind. It's the
thought that counts.
But for the record, it's
not like I need this stuff.
I mean, I have, you know,
a girlfr--you know what I mean.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
算了。心意
最重要。
不過說實話，
我並不需要這種東西。
我是說，我有，你知道，
女朋--你知道我的意思。

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
I'd like to pay you
back, but since I'm
on duty, all I can do
is replenish your health.
I'm not really supposed to,
but no one will say anything.
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
我想報答你，
但因為我正在
值班，我只能
恢復你的生命值。
按規定我不該這麼做，
但沒人會說閒話。

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Well, thanks for
the letter and the
male supplement, I guess.
I'll send a message to my
sister. Good luck on your
travels, alright?
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
好了，謝謝你的
信和男性補劑。
我會給我妹妹
發訊息的。
祝你旅途順利，
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Oh man...
I'm so tired~!
Enervated, even~
If I only had some
kind of refreshment...
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
天哪...
我好累~！
簡直精疲力竭~
要是能有點
什麼提神的東西...

scripts.text:
[Maruin]
Oh...
And just between you
and me, that Vigorgra
really came in handy!
That stuff's amazing!
scripts.translation:
[馬魯因]
噢...
還有，就我們
倆之間說，那瓶
加油藥水
真的很有用！
那東西太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Most Alchemists seek out the
Stone of Sage, but in my opinion, their goals are too short sighted. There are more important studies
to be conducted in the name of science for the good of mankind...
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
大多數鍊金術士
都在尋找賢者之石，
但在我看來，他們的
目標太短視了。
為了人類的福祉，
還有更重要的
科學研究
需要開展...

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Eh...?
What do you need?
If it's not important,
please leave my
laboratory!
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
嗯...？
你需要什麼？
如果不重要，
請離開我的
實驗室！

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Hmmm...
So did you
bring everything
you need for the
Vigorgra...?
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
嗯...
那麼，你
帶齊了製作
加油藥水
所需的一切
材料嗎...？

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Vigorgra is
a miracle of
modern science,
but it can do more
harm than good if
you're not careful!
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
加油藥水
是現代科學的
奇蹟，
但如果你不小心的話，
它造成的危害
可能比好處更多！

scripts.text: So what are you studying?
scripts.translation: 那你正在研究什麼？

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
In the end, the 
Stone of Sage may
just be a simple rumor.
After all, thousands of
Alchemists have already
failed to create it.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
到頭來，賢者之石
可能只是一個
簡單的謠言。
畢竟，成千上萬的
鍊金術士
都已經
嘗試失敗了。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
What am I studying?
Well, my expertise is...
Different. If you must
know, it's a secret~
If any man found out
about my research...
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
我在研究什麼？
嗯，我的專長
有點...
不同。如果你非要
知道的話，那是個秘密~
如果哪個男人
知道了我的研究...

scripts.text: Vigorgra?
scripts.translation: 加油藥水？

scripts.text: Oh, I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 哦，對不起。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
What?! Who told you
that I could make that?!
Oh, no matter. I suppose
you want me to get some
ready for you. Now tell me...
Why do you want it?
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
什麼？！誰告訴你的
我能做那個？！
哦，算了。我想
你是想讓我
給你準備一些。現在告訴我...
你為什麼想要它？

scripts.text: No, I don't want it!
scripts.translation: 不，我不想要！

scripts.text: I need Vigorgra for... a friend.
scripts.translation: 我需要加油藥水... 為了一個朋友。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
You immature--!
You come all this
way to bother me?
Don't bring your
shame into my lab!
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
你這個不成熟的人--！
你大老遠跑來
打擾我？
別把你的
羞恥心
帶進我的實驗室！

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Oh right.
Your friend.
I understand you.
Crystal clear.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
哦，對了。
你的朋友。
我理解你。
一清二楚。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Well, since you know
about my secret research,
I'll do you a favor so long as
you don't tell anyone else!
Of course, I can't just give
you Vigorgra for free...
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
嗯，既然你知道
我的秘密研究，
只要你不告訴
其他人，
我就幫你這個忙！
當然，我不能
白白送你
加油藥水...

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Now, write this
down. These are the
ingredients I need to
make a bottle of Vigorgra.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
現在，把這些
記下來。這些是
製作一瓶
加油藥水
所需的材料。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
^ff00001 Ment
20 Honey
10 Royal Jelly
30 Bear's Footskin
1 Hinalle Leaflet
1 Empty Bottle.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
^ff00001 薄荷
20 蜂蜜
10 蜂膠
30 熊掌
1 西納雷葉子
1 空瓶。^000000

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Alright.
Now go and
bring all those
items to me. I'll
be seeing you later.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
好了。
現在去
把這些材料
都帶給我。我
稍後見。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
There's no need
to apologize. But
I'd appreciate it if
you'd let me work
in peace.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
不用道歉。但
如果你能
讓我安靜地
工作，
我會很感激的。

scripts.text: Not yet...
scripts.translation: 還沒...

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Well, let me
remind you of
what you need to
bring to me in case
you forgot already...
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
嗯，讓我
提醒你一下
你需要帶給我
什麼，以防
你已經忘了...

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
^ff00001 Ment
20 Honey
10 Royal Jelly
30 Bear's Footskin
1 Hinalle Leaflet
1 Empty Bottle.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
^ff00001 薄荷
20 蜂蜜
10 蜂膠
30 熊掌
1 西納雷葉子
1 空瓶。^000000

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Take your time...
In the end, you're
the one who's got
the need for it, anyway.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
慢慢來...
畢竟，
是你自己
需要它。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Great...!
Now let me check
to see if you have
everything ready...
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
太好了...！
現在讓我檢查一下
你是否
準備好了
所有材料...

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Hmm, you're still
missing some of the
ingredients. Now, listen
carefully. I need you to get...
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
嗯，你還
缺少一些
材料。現在，仔細聽。我需要你去弄...

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Good work.
Everything's here.
Alright, just this once
I'll make you a bottle
of Vigorgra.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
幹得好。
材料都齊了。
好了，就這一次
我會給你做一瓶
加油藥水。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
^ff00001 Ment
20 Honey
10 Royal Jelly
30 Bear's Footskin
1 Hinalle Leaflet
1 Empty Bottle.^000000
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
^ff00001 薄荷
20 蜂蜜
10 蜂膠
30 熊掌
1 西納雷葉子
1 空瓶。^000000

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
If you ask me again,
I won't speak to you!
And I'll need to charge
you 10,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
如果你再問一次，
我就不跟你對話了！
而且我還得向你收取
10,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Alright, I'll be
taking my fee from
you now. It's not that
expensive when you
consider Vigorgra's
numerous benefits.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
好的，我現在
要收取你的費用了。
考慮到加油藥水
眾多的功效，
這並不算貴。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Huh...
It doesn't look like
you have enough zeny
right now. No matter,
I can wait until you
bring it all to me.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
嗯...
看來你現在
Zeny不夠。沒關係，
我可以等你
把錢都帶來。

scripts.text:
^3355FFMelkaba placed
all the ingredients
into a test tube and
began processing it
through some strange
electronic equipment.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF梅爾卡巴
將所有材料
放入試管中，
並開始通過某種
奇怪的電子裝置
進行處理。^000000

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Ah! Success!
A lifetime's supply
of Vigorgra! I know it's
just one bottle, but this
stuff is extremely potent!
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
啊！成功了！
一輩子的加油藥水！
我知道只有一瓶，
但這東西
效力極強！

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
It failed?!
Of course, the mixture
was too vigorous, even
for the machinery! I'm sorry,
but would you bring the things
we need to make Vigorgra again?
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
失敗了？！
當然，混合物
太劇烈了，
連機器都承受不住！
抱歉，
你能把製作加油藥水
需要的東西再帶來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
Um, just remember
not to take too much
at one time. Can't have
you getting crazy high
blood pressure~
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
嗯，請記住
一次不要喝太多。
可別讓你
血壓飆升~

scripts.text: So what are you studying?
scripts.translation: 那你正在研究什麼？

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
In the end, the
Stone of Sage may
just be a simple rumor.
After all, thousands of
Alchemists have already
failed to create it.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
到頭來，
賢者之石
可能只是個簡單的謠言。
畢竟，成千上萬的
鍊金術士
都已經失敗了。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
What am I studying?
Well, my expertise is...
Different. If you must
know, it's a secret~
If any man found out
about my research...
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
我在研究什麼？
嗯，我的專長
有點...
不同。如果你非要
知道的話，那是個秘密~
如果哪個男人
知道了我的研究...

scripts.text: So what are you studying?
scripts.translation: 那你正在研究什麼？

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
In the end, the
Stone of Sage may
just be a simple rumor.
After all, thousands of
Alchemists have already
failed to create it.
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
到頭來，
賢者之石
可能只是個簡單的謠言。
畢竟，成千上萬的
鍊金術士
都已經失敗了。

scripts.text:
[Melkaba]
What am I studying?
Well, my expertise is...
Different. If you must
know, it's a secret~
If any man found out
about my research...
scripts.translation:
[梅爾卡巴]
我在研究什麼？
嗯，我的專長
有點...
不同。如果你非要
知道的話，那是個秘密~
如果哪個男人
知道了我的研究...

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Welcome to the
Alchesh Estate.
The Alcheshs are the
most esteemed family
in all of Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
歡迎來到
阿爾切什莊園。
阿爾切什家族是
整個艾爾貝塔
最受尊敬的家族。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Ah yes, the master informed
me that you would be taking
care of an urgent delivery for
him. Please take this to a
man named ^3355FFLeibech^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
啊，是的，主人
告訴我你要為他
處理一個緊急的送貨任務。
請把這個交給
一位名叫^3355FF萊貝赫^000000的男子。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
You haven't delivered
the Stone yet? Please take
good care of it since it's very
rare. Don't use it or lose it.
before it's delivered!
Take care, now...
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
你還沒把石頭送出去？
請妥善保管，因為它非常稀有。
在送達之前
不要使用或丟失它！
請小心...

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Ah, you've returned.
And I see you already
delivered the Stone. Great,
well done. Let me send a
message to the master, so
please visit him later.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
啊，你回來了。
看來你已經
把石頭送出去了。很好，
幹得好。讓我給主人
發個訊息，
請稍後再去拜訪他。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Thank you very
much for the trouble
you've gone through
on our behalf.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
非常感謝你
為我們所付出的
辛勞。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Greetings. Hm?
Did the master ask
you to perform another
task for him already?
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
你好。嗯？
主人已經
讓你為他執行
另一個任務了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Although you may only
be doing it for the Sobbing
Starlight, I really appreciate
all your help. Seylin's a very
nice girl and doesn't deserve
to feel down...
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
雖然你可能只是
為了哭泣的星光，
但我真的很感激
你的所有幫助。賽琳恩是個
很好的女孩，
不應該感到沮喪...

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Yes.
I heard from Seylin.
I did not know she was worried about her brother.
Ahem ahem...
Thank you for helping her.
I will send a message to my master.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
是的。
我從賽琳恩那裡聽說了。
我不知道她
在擔心她的哥哥。
咳咳...
謝謝你幫助她。
我會給主人發訊息。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
I'm very disappointed
in you. We put our trust
in you and you really
let us down.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
我對你很失望。
我們信任你，
而你真的
讓我們失望了。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
I hope the master listens
to me and dresses more like
a man in his position. Even if
he thinks he's just a merchant,
he's the master of this estate!
But please don't tell him that~
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
我希望主人能聽我的，
穿得更像個
符合他地位的人。即使
他認為自己只是個商人，
他也是這個莊園的主人！
但請不要告訴他~

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
I am Mahatra Mornen,
steward of this family.
Feel free to ask me if
you need anything and
I shall do my best
to assist you.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
我是瑪哈特拉·莫恩，
這個家族的管家。
如果你需要任何幫助，
請隨時問我，
我會盡力協助你。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
It may be difficult
to find him since he
travels around the world.
Ah yes, I have heard that
he was in some other country...
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
因為他
周遊世界，
所以可能很難找到他。
啊，是的，我聽說
他在另一個國家...

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Now, the item I am
about to give you is
one of a kind. Don't lose
it or you will fall out of favor with the master...
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
接下來我要交給你的物品
是獨一無二的。
千萬別弄丟了，
否則主人會對你失望的...

scripts.text:
^3355FFMahatra gives you
a unique stone that has
your name attached to it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF瑪哈特拉給了你
一塊刻有你名字的
獨特石頭。^000000

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: You have another assignment for me.
scripts.translation: 你還有別的任務給我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Very well.
Then we shall
converse later~
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
好的。
那我們改天再聊~

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
I... I do...?
The master didn't
leave me any instructions.
Hmmm. Oh, I know what you can
do! Why don't you help ^FF0000Seylin^000000? She seems bothered by something...
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
我...我有...？
主人並沒有
給我留下任何指示。
嗯...啊，我知道你可以做什麼了！
你為什麼不幫幫^FF0000賽琳恩^000000呢？她看起來心事重重...

scripts.text:
Mahatra]
If there is anything else, he will let you pass the test.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
瑪哈特拉]
如果還有其他問題，他會讓你通過測試的。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Mahatra]
Well, I suppose
that's the nature
of the testing. They're
designed so that only
the best of the best
can pass them.
scripts.translation:
[瑪哈特拉]
嗯，我想
這就是測試的本質吧。
它們的設計初衷
就是隻有最優秀的人
才能通過。

scripts.text:
[Hurubu]
Welcome to the
Alchesh Estate.
If you have any business
with the master, please
let me know.
scripts.translation:
[胡魯布]
歡迎來到
阿爾切什莊園。
如果您有要事
需要見主人，
請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Hurubu]
Welcome to the
Alchesh Estate.
Please leave if
you do not have
any business here.
scripts.translation:
[胡魯布]
歡迎來到
阿爾切什莊園。
如果您沒有要事，
請離開。

scripts.text:
[Hurubu]
Welcome to the
Alchesh Estate.
Lately, it seems that
the master is in a good
mood. I believe that we
have you to thank for that.
scripts.translation:
[胡魯布]
歡迎來到
阿爾切什莊園。
最近，主人似乎
心情不錯。我想
這應該歸功於你。

scripts.text: I'd like to see Mr. Bakerlan.
scripts.translation: 我想見貝克蘭先生。

scripts.text: Have a nice day.
scripts.translation: 祝你有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Hurubu]
Ah, you've
come to speak
to the master?
He's not out on
business, so you
can probably see him.
scripts.translation:
[胡魯布]
啊，你是
來見主人的嗎？
他並沒有外出
經商，所以
你應該能見到他。

scripts.text:
[Hurubu]
Ah...
Good day.
scripts.translation:
[胡魯布]
啊...
祝你有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Machen]
Why...?
How did my
family's wealth
and prestige just
go down the drain?
scripts.translation:
[馬興]
為什麼...？
我們家族的財富
和威信
怎麼就付諸東流了？

scripts.text:
[Machen]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
How did it happen?
How did the Alcheshs
become so rich so quickly?
scripts.translation:
[馬興]
^333333*嘆氣...*^000000
這是怎麼發生的？
阿爾切什家族
怎麼這麼快就
變得如此富有？

scripts.text:
[Machen]
You know, if the Alcheshs
were greedy, they actually
wouldn't be as big as they
are today. They've contributed
to a lot of social causes and
that won them a lot of support.
scripts.translation:
[馬興]
你知道嗎，如果阿爾切什家族
貪婪的話，他們實際上
不會像今天這樣龐大。
他們為許多社會事業
做出了貢獻，
這為他們贏得了很多支援。

scripts.text:
[Machen]
Ever since the
Alcheshs came to Alberta,
they quickly took our place
as the biggest business owners
here. It's our biggest shame...
scripts.translation:
[馬興]
自從阿爾切什家族
來到艾爾貝塔以來，
他們很快就取代了我們的位置，
成為了這裡最大的商業巨頭。
這是我們最大的恥辱...

scripts.text: Alchesh family?
scripts.translation: 阿爾切什家族？

scripts.text: Do you know where Mr. Bakerlan is?
scripts.translation: 你知道貝克蘭先生在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Machen]
My family, the Tudas,
used to run the biggest
trading company in Alberta.
But when the Alcheshs came
fifty years ago, they started
to outdo us in everything...
scripts.translation:
[馬興]
我的家族，圖達斯家族，
曾經是艾爾貝塔最大的貿易公司。
但五十年前阿爾切什家族到來後，
他們在各方面都超越了我們...

scripts.text:
[Machen]
It's like they're financial
geniuses or something!
Under Bakerlan's guidance,
their estate has grown to be
one of the richest in Alberta,
if not all of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation:
[馬興]
他們簡直像是金融天才！
在貝克蘭的指導下，
他們的資產增長到成為艾爾貝塔，
甚至整個盧恩·米德加茲最富有的家族之一...

scripts.text:
[Machen]
Bakerlan...?
Oh, he's probably
in his ten story money
vault, swimming in his
money by now. You
know rich people.
scripts.translation:
[馬興]
貝克蘭...？
哦，他大概現在
正在他那十層樓高的金庫裡，
泡在錢堆裡吧。你知道有錢人都是這樣的。

scripts.text:
[Machen]
It-was-a-joke!
You see that big
mansion to the north?
That's the Alchesh Estate.
He should be home now.
scripts.translation:
[馬興]
我開玩笑的！
你看到北邊那棟大宅子了嗎？
那就是阿爾切什莊園。
他現在應該在家。

scripts.text:
[Machen]
He usually travels
a lot on business,
but if you're lucky you
should be able to catch him.
scripts.translation:
[馬興]
他通常因為生意
經常出差，
但如果你運氣好，
應該能碰到他。

scripts.text:
[Machen]
Ever since the
Alcheshs came to Alberta,
they quickly took our place
as the biggest business owners
here. It's our biggest shame...
scripts.translation:
[馬興]
自從阿爾切什家族
來到艾爾貝塔以來，
他們很快就取代了我們的位置，
成為了這裡最大的商業巨頭。
這是我們最大的恥辱...

scripts.text:
[Machen]
I gotta admit...
The whole family
is a bunch of financial
geniuses, alright.
scripts.translation:
[馬興]
我得承認...
他們全家
確實是一群金融天才。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
I have a great
interest in collecting
unique and uncommon
goods. You know, things
that most people see just
once in their lifetimes.
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
我對收集獨特
且稀有的物品
很感興趣。你知道，
那些大多數人
一輩子只能看到一次的東西。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Excuse me...
Are you from the Alchesh
Trading Company? I've been
waiting for my order and they
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
打擾一下...
你是阿爾切什貿易公司的嗎？
我一直在等我的訂單，他們...

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Hm...?
There must be some
mistake. This isn't what
I ordered. Well, I can wait...
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
嗯...？
一定是搞錯了。
這不是我訂的東西。
好吧，我可以再等等...

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Finally, it's here!
Yes, this is what I ordered.
Thanks for the delivery!
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
終於到了！
是的，這就是我訂的東西。
謝謝你的配送！

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
I am interested in collecting uncommon stuffs.
For that, I need to find something that I cannot see around here.
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
我對收集稀有物品很感興趣。
為此，我需要找到一些
在這裡看不到的東西。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Hey, thanks for
delivering my order
for me. It was a great
addition to my collection!
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
嘿，謝謝你
幫我送來了訂單。
它是我收藏中
很棒的新增！

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
I usually use the
Alchesh Trading Company
to help add to my collection.
Their prices aren't the cheapest, but their service is very reliable.
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
我通常使用
阿爾切什貿易公司
來擴充我的收藏。
他們的價格不是最便宜的，
但服務非常可靠。

scripts.text: No, I'm not.
scripts.translation: 不，我不是。

scripts.text: They must be busy.
scripts.translation: 他們一定很忙。

scripts.text: Yes, I have your order.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有你的訂單。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Oh, I'm sorry.
My mistake. Well
then, be safe in
your travels.
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
哦，對不起。
是我搞錯了。
那麼，祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
I suppose you're
right. I mean, Juno
is pretty far from
Alberta. Maybe I'm
just overly excited
about my delivery...
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
我想你說得對。
我是說，朱諾
離艾爾貝塔挺遠的。
也許我只是
對我的配送太興奮了...

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Really?!
That's great!
Do you have the
item I ordered?
Where is it?
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
真的嗎？！
太好了！
你有我訂的物品嗎？
它在哪裡？

scripts.text: I put it somewhere.
scripts.translation: 我把它放在某個地方了。

scripts.text: Sorry, I lost it.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我弄丟了。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Oh, alright. 
So long as you didn't
lose it, that's fine. I'll wait
here, so would you bring it
to me as soon as you can?
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
哦，好的。
只要沒弄丟就沒關係。
我會在這裡等，
你能儘快把它帶給我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
What...?
Hey, man.
That's not funny!
You're joking, right?
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
什...？
喂，夥計。
這不好笑！
你在開玩笑吧？

scripts.text: No. I'm not joking.
scripts.translation: 不。我沒開玩笑。

scripts.text: Okay, you got me~
scripts.translation: 好吧，你贏了~

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
I don't believe it!
I think I'm going to
write a letter to your
boss, Mister Bakerlan.
What do you think 
about that?
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
我不信！
我想我會寫封信給你的老闆，貝克蘭先生。
你覺得怎麼樣？

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Oh, thank goodness!
I thought you might have
really lost it! Say, would you
bring it to me as soon as
can? I'll wait for you here.
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
哦，謝天謝地！
我還以為你真的弄丟了！
喂，你能儘快把它帶給我嗎？
我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Just come back and
bring me what I actually
ordered, alright? And this
time, don't make any mistakes.
Thanks, I appreciate it~
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
回來時記得帶上我真正訂的東西，好嗎？
這次別再出錯了。
謝謝，我很感激~

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Well, here's your
receipt. Please take
this to Mister Bakerlan
so he knows you did
a good job for me.
Thanks again!
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
好了，這是你的收據。
請把它交給貝克蘭先生，
讓他知道你為我做了一件好事。
再次感謝！

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
I usually use the
Alchesh Trading Company
to help add to my collection.
Their prices aren't the cheapest, but their service is very reliable.
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
我通常使用
阿爾切什貿易公司
來擴充我的收藏。
他們的價格不是最便宜的，
但服務非常可靠。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
Usually, I am using Alchesh Trading Company for that.
Although the price is little bit higher than I wish,
they are very reliable.
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
通常，我會使用阿爾切什貿易公司。
雖然價格比我期望的要高一點，
但他們非常可靠。

scripts.text:
[Leibech]
It's really tough to
find unique and oddball
items, but I find great pride
in expanding my collection~
scripts.translation:
[萊貝赫]
找到獨特且古怪的物品真的很難，
但我以擴充套件我的收藏而感到自豪~

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Hmm...
What should I make for
dinner today? Pickled cabbage?
I learned how to make it a while ago, but I've never gotten the chance to make it yet...
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
嗯...
今天晚餐做什麼好呢？醃捲心菜？
我很久以前就學會了怎麼做，但一直沒機會做...

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Hey, who are you anyhow?
Don't you know it's rude to
enter someone's house without
being invited? Besides, I don't have the time to help strangers while I'm busy making dinner...
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
嘿，你是誰？
你不知道未經邀請就進入別人家是不禮貌的嗎？
而且，我正忙著做晚飯，沒時間理會陌生人...

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Ho-ho~!
Crisp and delicious pickled
cabbage~ My kid loves this stuff and finished it all by herself the last time I made it.
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
呵呵~！
脆脆的、美味的醃捲心菜~
我的小孩很喜歡這個，上次我做的時候她一個人全吃光了。

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Ah...
So you've seen my husband.
How is he doing? I worry about
whether or not he's taking care
of himself enough...
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
啊...
原來你見過我丈夫。
他過得怎麼樣？我擔心他是否照顧自己...

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Thank you so much for bringing
this to me. I'm so happy to hear that he's fine and doing well.
Although he's not here often enough, it's good to know
that he loves his job.
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
非常感謝你把這個帶給我。
聽到他沒事且過得很好，我很高興。
雖然他不在家的時間不夠多，但知道他熱愛他的工作，這就很好了。

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Liana's daddy needs to come home more often. ^333333*Sigh*^000000 Even though he's away for long periods of time, I suppose it's for the best...
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
莉安娜的爸爸需要更常回家。^333333*嘆氣*^000000 雖然他在外時間很長，但我想這樣最好...

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
So how have you been?
So how have you been?
As usual, Liana misses
her daddy, but I suppose
it can't be helped...
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
你最近怎麼樣？
你最近怎麼樣？
一如既往，莉安娜想念她的爸爸，但我想沒辦法...

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Try to cherish your
family, especially through the
hard times. Even when you're angry with them, try to be more understanding. I know it's hard...
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
試著珍惜你的家人，尤其是在困難時期。
即使你對他們生氣，也要試著多理解。我知道這很難...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait!
I'm here to see...

[Brenda Howard]
Huh?
What are you
talking about?
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
嗯？
你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Hmm...
I wonder
how my pickled
cabbage will turn out?
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
嗯...
不知道我醃的白菜會做成什麼樣呢？

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Ah... I see.
You're looking for my husband.
My husband, my daughter and
I just moved to Geffen from
Prontera a while ago.
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
啊...我明白了。
你在找我丈夫。
我丈夫、女兒和我
不久前剛從普隆德拉
搬到了吉芬。

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
We moved to Geffen for the sake of my husband's business. Apparently, this town is closest to something he really seems to need. Whatever it is, it must be really important to his smithing work.
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
我們搬到吉芬是為了我丈夫的事業。聽說這個城鎮離他非常需要的某種東西最近。無論那是什麼，對他的鐵匠工作一定非常重要。

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Oh, and if you're going to look
for my husband, please talk to my daughter before you go. I think she has something that she wants to give to her father...
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
哦，如果你要去找我丈夫，
請先和我女兒談談再走。
我想她有些話
想對父親說...

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Oh, I can't help but worry!
Thank you for letting me know
how he's doing. Still, he should
be doing a better job of keeping
in touch with us. ^333333*Sigh*^000000
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
哎呀，真讓人擔心！
謝謝你告訴我他的近況。
不過，他應該更勤快地
和我們聯絡才對。^333333*嘆氣*^000000

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Even so, I should start letting
him know that I want him to spend
a little more time at home. Oh, and why don't you talk to Liana? She's been waiting to tell you something.
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
即便如此，我也該讓他知道，
我希望他多花點時間在家。
哦，還有，你去和莉安娜談談吧？
她一直在等你，有話想對你說。

scripts.text:
I may be no expert, but I'm
certain that my husband is
the best blacksmith in the world! Did you know Hollgrehenn and Aragham used to be his apprentices? Ho ho ho~
scripts.translation: 我雖然不是行家，但我確信我丈夫是世界上最棒的鐵匠！你知道嗎？霍爾格雷恩和阿拉甘以前都是他的學徒呢。呵呵呵~

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've made more available inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在的物品欄太滿了。
請騰出一些空間後再來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Liana]
*Pout*
When's my daddy
coming home?!
I... I miss him so much~
*Cries*
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
*撅嘴*
爸爸什麼時候回家呀？！
我...我好想他~
*哭泣*

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Oh, my mom said she's gonna cook me something good today.
I wonder what she's gonna make?
I hope it's pickled cabbage again!
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
哦，媽媽說今天要給我做好吃的。
不知道她會做什麼呢？
希望又是醃白菜！

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Everyone says that daddy is the best blacksmith in the whole world! But now he lets his apprentices do
the work so he can go around the world to find a rare ore~ Isn't that amazing?
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
大家都說爸爸是全世界最棒的鐵匠！但現在他讓學徒們幹活，自己跑去世界各地尋找稀有礦石~ 是不是很厲害？

scripts.text:
[Liana]
My dad never broke anything
his customers gave him. And my uncle Hollgrehenn and Aragham wouldn't let anything like that
happen, would they?
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
爸爸從來沒有弄壞過顧客給他的東西。而且叔叔霍爾格雷恩和阿拉甘也不會讓這種事發生的，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Would you please bring my letter over to my dad? Heh heh, he'll be
so happy to hear from me!
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
請幫我把這封信帶給爸爸好嗎？嘿嘿，他收到我的信一定會很開心的！

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Yay~!
Thank you for bringing my letter to my dad. Here, here!
You have to share my treasure with me, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
耶~！
謝謝你幫我把信帶給爸爸。給你，給你！
你要和我分享我的寶藏哦，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Liana]
I never saw my dad fail to upgrade a weapon or armor. Mmm? But maybe if he had something really really old and rare and special...
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
我從來沒見爸爸升級武器或防具失敗過。嗯？不過，如果是一件非常非常古老、稀有又特別的...

scripts.text: What are you drawing by the way?
scripts.translation: 你在畫什麼呀？

scripts.text: Apprentices?
scripts.translation: 學徒？

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Oh, this?
It's a letter for my daddy.
Mom said that some {0} is gonna try to find my dad, so I'm making this so {1}he can take it him~
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
哦，這個？
這是給爸爸的信。
媽媽說有個{0}會去找爸爸，所以我寫了這封信，讓{1}他帶過去~

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Yeah, Uncle Hollegrehenn and Aragham come to visit sometimes and we all play. But, it's more fun to see my dad, even though he's not back yet. ^333333*Pout*^000000
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
是的，叔叔霍爾格雷恩和阿拉甘有時會來拜訪，我們一起玩。但是，還是見到爸爸更有趣，雖然他還沒回來。^333333*撅嘴*^000000

scripts.text: Don't you miss your dad?
scripts.translation: 你想爸爸了嗎？

scripts.text: He also misses you a lot.
scripts.translation: 爸爸也很想你。

scripts.text:
[Liana]
I miss him sooo much!
^333333*Cries*^000000 But Mom always
says that he's too busy.
^333333*Pouts*^000000

[Liana]
I hope so...
But I hate it when
he doesn't have enough
time to come home and
see me. Sooooooooo~
I wrote this letter!
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
希望如此...
但是我不喜歡他沒時間回家看我。所以...我寫了這封信！

scripts.text: I'll bring this to him.
scripts.translation: 我會把它帶給他的。

scripts.text:
[Brenda Howard]
Liana~
This nice {0} is going to look for your dad. Why don't you ask {1} to take your letter to him for you?
scripts.translation:
[布倫達·霍華德]
莉安娜~
這位善良的{0}要去尋找你的爸爸。為什麼不請{1}幫你把信帶給他呢？

scripts.text:
[Liana]
You are...?
Really, really?
H-hooray!
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
你是...？
真的嗎，真的嗎？
太棒了！

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Okay then, don't
forget to give this to
my dad, okay? Promise?
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
那麼，別忘了把這個交給爸爸，好嗎？拉鉤？

scripts.text:
[Liana]
Mmmm...
But I don't know you!
Mom says I should never
ask for anything from strangers.
scripts.translation:
[莉安娜]
嗯...
但是我不認識你！
媽媽說，我不應該向陌生人索要任何東西。

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've freed up more inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在的物品欄太滿了。
請騰出一些空間後再來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Just as I suspected...
I didn't bring enough of them.
Hmm, this is serious. What
am I going to do about this?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
果然如我所料...
我帶的材料不夠。
嗯，這很嚴重。我該怎麼辦呢？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
I hope you understand that
this forge isn't really open to the public. I'm doing some intensive training,so I'd appreciate it if you would just leave now.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
希望你能理解，這個鐵匠鋪並不對外開放。我正在接受高強度訓練，所以請你們現在離開。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^333333*Sigh*^000000
It's been a long
time since I've seen
my family. I really should let them know how I'm doing sooner or later. Hmmm....
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
^333333*嘆氣*^000000
我已經很久沒見家人了。我遲早應該告訴他們我的近況。嗯....

scripts.text:
[Engel]
As I've told you before, I'm more likely to succeed in my work if I'm able to use a higher quality anvil. Let's me see what you've brought...
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
正如我之前所說，如果我能使用更高質量的鐵砧，我的成功率會更高。讓我看看你帶來了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Are you back already?
Sorry, but I haven't quite finished yet. I won't be done for a while, so why don't you deliver that letter to my family?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
你這麼快就回來了？
抱歉，我還沒完成。我還需要一段時間，所以你能幫我把那封信帶給我的家人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Are you back already?
While you were gone, I managed to restore this Sobbing Starlight. Why don't you go ahead and take a look?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
你這麼快就回來了？
趁你不在的時候，我修復了這塊星淚石。你要不要先看看？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
You've returned?
Well, I don't know how to put this, but once you hear it, don't take it the wrong way...
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
你回來了？
嗯，我不知道該怎麼說，但聽到後請不要誤會...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh good, you're back.
I've got some bad news,
so please don't overreact~
Um, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
太好了，你回來了。
我有個壞訊息，所以請不要反應過度~
嗯，你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Didn't I tell you to bring me a Golden Anvil or an Emperium Anvil? Anything less isn't good enough to do any restoration work on this Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
我不是讓你帶黃金鐵砧或華麗金屬鐵砧來嗎？比這更差的鐵砧，不足以對這塊星淚石進行修復工作。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Good, good.
I see that you've brought a Golden Anvil. Now I can get started right away! Still, I'm a little about those monsters showing up again, so would you keep a lookout?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
很好，很好。
看來你帶了黃金鐵砧。我現在可以馬上開始了！不過，我還是有點擔心那些魔物再次出現，所以你能幫我警戒一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Excellent! You've brought an Emperium Anvil! Now, keep a lookout for monsters while I repair these ore fragments. We can't have those beasts ruin my work again, right? Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
太棒了！你帶了華麗金屬鐵砧！現在，請幫我警戒魔物，我要修復這些礦石碎片。我們不能讓那些野獸再次毀了我的工作，對吧？謝謝你。

scripts.text: [Engel]
scripts.translation: [恩格爾]

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh, you don't have everything ready yet? Take your time, so long as you didn't forget what you needed to bring. You do remember, right?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
哦，你還沒準備好所有東西嗎？慢慢來，只要沒忘記需要帶什麼就行。你記得吧？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Still don't have everything ready? That's fine, just take your time. So long as you haven't forgotten all the things that you need. I mean, how can you forget when you have such an important ore on you?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
還是沒準備好嗎？沒關係，慢慢來。只要沒忘記所有需要的東西就好。畢竟，你身上帶著這麼重要的礦石，怎麼可能忘記呢？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
How have you been doing lately? Feel free to ask me if you ever think that you need my expertise, alright?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
最近過得怎麼樣？如果你覺得需要我的專業知識，隨時可以來找我，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
How have you been
doing lately? You seem
quite well. So is there anything
I can help you with today?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
最近過得怎麼樣？看起來氣色不錯。那麼，今天有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
It's so...
Beautiful! I don't know
if I'll ever see anything
like this again in my life...
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
真是...太美了！我不知道這輩子還能不能再看到這樣的東西...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
I haven't completed it yet, but please understand that I've got to be really careful when working with something so valuable. But don't worry, its inner power will be revealed when I'm finished.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
我還沒修好，但請理解，處理這麼珍貴的東西我必須非常小心。不過別擔心，等我修好後，它內在的力量就會顯現出來。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Sometimes, you can only
improve yourself by training in solitude. But don't ever forget about the ones who really care about you. It's those people who make everything worth it.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
有時候，你只能通過在孤獨中修煉來提升自己。但永遠不要忘記那些真正關心你的人。正是這些人讓一切變得值得。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh great! I see that you're
carrying some Iron Ores with you. Would you be so kind as to lend me 1 Iron Ore? Please, I beg of you...
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
太好了！我看你身上帶著一些鐵礦石。能借我一塊鐵礦石嗎？拜託了，求你了...

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 當然，為什麼不呢？

scripts.text: Sorry, I can't.
