scripts.translation: 抱歉，我不行。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Thank you so much!
If it weren't for your help,
I'd be in big trouble. I really appreciate you stepping in and volunteering your materials like this.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
非常感謝！如果沒有你的幫助，我就大難臨頭了。真的很感激你主動伸出援手，願意提供材料。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
I suppose I understand.
However, you're lucky that I don't kick you out of my forge right here and right now~
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
我想我理解你的意思。
不過，你運氣真好，我現在沒把你趕出我的鍛造爐~

scripts.text:
[Engel]
...?
Were you looking for me?
I'm sorry, but I'm busy at the moment. Please don't disturb me while I try to get my work done.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
...？
你在找我嗎？
抱歉，我現在很忙。請別打擾我，讓我專心工作。

scripts.text: I need your help.
scripts.translation: 我需要你的幫助。

scripts.text: Here is a letter for you.
scripts.translation: 這是給你的信。

scripts.text: I am leaving, leaving.
scripts.translation: 我要走了，再見。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Well, I'd like to help you,
but now isn't a good for me.
plenty of other good smiths out there who can help you with the work that you want done. Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
嗯，我想幫你，但現在不是好時機。
外面有很多優秀的鐵匠可以幫你完成你想做的活計。再見。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh, are you serious?
Let me read it first.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
哦，你是認真的嗎？
讓我先讀一下。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Yes, yes.
...Hahaha!
It's so good to hear from
my darling daughter.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
是的，是的。
...哈哈！
收到我親愛的女兒的信真好。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Thanks, I really appreciate that you've delivered this letter for me. Now, is there anything you'd like to ask of me? If it's not a big favor, I can probably help you.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
謝謝，真的很感激你幫我送這封信。那麼，你有什麼想讓我幫忙的嗎？如果不是太大的忙，我大概能幫上忙。

scripts.text: Please look at this.
scripts.translation: 請看看這個。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh?
Isn't this...?
I see, I see!
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
哦？
這不是……？
原來如此，原來如此！

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Long ago, my old master told me that there are these strange ores that have fallen from the sky. The most beautiful and mysterious is the one shines just like a star.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
很久以前，我的師父曾告訴我，有一種從天空墜落的奇異礦石。其中最美麗、最神秘的，是那種像星星一樣閃耀的礦石。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Most people may know it as Sobbing Starlight, but my master used to call it God's Tear Drop.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
大多數人可能知道它叫星淚石，但我的師父以前叫它“神之淚滴”。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
However, this ore has been shattered into pieces. Judging from the smoothness of the edges, its inner power must have caused it to break apart. So you want me to put this back together, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
然而，這塊礦石已經碎裂成了碎片。從邊緣的光滑程度來看，一定是其內部的力量導致它破裂的。所以，你是想讓我把它重新拼合起來，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
This will be a good challenge
for me! However, I'll need some
special tools and materials to repair this kind of ore. Now, I want you to bring me the following things...
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
這對我來說是個不錯的挑戰！不過，修復這種礦石需要一些特殊的工具和材料。現在，我想請你幫我收集以下物品……

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000,
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000,
and ^ff00001 good quality Anvil^000000.
Now keep in mind that ordinary anvils won't be good enough for
this kind of work.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
^FF00005 攜帶用熔礦爐^000000、
^FF00002 神之金屬錘子^000000，
以及 ^ff00001 高品質的鐵砧^000000。
請記住，普通的鐵砧不足以勝任這項工作。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Now, an Emperium Anvil would be ideal for this job. I used to have one, but a while back I ended up giving it to someone. Anyway, I'll wait here for you while you gather everything you need.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
對於這項工作，華麗金屬鐵砧是最理想的。我以前有一個，但不久前把它送給了別人。總之，我會在這裡等你，你去收集所需的一切吧。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Right. Let me guide you to a shortcut to the exit of these mines, just in case you don't know your way out of here. Good luck~
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
對了。讓我指引你一條通往礦洞出口的捷徑，以防你不知道怎麼出去。祝你好運~

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Alright, then.
Take care.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
那麼，就這樣吧。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
...?
Do you have any business
me? I'm sorry, but right
now I'm very busy. Please leave
me alone to my research.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
……？
你有事找我嗎？抱歉，我現在很忙。請讓我專心研究。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
A...
Regular Anvil?
Alright, I guess I'll try it.
But I can't guarantee success.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
啊……
普通鐵砧？
好吧，我想試試看。
但我不能保證成功。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Ah...
An Oridecon Avil.
This isn't too bad,
but there's a good risk
that this might not work.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
啊……
神之金屬鐵砧。
這還不錯，
但很有可能無法成功。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Ah...
A Golden Anvil.
This just might be able to do the job. This might take a while, so I have something to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
啊……
黃金鐵砧。
這個也許能勝任這項工作。這需要一些時間，所以我有一件事想拜託你。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh wow, an Emperium Anvil!
And this looks like one I might have actually made. Great, I should be able to do this so long as I don't make any critical mistakes~
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
哇，華麗金屬鐵砧！
而且這看起來像是我親手製作的。太好了，只要我不犯重大錯誤，應該就能修好~

scripts.text: [Engel]
scripts.translation: [恩格爾]

scripts.text:
[Engel]
While I'm working on this, would you deliver a letter to my family for me? I'm sorry, but please consider that I'm waiving the fee for restoring this Sobbing Starlight.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
在我工作的時候，你能幫我給家人送一封信嗎？抱歉，請把這視為我免除修復這塊星淚石的費用。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Well then...
I wish you safety
in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
那麼……
祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh, you don't have everything ready yet? Take your time, so long as you didn't forget what you needed to bring. You do remember, right?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
哦，你還沒準備好所有東西嗎？慢慢來，只要沒忘記需要帶什麼就行。你記得吧？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000,
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000,
and ^ff00001 good quality Anvil^000000.
That's all you need!
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
^FF00005 攜帶用熔礦爐^000000、
^FF00002 神之金屬錘子^000000，
以及 ^ff00001 高品質的鐵砧^000000。
這些就夠了！

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Remember that I have a greater chance of repairing the Sobbing Starlight if I have access to a higher quality Anvil. Otherwise...
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
請記住，如果我擁有更高質量的鐵砧，修復星淚石的成功率會更高。否則……

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Still don't have everything ready? That's fine, just take your time. So long as you haven't forgotten all the things that you need. I mean, how can you forget when you have such an important ore on you?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
還是沒準備好嗎？沒關係，慢慢來。只要沒忘記所有需要的東西就好。畢竟，你身上帶著這麼重要的礦石，怎麼可能忘記呢？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
This was one of the most difficult jobs I've ever done. But look! It was beautiful when broken in fragments but now it's absolutely dazzling! This was really worth my effort.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
這是我做過的最難的工作之一。但看！它破碎時很美，但現在絕對光彩奪目！這真的值得我付出努力。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
In any case, I worked really hard to do a good job on this, so I hope you treasure this Sobbling Starlight, young adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
總之，我努力做好了這項工作，所以我希望你能珍惜這塊星淚石，年輕的冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^333333*Ahem*^000000
Just as I've warned you, this attempt to restore the Sobbling Starlight failed because the anvil you gave me wasn't up to the job. I'm sorry about that.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
^333333*咳*^000000
正如我之前警告過你的，這次修復星淚石失敗了，因為你給我的鐵砧質量不夠。對此我很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
However, I only
broke all of the tools
and the ore pieces are still intact. Now, if you bring me the tools one more time, I can try this again.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
不過，我只是弄壞了所有的工具，礦石碎片依然完好無損。現在，如果你再給我帶一次工具，我可以再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Since I'm a bit more familiar with this material, I won't take so much time. Once again, let me tell you which things you need to bring...
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
既然我對這種材料更熟悉了，這次不會花太多時間。讓我再告訴你一次你需要帶什麼...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000,
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000,
and ^ff00001 good quality Anvil^000000.
And this time, bring
me a better anvil, huh?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
^FF00005 攜帶用熔礦爐^000000、
^FF00002 神之金屬錘子^000000，
以及 ^ff00001 高品質的鐵砧^000000。
這次，給我帶個更好的鐵砧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Although it'd be perfect if I had an Emperium Anvil, I'm pretty sure it'll be alright if we used a Golden Anvil.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
雖然如果有華麗金屬鐵砧就完美了，但我相信用黃金鐵砧也沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
While I was trying to restore the 
Sobbling Starlight, I was attacked 
by monsters all of a sudden. If only
I paid more attention to my
surroundings...
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
在我試圖修復星淚石的時候，突然被魔物襲擊了。要是我當時多注意一下週圍的情況就好了...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Please understand that I get very deeply engrossed in my smithing work. If you don't mind, I'll try this again you'll bring all the tools just like the last time.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
請理解，我在打鐵時非常投入。如果你不介意的話，只要你像上次一樣把所有工具都帶過來，我就再試一次。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000 and
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000.
Don't forget the ^FF0000Golden Anvil^000000! But if you can get your hands on one, an ^FF0000Emperium Anvil^000000 would be better.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
^FF00005 攜帶用熔礦爐^000000 和
^FF00002 神之金屬錘子^000000。
別忘了 ^FF0000黃金鐵砧^000000！但如果你能弄到 ^FF0000華麗金屬鐵砧^000000 就更好了。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Next time you come
here, bring a Golden or Emperium Anvil and make sure to leave all of your other anvils in Kafra Storage or something, okay?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
下次你來的時候，帶上黃金鐵砧或華麗金屬鐵砧，並確保把你其他的鐵砧都放在卡普拉倉庫裡，好嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Clink*
*Clink Clink Clink*
*Clink Clink Clink*
*Cliiiiiiiiiiiiink*^000000

^3355FF*Clink*
*Clink-Clink*
*Clink-Clink-Clink*
*Claaaaaaaaaaack*^000000

[Engel]
It's almost done.
Just be a bit more patient...
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
快完成了。
請再耐心等一下...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Finally... Completed.
^333333*Phew!*^000000 That was one of the toughest jobs I've ever done, but this was well worth all of our efforts. Just look at the dazzling beauty of this Sobbing Starlight!
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
終於...完成了。
^333333*呼！*^000000 這是我做過的最難的工作之一，但這值得我們要付出的所有努力。看看這塊星淚石那耀眼的美麗吧！

scripts.text:
[Engel]
We've both gone through a lot of trouble to make this, so I hope you treasure your Sobbing Starlight. Good luck on your adventures...
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
我們都經歷了很多麻煩才做成這個，所以我希望你能珍惜你的星淚石。祝你在冒險中好運...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
^FF00005 Mini Furnace^000000,
^FF00002 Oridecon Hammer^000000,
and ^ff00001 good quality Anvil^000000.
That's all you need!
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
^FF00005 攜帶用熔礦爐^000000、
^FF00002 神之金屬錘子^000000，
以及 ^ff00001 高品質的鐵砧^000000。
這些就夠了！

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Remember that I have a greater chance of repairing the Sobbing Starlight if I have access to a higher quality Anvil. Otherwise...
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
請記住，如果我擁有更高質量的鐵砧，修復星淚石的成功率會更高。否則……

scripts.text: I need your help again.
scripts.translation: 我需要你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Haha, so what have
you brought me this time?
It must be fairly important if you've brought it all the way
down here.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
哈哈，這次你帶給我什麼了？
既然你大老遠帶到這裡，一定挺重要的吧。

scripts.text: Please look at this.
scripts.translation: 請看看這個。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Isn't this...?!
Amazing, just by looking at it,
I can feel its power! You really
are something! How do you come across all of this amazing stuff?
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
這不是...？！
太棒了，光是看著它，
我就能感受到它的力量！你真是個了不起的人！你是怎麼找到這些神奇的東西的？

scripts.text:
[Engel]
You know, I consider myself
lucky to even see this kind of stuff. Most smiths might be able to see this kind of thing only once in their entire lives. And to be able to work on it...
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
你知道嗎，我覺得自己很幸運能看到這種東西。大多數鐵匠可能一輩子只能看到一次。而能親手打造它...

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Hmmm...
It's going to take quite
a while to work on this. Unfortunately, I can't even
give you a time estimate...
But I'll do my best for you.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
嗯...
打造這個需要相當長的時間。不幸的是，我甚至無法給你一個時間估計...
但我會盡我所能為你做的。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
Oh, you're back just in time.
Although it was one of my most difficult jobs, I believe you'll be pleased with my work. Only a few smiths are privileged enough to work with this, even just once.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
哦，你來得正是時候。
雖然這是我做過最困難的工作之一，但我相信你會對我的作品感到滿意。只有少數鐵匠才有幸能打造這種材料，哪怕只有一次。

scripts.text:
[Engel]
This is now yours to keep.
Thank you for giving me the
honor of working on a worthy
smithing challenge.
scripts.translation:
[恩格爾]
現在它歸你了。
謝謝你給我這個機會，讓我能參與這項配得上鐵匠的挑戰。

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Hmmm...
That can't be right...
What could possibly be
the answer I'm looking
for? ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
嗯...
這不對勁...
我到底在找什麼答案呢？^333333*嘆氣...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Wah~
Why the hell did he even go there...!
What are you doing here?!
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
哇~
他到底為什麼要去那裡...！
你在這裡幹什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
You're not even a Mage,
much less a Wizard, Sage, Warlock or a Sorcerer.
Why bother climbing this tower?
What are you doing here?!
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
你甚至不是個魔法師，
更別提巫師、賢者、大魔導士或妖術師了。
為什麼要爬這座塔？
你在這裡幹什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Eh?
Did you just say you're
here for Metz Brayde?
For that Sobbing Starlight, is that right?
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
咦？
你剛才說你是來找梅茨·布萊德的？
是為了那個星淚石，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Eh?
For that Sobbing Starlight, is that right?
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
咦？
是為了那個星淚石，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Eh?
Did you just say you're
here for Metz Brayde?
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
咦？
你剛才說你是來找梅茨·布萊德的？

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Eh?
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
咦？

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
...

[Dhota]
...
......
BWAAAAH~!
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
...
......
BWAAAAH~!

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Right, he wants that guy
who's good at working with
gems and stuff. Eh, he's not
here right now. Went somewhere
near Comodo to investigate some
tribal people or whatever.
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
對了，他想要那個擅長處理寶石之類東西的傢伙。呃，他現在不在這裡。去克魔島附近調查什麼部落的人了，之類的。

scripts.text:
[Dhota]
Say what...?
I have no idea what
you're talking about!
If you've got nothing
to say, then leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[多塔]
你說什麼...？
我完全不知道你在說什麼！
如果你沒什麼事，就讓我一個人待著！

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
Oh, I wish I had
a Mr. Smile mask!
But where can I get
one of those? Well, I'd
be happy if I had some
Meat to eat, I guess!
scripts.translation:
[老譚]
哦，我希望我有一張笑臉面具！
但我在哪裡能買到呢？嗯，如果我能吃點肉就好了，我想！

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
Mmm...?
A new guy in our village?
I think I know him! Yea, I do!
scripts.translation:
[老譚]
嗯...？
我們村來了個新面孔？
我想我認識他！是的，我認識！

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
I love my Mr. Smile mask
soooo much! I'm gonna show
it to all my friends! Thank you
so much again! You're really
really nice, you know that?
scripts.translation:
[老譚]
我太喜歡我的笑臉面具了！我要給所有朋友看看！再次非常感謝！你真的很好，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
Oh my gosh!
You've got a Mr. Smile mask!
Would you give that to me?
Pretty please...?
scripts.translation:
[老譚]
天哪！
你有一張笑臉面具！
你能把它給我嗎？
拜託了...？

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
Waaaait.
I knooow~!
I know if you get
me a Mr. Smile, okay?
scripts.translation:
[老譚]
等等。
我知道~！
如果你給我一張笑臉面具，好嗎？

scripts.text: Sure~
scripts.translation: 當然~

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
Hooooray!
Thank you thank you
thank you thank you
soooooooooo much!
scripts.translation:
[老譚]
耶——！
謝謝謝謝
謝謝謝謝
太謝謝你了！

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
Oh right~!
The weird man in the funny clothes was in our village for a while, but ever since he went into that big tree, nobody's seen him!
scripts.translation:
[老譚]
對了~！
那個穿著奇怪衣服的怪人，之前在我們村子裡待了一會兒，但自從他走進那棵大樹後，就再也沒人見過他了！

scripts.text:
[Laotan]
I...
I was...
I just...
Waaaaaaahhhh!
scripts.translation:
[老譚]
我...
我...
我只是...
哇啊啊啊——！

scripts.text:
[??????]
Chuuuba?
Chu-chu-chu-chu-chaba?
Oom oom oom daba. Blip blip?
Sabaloo koombah Solo. Ho ho~
scripts.translation:
[??????]
楚巴？
楚-楚-楚-楚-巴？
噢姆 噢姆 噢姆 達巴。嗶嗶？
薩巴魯 庫姆巴 索羅。呵呵~

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've freed up more inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在的物品欄太滿了。
請騰出一些空間後再來。^000000

scripts.text:
^333333*Giggle*^000000
So if I do this,
then that and then...
Ooh, these calculations
are absolutely perfect!
scripts.translation:
^333333*輕笑*^000000
如果這樣，然後那樣，再然後...
噢，這些計算
簡直完美無缺！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Wh-what?!
Who are you?
H-how did you get
in here? I demand
that you leave, right now!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
什-什麼？！
你是誰？
你-你怎麼
進來的？我命令
你立刻離開，馬上！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
^333333*Giggle*^000000
So if I do this,
then that and then...
Ooh, these calculations
are absolutely perfect!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
^333333*輕笑*^000000
如果這樣，然後那樣，再然後...
噢，這些計算
簡直完美無缺！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Wh-what?!
Who are you?
H-how did you get
in here? I demand
that you leave, right now!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
什-什麼？！
你是誰？
你-你怎麼
進來的？我命令
你立刻離開，馬上！

scripts.text: I'm here for Metz Brayde.
scripts.translation: 我是來找梅茨·佈雷德的。

scripts.text: My apologies.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text: Would you look at this?
scripts.translation: 你看看這個？

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Huh? Brayde?
Do you expect me
to just trust you without
a single shred of proof that
he sent you? Get out now!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
嗯？佈雷德？
你指望我
在沒有絲毫證據證明
是他派你來的情況下
就相信你的話？
現在立刻滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
If you're so sorry,
then hurry up and get
out of here! Not just anyone
is allowed here! Leave!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
如果你這麼抱歉，
那就趕緊滾出去！
不是誰都能進來的！
離開！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
What could be so
special about what
you've brought here?!
Fine, you've piqued my
scientific curiosity...
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
你帶來的東西
有什麼特別之處？！
好吧，你引起了我的
科學好奇心...

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Sweet lord...
This is 'God's Tear Drop!'
The Sobbling Starlight!
He finally made it....
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
天哪...
這是“神之淚滴”！
星淚石！
他終於做到了....

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
^333333*Giggle*^000000
Well, since he's kept his promise, I suppose that I should keep mine
as well. Now, within this Sobbing Starlight are these tiny letters... ^FFFFFFcobo^000000
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
^333333*輕笑*^000000
既然他信守了承諾，我想我也應該信守我的承諾。現在，在這塊星淚石裡有一些微小的文字... ^FFFFFFcobo^000000

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
The text is so small that even Hunters skilled in Vulture's Eye are unable to read them. However, I've read that this Sobbing
Starlight will respond
to really old papers...
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
文字太小了，即使是擅長蒼鷹之眼的獵人也無法閱讀。不過，我讀到過這塊星淚石會對非常古老的紙張產生反應...

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Now, if we want to figure out
what's written in the Sobbing
Starlight, we'd need at least
10 ancient pieces of paper...
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
現在，如果我們想弄清楚
星淚石裡寫了什麼，
我們至少需要
10張古老的紙張...

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Not listening, eh?
Fine, if you don't
understand words, then
I'll have to use force!
Get out here right now!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
不聽嗎？
好吧，如果你聽不懂
人話，那我就只能用
武力了！
現在立刻給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
You've come back.
I hope you were able
to find some ancient
or really aged paper...
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
你回來了。
我希望你能找到
一些古老的
或者非常陳舊的紙張...

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
How did you find these
Worn Out Pages? This is great,
I'm sure the Sobbing Starlight
will respond to these!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
你是怎麼找到這些
廢棄雜誌的？太好了，
我相信星淚石
會對這些產生反應！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Yes. Yes...
This should be enough.
Now give them to me
and wait here while
I try a few things...
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
是的。是的...
這些應該足夠了。
現在把它們給我，
然後在這裡等著，
我要嘗試一些事情...

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Just as I thought!
The Sobbing Starlight is responding to these Worn Out Pages! Excellent! I've finally fulfilled my promise to Metz! Now he can leave
me alone!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
果然如此！
星淚石對這些破舊紙張有反應！太好了！我終於兌現了對梅茨的承諾！現在他可以別來煩我了！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
How did you find these
^FF0000Worn Out Pages^000000? This is great,
I'm sure the Sobbing Starlight
will respond to these!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
你是怎麼找到這些
^FF0000破舊紙張^000000的？太好了，
我相信星淚石
會對這些產生反應！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
Wait, we don't have enough
of them to make the Sobbing
Starlight respond. Find more
of these papers and bring
them all to me!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
等等，我們還沒有足夠的
紙張讓星淚石產生反應。
去找更多這樣的紙張，
然後全部帶給我！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
You haven't found anything?
What kind of scientist are you?
Now go out and find some old and ancient papers so that we can learn what's written in the Sobbing Starlight! Go!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
你什麼都沒找到？
你是什麼科學家？
現在出去找一些古老陳舊的紙張，
這樣我們才能知道星淚石上寫了什麼！快去吧！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
...?
Why are you still here?
Leave and do what I told
you to do, alright?! Don't
make me get violent...
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
...？
你為什麼還在這裡？
離開，去做我讓你做的事，好嗎？！
別逼我動手...

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
My business with you is finished, so you go along on your way now. And tell Metz not to bother me anymore! I'm done doing favors!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
我和你的事結束了，所以你現在可以走了。告訴梅茨別再煩我了！我不想再幫這種忙了！

scripts.text:
[Cyon]
How dare you intrude
on my property?! Now,
get out now before I get
violent! Didn't you hear me?
GET OUT OF HERE!
scripts.translation:
[賽昂]
你竟敢闖入我的地盤？！
現在，在我動手之前
趕緊滾出去！你沒聽到嗎？
給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait a second! Right now,
you have too many items in your inventory. Please come back after you've freed up more inventory space.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等一下！
你現在的物品欄太滿了。
請騰出一些空間後再來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Frank]
My back~
It's so sore!
And my eyes are
hurting worse and worse.
^333333*Sigh*^000000 I'm getting old...
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
我的背...
好酸！
而且我的眼睛
越來越疼了。
^333333*嘆氣*^000000 我老了...

scripts.text:
[Frank]
My vision's getting
blurrier and I get headaches
when I read. I guess this old
man's got no choice but to get
some sort of seeing aid...
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
我的視力越來越模糊，
看書時還會頭痛。我想這個老頭
不得不找點助視工具了...

scripts.text:
[Frank]
I've finally completed the translation. It was a challenge deciphering the meaning of some
of these words. Even translated in our own language, this contents of this text are fairly ambiguous.
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
我終於完成了翻譯。解讀其中一些詞的含義是個挑戰。即使翻譯成我們的語言，這段文字的內容也相當晦澀難懂。

scripts.text:
[Frank]
I'm sorry, but I haven't finished translating this text. It's taking quite a long time since I don't have any reference material for this particular language. Why
don't you come back later?
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
抱歉，我還沒翻譯完這段文字。由於我沒有這種特定語言的參考資料，所以花了不少時間。
你稍後再來好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Frank]
There are many things out
there that defy our understanding of the world and are beyond our imagination. Many fear the unknown, but the truly brave will always seek out the truth.
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
世界上有很多事物超出了我們的理解，甚至超出了我們的想像。許多人害怕未知，但真正的勇者總會去探尋真相。

scripts.text: Wait, I've got a pair of glasses...
scripts.translation: 等等，我有一副眼鏡...

scripts.text: Pass on by.
scripts.translation: 路過而已

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Oh, you've brought me
these Glasses? Thanks
so much, youngster. Now that
I can see better, what can
I do for you in return?
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
哦，你帶給我
這副眼鏡？太感謝了，年輕人。現在我看清楚了，
我能為你做些什麼作為回報呢？

scripts.text: About Geffen's Hidden Power
scripts.translation: 關於吉芬的隱藏力量

scripts.text: About Sobbing Starlight
scripts.translation: 關於星淚石

scripts.text: Interpret Ancient Document
scripts.translation: 解讀古代文獻

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Geffen's hidden power?
I don't know much about it, but I'm sure that Geffen Tower is more than just a simple building. I'm sure it was created to restrain or contain some powerful force.
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
吉芬的隱藏力量？
我不太瞭解，但我確信吉芬中央塔不僅僅是一座普通的建築。我相信它是為了束縛或容納某種強大的力量而建造的。

scripts.text:
[Frank]
It's even possible that the fountain in front of Geffen Tower also plays the same role, but I've got no hard evidence. Since I'm not too interested in Geffen, I haven't really investigated...
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
吉芬中央塔前的噴泉也可能扮演著同樣的角色，但我沒有確鑿的證據。因為我對吉芬不太感興趣，所以並沒有深入調查...

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Still...
There's a strong possibility that some enormous power is being sealed beneath the Geffen Tower.
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
不過...
吉芬中央塔下極有可能封印著某種巨大的力量。

scripts.text:
[Frank]
The Sobbing Starlight?
To the experts, it's known as God's Tear Drop. Now, some believe it was created from the voice of God.
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
星淚石？
在行家眼中，它被稱為“神之淚”。據說，它是用神的聲音凝結而成的。

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Of course, it probably isn't made from God's voice or tear drops, but who knows? In any case, it's said that something's written in the Sobbing Starlight. What ever it is, it must be something important...
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
當然，它可能並非由神的聲音或淚水製成，但誰知道呢？總之，據說星淚石上記載著某些內容。無論那是什麼，一定非常重要...

scripts.text:
[Frank]
I don't believe it!
This is... I see. You want me to translate this ancient language. Ah, you're rather fortunate. I'm probably the only person in the world who can translate this.
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
我不信！
這是...我明白了。你想讓我解讀這種古代語言。啊，你運氣真好。我大概是世上唯一能解讀這種語言的人了。

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Hmm, as far as I can tell, this is a sophisticated language spoken by the ancient gods. It's complex and confusing, but I'll do my best for you. Come back to me later, and I'll what I've learned.
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
嗯，據我觀察，這是古代神祇使用的一種複雜語言。雖然晦澀難懂，但我會盡力為你解讀。稍後回來找我，我會告訴你我的發現。

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Oooh~
How will I ever
be able to continue
my life's work? I'm
helpless if I can't read...
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
噢~
如果讀不了書，
我該如何繼續
我的畢生事業？
我簡直無能為力...

scripts.text:
[Frank]
Well, I've written down the best translation that I could for you. It's been a long time since I've had this kind of challenge. Thanks, youngster.
Ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[弗蘭克]
好了，我為你寫下了我能做到的最佳譯文。很久沒有遇到這麼有挑戰性的任務了。謝謝你，年輕人。
哈哈~

scripts.text:
^6B8E23It seems that
something in the
vicinity is reacting
with the Sobbing Starlight
in your possession. Perhaps
you can find it nearby...^000000
scripts.translation:
^6B8E23似乎附近有什麼東西
正在與你持有的星淚石
產生反應。
也許你可以在附近找到它...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the...?
What's happening?!

^3355FFFor some reason, in
this particular spot, the
Sobbing Starlight is reacting
with the Resin, Stone Hearts
and Coral Reefs that you're
holding. All the objects are
violently resonating...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF不知為何，
在這個特定的地點，
星淚石正在與你持有的
樹脂、石心和珊瑚
產生反應。所有物品
都在劇烈共鳴...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAll of a sudden these
objects emit a bright flash
of light that envelops your
entire body, then you gently
fall into unconsciousness...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF突然，
這些物品發出耀眼的強光，
籠罩了你的全身，
隨後你緩緩陷入了昏迷...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFNothing seems to
happen when you
approach this area now.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF現在，
當你接近這個區域時，
似乎什麼也沒有發生。^000000

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Only the chosen
can enter this place.
I will not ask how you've
gained entrance, but I will
require you to leave.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
只有被選中的人
才能進入此地。
我不會詢問你是如何獲得進入資格的，
但我要求你離開。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Welcome, {0},
to this realm of holiness.
You have endured great difficulty and tested your courage to obtain the Sobbing Starlight, which will be the certificate for your test.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
歡迎，{0}，
來到這片神聖之地。
你歷經重重艱難，考驗了你的勇氣，
獲得了星淚石，
它將作為你通過考驗的證明。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
I commend your ability
to survive in the realm
of the dead. I imagine it
must be very difficult for
a mortal to endure its cruelty.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
我讚賞你在亡者之域
生存下來的能力。
我想，對於凡人來說，
忍受那裡的殘酷一定非常困難。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Regrettably, I can't really
provide any answers for you.
You must overcome the ordeals
of the gods on your own. All I can do is offer my guidance and prayer. ^FFFFFFcobo^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
遺憾的是，我無法真正
為你解答。
你必須獨自克服神祇的考驗。
我能做的，只有提供指引和祈禱。 ^FFFFFFcobo^000000

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Welcome back.
Not only have you passed the trials that the gods have set for you, you have tested your courage in the realm of the dead and protected Midgard from attack.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
歡迎回來。
你不僅通過了神祇為你設定的考驗，
還在亡者之域考驗了你的勇氣，
並保護了米德加爾特免受攻擊。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
The gods are watching
you. Prove your courage,
and at that moment, you
will earn the honor of being
selected by the gods.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
神祇正在注視著你。
證明你的勇氣，
在那一刻，
你將獲得被神祇選中的榮耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
You have yet to
fully prove your courage.
Once you do, you will be
summoned by the gods.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
你尚未完全
證明你的勇氣。
一旦你做到了，
你將被神祇召喚。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
The gods are disappointed
in what you have decided to
do. Unfortunately, you have
been banished from Valhalla
and this place as well.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
神祇對你所做出的決定感到失望。
不幸的是，你已被放逐出瓦爾哈拉，
以及此地。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Great warrior,
your time has not yet
come. Please focus on
your training until you
are summoned by the gods...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
偉大的戰士，
你的時刻尚未到來。
請專注於訓練，
直到被神祇召喚...

scripts.text: Test...?

[Valkyrie Sandra]
The gods have decided that
you are worthy of undergoing
a special test that will judge
your merits. If you are a true
hero who is pure of heart,
you will certainly succeed...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
神祇已決定，你有資格接受一項特殊的考驗，
以評判你的功績。
如果你是一位心地純潔的真正英雄，
你一定會成功...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Now, there is a critical
situation in the ^FF0000realm where
the fallen warriors dwell^000000. The
gods wish for you to restore the balance by quelling a specific
evil influence in that place.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
現在，^FF0000亡者之域^000000正處於危急狀況。
神祇希望你能平息那裡的特定邪惡影響，
以恢復平衡。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
There will be many obstacles.
First, the fallen, who will target their anger and hatred towards
you. Where they have failed to
enter Valhalla, you have a rare
and wondrous opportunity...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
你將面臨許多障礙。
首先，是那些未能進入瓦爾哈拉的亡者，
他們會將憤怒和仇恨指向你。
你擁有他們未曾擁有的罕見而奇妙的機會...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Secondly, and more
importantly, you must find
this evil influence on your
own. This will judge your
ability to discern good from evil. Do not trust appearances...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
其次，也是更重要的是，
你必須獨自找到這股邪惡影響。
這將考驗你辨別善惡的能力。
不要相信表象...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
This is your task.
I cannot tell you more.
It is now your duty to
travel there and ferret
out true darkness from
one of the hearts there...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
這就是你的任務。
我無法告訴你更多。
現在，你的職責是前往那裡，
從那裡某人的心中
揪出真正的黑暗...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Remember that the
demonstration of your belief,
rather than the decision to
blindly adhere to faith, is
what the gods want to see.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
請記住，神祇希望看到的是
你信仰的展現，
而非盲目堅守信仰的決定。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Always step forward
with wisdom and courage.
That is all I can tell you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
永遠帶著智慧和勇氣前進。
這就是我能告訴你的全部。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
I'm pleased to announce that the gods have been watching you and decided to invite you to Valhalla. However, Midgard still has great need of you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
我很高興宣佈，神祇一直在注視著你，
並決定邀請你進入瓦爾哈拉。
然而，米德加爾特仍然非常需要你。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
As a symbol of this promise to invite you to Valhalla, you shall be rewarded with 'The Sign' which will show all others that you are a great warrior whose courage was tested by the gods themselves.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
作為邀請你進入瓦爾哈拉的承諾象徵，
你將獲得“標示”，
它將向所有人展示，
你是一位勇氣經受過神祇考驗的偉大戰士。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Congratulations,
{0}. Verily,
you are an honorable
hero worthy of praise!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
恭喜你，
{0}。
誠然，
你是一位值得讚揚的
榮譽英雄！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Sandra]
Although you have failed,
I hope that you find your
another way to win back
the favor of the gods...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 桑德拉]
雖然你失敗了，
但我希望你能找到另一種方式，
重新贏得神祇的青睞...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
....?

[Serin]
As its magic power grows,
the Magic Circle is nearing completion. The symbol which I've asked you for is the last material needed for summoning Dark Lord.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
隨著魔力的增長，
魔法陣即將完成。
我向你索要的那個符號，
是召喚暗黑之王所需的最後材料。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
However, the power of that
symbol can be used to complete
the Magic Circle or destroy it.
Would you hand it over to me?
I choose to destroy this...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
然而，那個符號的力量
既可以用來完成魔法陣，
也可以用來摧毀它。
你願意把它交給我嗎？
我選擇摧毀它...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Please...
Let me have the symbol.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
請...
把符號給我。

scripts.text: Give Serin the symbol.
scripts.translation: 把符號交給賽琳

scripts.text:
[Serin]
This could be
pretty dangerous
so please step back...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
這可能會很危險，
請退後...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I'm sorry.
But I have to do this
to summon Dark Lord.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
對不起。
但我必須這樣做，
才能召喚出暗黑之王。

scripts.text: But why...?
scripts.translation: 但為什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
It was never the witch
that wanted Dark Lord summoned,
but me. I've always wanted to return to my human form. I'm sick and tired of being bound here in Niflheim!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
想要召喚暗黑之王的
從來都不是那個女巫，
而是我。我一直都想變回人類。
我受夠了被束縛在尼弗爾海姆！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Unfortunately, the symbol
which Lady Hell gave you is
limited to a one time use. Its
power wasn't enough to bring me
back, so summoning Dark Lord is
my last chance.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
不幸的是，地獄夫人
給你的那個符號
只能使用一次。它的力量
不足以讓我復活，
所以召喚暗黑之王
是我最後的機會。

scripts.text: But if Dark Lord comes to Midgard...
scripts.translation: 但如果暗黑之王來到米德加爾特...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Oh, I'm pretty sure of
what will happen if Dark Lord
enters the realm of the living. He'll destroy Midgard and bring death to thousands and thousands of people.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
哦，我很清楚
如果暗黑之王進入生者的世界
會發生什麼。他會摧毀米德加爾特，
讓成千上萬的人死亡。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
So if I came back to life
and everyone else were dead,
However, by summoning Dark Lord,
you might be thinking it'd be pretty pointless for me to come back. But you know what? I don't care.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
如果我復活了，
而其他人全都死了，
不過，通過召喚暗黑之王，
你可能覺得我回來也沒什麼意義。但你知道嗎？我不在乎。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
The living don't appreciate
what they have, so they ought
to be punished. They can all go to Niflheim while I enjoy the warmth of the sun and the fresh outside air.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
活著的人不懂得珍惜
他們擁有的東西，
所以他們應該受到懲罰。
讓他們都去尼弗爾海姆吧，
而我要享受陽光的溫暖和
清新的空氣。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Maybe you might not
pity my situation since you've
never been bound to Niflheim,
but I'm begging you. Don't get
in my way.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
也許你並不同情我的處境，
因為你從未被束縛在尼弗爾海姆，
但我求求你。別擋我的路。

scripts.text: Alright. I'll let you go.
scripts.translation: 好吧。我讓你走。

scripts.text: No, you have to be stopped.
scripts.translation: 不，你必須被阻止。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Are you really willing
to throw so much away for
my sake? You do understand
that you'll be failing the ordeals set before you by the gods...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你真的願意
為了我放棄這麼多嗎？
你知道這會違背
眾神為你設定的試煉...

scripts.text: I changed my mind for Midgard.
scripts.translation: 為了米德加爾特，我改變主意了。

scripts.text: I do, and it's alright...
scripts.translation: 我知道，沒關係...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
...
I really don't want to fight you,
but I've come too far to give up now. If you insist on interfering, then you leave me no choice...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
...
我真的不想和你戰鬥，
但我已經走到這一步了，
不能放棄。如果你堅持要干涉，
那就別怪我不客氣了...

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033Insolent mortal!
Do you really think
you have a chance of
stopping me? Hmpf.
Every fool must learn.
Prepare to die!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033無禮的凡人！
你真以為
你有機會
阻止我嗎？哼。
每個傻瓜都必須付出代價。
準備受死吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Serin]
The least I can
do is send you back
to Midgard and
ask the Dark Lord to spare
you. Thank you so much...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我至少能做的
就是把你送回米德加爾特，
並請求暗黑之王
放過你。非常感謝...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
...
I really don't want to fight you,
but I've come too far to give up now. If you insist on interfering, then you leave me no choice...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
...
我真的不想和你戰鬥，
但我已經走到這一步了，
不能放棄。如果你堅持要干涉，
那就別怪我不客氣了...

scripts.text:
[Dark Lord]
^330033Insolent mortal!
Do you really think
you have a chance of
stopping me? Hmpf.
Every fool must learn.
Prepare to die!^000000
scripts.translation:
[暗黑之王]
^330033無禮的凡人！
你真以為
你有機會
阻止我嗎？哼。
每個傻瓜都必須付出代價。
準備受死吧！^000000

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I see now.
Soon, I'll lose my memories
and remain dead in Niflheim.
Just like all the others. Still,
may I ask you one question?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我明白了。
很快，我就會失去記憶，
永遠死在尼弗爾海姆。
就像其他人一樣。不過，
我能問你一個問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
With that symbol, you
could order the dead to do
whatever you want. Why didn't
you use it to command me to quit?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
用那個符號，
你可以命令死者
做任何你想做的事。為什麼你
不用它來命令我放棄呢？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I see it now.
The kindness in your eyes
tells me everything. You wanted to give me another chance. But in the end, I managed to destroy the
chance you had given me.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我現在明白了。
你眼中的善意告訴我了一切。你想再給我一次機會。但最終，是我親手毀掉了你給我的這份機會。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Even though I'm nothing but
a spirit now, it was an honor
for me to meet somebody like you. Although I'll lose my memories, I'll try not to forget you.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
即使我現在只是一縷殘魂，能遇到你這樣的人，也是我的榮幸。雖然我會失去記憶，但我會努力記住你的。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
My memories of your
courage and kindness
are more precious to
me than life itself.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我對你的勇氣和善意留下的記憶，比生命本身更珍貴。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Farewell, now.
And good luck on
your travels, my friend...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
再見了。
願你在旅途中一切順利，我的朋友...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou helped the
unconscious Serin
and returned to Niflheim.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你幫助了昏迷的賽琳，
並返回了尼弗爾海姆。^000000

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Even though you tried
to stop me, I still don't wish
to take your life. I understand
that you've merely trying to
protect your Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
儘管你試圖阻止我，但我仍無意奪走你的性命。我明白，你只是在試圖保護你的米德加爾特。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
However...
I do not think you
have the courage to
overcome the ordeals 
of the gods. Please don't
come here anymore...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
但是...
我不認為你有勇氣
克服諸神的試煉。請不要再
來這裡了...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Farewell...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
再見...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Haven't you
given up yet?
Please don't
try to stop me!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你還沒
放棄嗎？
請別
試圖阻止我！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Even though you tried
to stop me, I still don't wish
to take your life. I understand
that you've merely trying to
protect your Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
儘管你試圖阻止我，但我仍無意奪走你的性命。我明白，你只是在試圖保護你的米德加爾特。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
However...
I do not think you
have the courage to
overcome the ordeals 
of the gods. Please don't
come here anymore...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
但是...
我不認為你有勇氣
克服諸神的試煉。請不要再
來這裡了...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Farewell...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
再見...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Haven't you
given up yet?
Please don't
try to stop me!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你還沒
放棄嗎？
請別
試圖阻止我！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Let me guide
you to where
you belong.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
讓我指引你
去往
你該去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
You're finally here.
That witch has been watching
my every move, so she probably
knows what I'm up to by now...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你終於來了。
那個女巫一直在監視我的一舉一動，
所以她大概已經知道我的計劃了...

scripts.text: Why are you doing this...
scripts.translation: 你為什麼要這樣做...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
You don't understand
the horrific experience
of being bound to Niflheim.
I'm sick of breathing death
and feeding on despair.
I want to live again!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你無法理解被束縛在尼弗爾海姆的恐怖經歷。
我厭倦了呼吸死亡的氣息，以絕望為食。
我想再次活下去！

scripts.text: Is that why you want Dark Lord...?
scripts.translation: 這就是你想要暗黑之王的原因嗎...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Unfortunately, the symbol
which Lady Hell gave you is
limited to a one time use. Its
power wasn't enough to bring me
back, so summoning Dark Lord is
my last chance.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
不幸的是，地獄夫人
給你的那個符號
只能使用一次。它的力量
不足以讓我復活，
所以召喚暗黑之王
是我最後的機會。

scripts.text: But if Dark Lord comes to Midgard...
scripts.translation: 但如果暗黑之王來到米德加爾特...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Oh, I'm pretty sure of
what will happen if Dark Lord
enters the realm of the living. He'll destroy Midgard and bring death to thousands and thousands of people.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
哦，我很清楚
如果暗黑之王進入生者的世界
會發生什麼。他會摧毀米德加爾特，
讓成千上萬的人死亡。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
So if I came back to life
and everyone else were dead,
However, by summoning Dark
Lord, you might be thinking it'd be pretty pointless for me to come back. But I don't care.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
如果我復活了，而其他人全都死了，
不過，通過召喚暗黑之王，你可能覺得我復活也沒什麼意義。但我不在乎。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
The living don't appreciate
what they have, so they ought
to be punished. They can all go to Niflheim while I enjoy the warmth of the sun and the fresh outside air. Everyone should die...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
活著的人不懂得珍惜他們所擁有的，所以他們應該受到懲罰。讓他們都去尼弗爾海姆吧，而我要享受陽光的溫暖和戶外的新鮮空氣。所有人都該死...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Maybe you might not
pity my situation since you've
never been bound to Niflheim,
but I'm begging you. Don't get
in my way, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
也許你從未被束縛在尼弗爾海姆，所以不會同情我的處境，但我求求你。別擋我的路，{0}。

scripts.text: I can't let you do this!
scripts.translation: 我不能讓你這麼做！

scripts.text: Okay, have it your way.
scripts.translation: 好吧，隨你吧。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Are you really willing
to throw so much away for
my sake? You do understand
that you'll be failing the ordeals set before you by the gods...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你真的願意
為了我放棄這麼多嗎？
你知道這會違背
眾神為你設定的試煉...

scripts.text: I changed my mind for Midgard.
scripts.translation: 為了米德加爾特，我改變主意了。

scripts.text: I do, and it's alright...
scripts.translation: 我知道，沒關係...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
The least I can
do is send you back
to Midgard and
ask the Dark Lord to spare
you. Thank you so much...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我至少能做的
就是把你送回米德加爾特，
並請求暗黑之王
放過你。非常感謝...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
If you think that
I can't summon Dark Lord
without the symbol, then you're
mistaken. I've been collecting
the power of despair!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
如果你認為沒有象徵物
我就無法召喚暗黑之王，
那你可就錯了。
我一直在收集絕望的力量！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Do you remember what
happened to the dead that you
helped on my behalf? Even if they seemed to have found shelter at first, they cannot escape my
deep hollow of despair...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你還記得那些
你受我之託幫助的靈魂嗎？
即使他們起初看似找到了庇護，
也無法逃脫我深不見底的絕望深淵...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
And that poor little girl,
Alakina Anne? She still
hasn't realized that she's dead!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
還有那個可憐的小女孩，
阿拉基娜·安？
她到現在都還沒意識到
自己已經死了！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
You gave her hope,
but ultimately, you can't
keep your promise to bring her home. Oh, her disappointment
must be so crushing...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你給了她希望，
但最終，你無法兌現
送她回家的承諾。
噢，她的失望
一定非常沉重...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Yes...
By trying to help,
you gave them nothing
but pain, just as I planned.
Now I have enough despair
to summon Dark Lord!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
是的...
通過試圖幫助他們，
你只給他們帶來了痛苦，
正如我所計劃的那樣。
現在我有足夠的絕望
來召喚暗黑之王了！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I don't want us to fight,
but I can't let you stop me.
I've already sold my soul to
Dark Lord to become a living
human again so I can't give up
now! We'll have to battle!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我不想和你戰鬥，
但我不能讓你阻止我。
為了再次成為活人，
我已經把靈魂賣給了暗黑之王，
所以我不能放棄！
我們不得不戰鬥！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
If you think that
I can't summon Dark Lord
without the symbol, then you're
mistaken. I've been collecting
the power of despair!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
如果你認為沒有象徵物
我就無法召喚暗黑之王，
那你可就錯了。
我一直在收集絕望的力量！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
What most adventurers
don't know is that many of the
souls in Niflheim are simply
doomed to suffer. That's the
nature of this realm and one
of the rules of balance...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
大多數冒險者不知道的是，
尼弗爾海姆的許多靈魂
註定要受苦。
這是這個領域的本質，
也是平衡法則之一...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
It was child's play to ask
some adventurers to help
these souls. But once they learn that these souls can't be helped,
it's too late! In failing them, the adventurers add to their despair!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
讓一些冒險者去幫助
這些靈魂易如反掌。
但一旦他們發現這些靈魂無法被拯救，
就太晚了！在讓他們失望的同時，
冒險者也在增加他們的絕望！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
And by increasing
the despair here, it
also adds to the power I'll
use to summon Dark Lord!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
而通過增加這裡的絕望，
也增加了我用來
召喚暗黑之王的力量！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I don't want us to fight,
but I can't let you stop me.
I've already sold my soul to
Dark Lord to become a living
human again so I can't give up
now! We'll have to battle!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我不想和你戰鬥，
但我不能讓你阻止我。
為了再次成為活人，
我已經把靈魂賣給了暗黑之王，
所以我不能放棄！
我們不得不戰鬥！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I see now.
Soon, I'll lose my memories
and remain dead in Niflheim.
Just like all the others. Still,
may I ask you one question?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我明白了。
很快，我就會失去記憶，
永遠死在尼弗爾海姆。
就像其他人一樣。不過，
我能問你一個問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
With that symbol, you
could order the dead to do
whatever you want. Why didn't
you use it to command me to quit?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
用那個符號，
你可以命令死者
做任何你想做的事。為什麼你
不用它來命令我放棄呢？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I see it now.
The kindness in your eyes
tells me everything. You wanted to give me another chance. But in the end, I managed to destroy the
chance you had given me.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我現在明白了。
你眼中的善意告訴我了一切。你想再給我一次機會。但最終，是我親手毀掉了你給我的這份機會。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Even though I'm nothing but
a spirit now, it was an honor
for me to meet somebody like you. Although I'll lose my memories, I'll try not to forget you.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
即使我現在只是一縷殘魂，能遇到你這樣的人，也是我的榮幸。雖然我會失去記憶，但我會努力記住你的。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
My memories of your
courage and kindness
are more precious to
me than life itself.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我對你的勇氣和善意留下的記憶，比生命本身更珍貴。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Farewell, now.
And good luck on
your travels, my friend...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
再見了。
願你在旅途中一切順利，我的朋友...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou helped the
unconscious Serin
and returned to Niflheim.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你幫助了昏迷的賽琳，
並返回了尼弗爾海姆。^000000

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Even though you tried
to stop me, I still don't wish
to take your life. I understand
that you've merely trying to
protect your Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
儘管你試圖阻止我，但我仍無意奪走你的性命。我明白，你只是在試圖保護你的米德加爾特。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
However...
I do not think you
have the courage to
overcome the ordeals 
of the gods. Please don't
come here anymore...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
但是...
我不認為你有勇氣
克服諸神的試煉。請不要再
來這裡了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFSerin took
1 Witch's Tonic
from you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF賽琳從你這裡
拿走了1瓶魔女藥水。^000000

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I'm sorry...
But I'm taking
your Witch's Tonic
to help me summon
Dark Lord. Farewell...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
對不起...
但我要拿走你的魔女藥水
來幫助我召喚暗黑之王。
再見...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Haven't you
given up yet?
Please don't
try to stop me!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你還沒
放棄嗎？
請別
試圖阻止我！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Even though you tried
to stop me, I still don't wish
to take your life. I understand
that you've merely trying to
protect your Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
儘管你試圖阻止我，但我仍無意奪走你的性命。我明白，你只是在試圖保護你的米德加爾特。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
However...
I do not think you
have the courage to
overcome the ordeals 
of the gods. Please don't
come here anymore...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
但是...
我不認為你有勇氣
克服諸神的試煉。請不要再
來這裡了...

scripts.text:
^3355FFSerin took
1 Witch's Tonic
from you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF賽琳從你這裡
拿走了1瓶魔女藥水。^000000

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I'm sorry...
But I'm taking
your Witch's Tonic
to help me summon
Dark Lord. Farewell...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
對不起...
但我要拿走你的魔女藥水
來幫助我召喚暗黑之王。
再見...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Haven't you
given up yet?
Please don't
try to stop me!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你還沒
放棄嗎？
請別
試圖阻止我！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Let me guide
you to where
you belong.
.......
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
讓我指引你
去往你該去的地方。
.......

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I'm sorry,
but you're not
the person I'm
looking for. No...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
對不起，
你不是我在找的人。
不...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Kind adventurer...
You're the one I'm looking
for, the one who's been on
a long journey to prove
his courage.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
善良的冒險者...
你就是我在找的人，
那個為了證明勇氣
而踏上漫長旅程的人。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Kind adventurer...
You're the one I'm looking
for, the one who's been on
a long journey to prove
her courage.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
善良的冒險者...
你就是我在找的人，
那個為了證明勇氣
而踏上漫長旅程的人。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Even in the darkness of
Niflheim, I can recognize
you. You shine out to me like
a star! I beg of you, please
listen to my story...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
即使在尼弗爾海姆的黑暗中，
我也能認出你。
你像星星一樣向我閃耀！
我懇求你，請聽我
講講我的故事...

scripts.text: I'm busy, sorry.
scripts.translation: 我很忙，抱歉。

scripts.text: Sure, go ahead.
scripts.translation: 好的，請說。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I know I can't stop
you from pursing your
path to glory. But if you
should change your mind...!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我知道我無法阻止你
追求榮耀的道路。
但如果你改變主意...！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Thank you...
Now, if you've heard
from the others and as
you can tell by my appearance,
I clearly don't belong here.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
謝謝你...
如果你從其他人那裡聽說過，
而且從我這副模樣也能看出來，
我顯然不屬於這裡。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I might not have
the luck to be selected
by Valkyrie, but I need
your help to get out of
here as soon as I can~
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我可能沒有運氣被瓦爾基里選中，
但我需要你的幫助，
讓我儘快離開這裡~

scripts.text: Er, I'm busy, now that I think about it.
scripts.translation: 呃，我現在很忙，仔細想想。

scripts.text: Sure, let's do it.
scripts.translation: 好的，我們來做吧。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I know I can't stop
you from pursing your
path to glory. But if you
should change your mind...!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我知道我無法阻止你
追求榮耀的道路。
但如果你改變主意...！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I know I'm asking too much
of you, but if you'd also help
the other unfortunate souls in
this place, I'd be truly grateful. Somehow, I think solving their problems will help me get back.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我知道我要求太多了，
但如果你也能幫助
這裡其他不幸的靈魂，
我會非常感激。
不知為何，我覺得解決他們的問題
會幫助我回去。

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 當然，為什麼不呢？

scripts.text: Why should I help them?
scripts.translation: 我為什麼要幫他們？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I knew you'd understand!
You really are a kind person.
Now, in order to help the other
misfortunate in Niflheim, you've got to remember to gain their trust first and get close to them, okay?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我就知道你會理解的！
你真是個善良的人。
那麼，為了幫助尼弗爾海姆
其他不幸的人，
你必須先記住贏得他們的信任，
並接近他們，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I... I understand.
Although I asked too much in asking you to help the other people here, I was hoping you'd realize that
would be the best way to learn clues for a way to escape for now.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我...我理解。
雖然我要求你幫助這裡其他人
可能要求太多了，
但我希望你能意識到，
這是目前尋找逃脫線索的最佳方式。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Hmm...?
You don't know which
people you need to help
here in Niflheim? Mmm,
let me think about it...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
嗯...？
你不知道在尼弗爾海姆
需要幫助哪些人嗎？
嗯，讓我想想...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
In this doomed place,
there isn't too much trust
amongst some of the people
here, but some will share their
problems if you ^3355FFapproach them
closely^000000, ^3355FFface to face^000000. Okay?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
在這個註定毀滅的地方，
這裡有些人之間缺乏信任，
但如果你^3355FF接近他們^000000，^3355FF面對面^000000，
有些人會分享他們的問題。好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
In this way, if they talk
to you first, they might
be more willing to accept
help or tell you what you
really need to know.
I hope this helps...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
這樣，如果他們先和你說話，
他們可能更願意接受幫助，
或者告訴你真正需要知道的事情。
希望這能幫到你...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Thank you so much for
your help. This is all I have,
and it means a lot to me, but
I want you to have this ring. It's the only way I can properly express my gratitude for your aid so far.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
非常感謝你的幫助。
這是我所有的一切，
對我來說意義重大，
但我想把這個戒指給你。
這是我唯一能恰當表達
對你迄今為止幫助感激之情的方式。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
To the dead,
living people
are either good
prey or good marks.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
對於死者來說，
活人要麼是好的獵物，
要麼是好的目標。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Hello, adventurer.
How have you been doing?
I'm surprised to still see you
around this dangerous town.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你好，冒險者。
你過得怎麼樣？
我很驚訝還能在這個危險的城鎮
見到你。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
If you wander around
Niflheim, you'll find that
some of the deceased here are
different than most of the others in this town. Please talk to them and see if you can be of any help.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
如果你在尼弗爾海姆四處遊蕩，
你會發現這裡的一些死者
與鎮上大多數其他人不同。
請和他們談談，看看你能否幫上忙。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
There's a Bard in
Niflheim with a very
sweet, yet melancholy voice.
He sings for strangers just
like you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
尼弗爾海姆有一位詩人，
他的聲音非常甜美，
卻又帶著憂鬱。
他為你這樣的陌生人歌唱，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I think he might know
some useful information,
so it might be a good
idea to speak with him.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我想他可能知道一些有用的資訊，
所以和他對話可能是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Hello, {0},
I'm surprised that
you've managed to survive
here all this time. It's no small feat for a mortal to be able to remain alive in Niflheim...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你好，{0}，
我很驚訝你能在這裡
生存這麼久。
對於凡人來說，
能在尼弗爾海姆保持活著
絕非易事...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Ah, {0}~
How is everything?
Once again, I want to
thank you for helping the
poor souls in this place.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
啊，{0}~
一切都好嗎？
再次感謝你幫助
這個地方的可憐靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Hmm...?
What's with that
look on your face?
Do you have something
you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
嗯...？
你臉上那是什麼表情？
你有什麼想問我的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Ah, {0}~
How is everything?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
啊，{0}~
一切都好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Hmm...?
What's with that
look on your face?
Do you have something
you want to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
嗯...？
你臉上那是什麼表情？
你有什麼想問我的嗎？

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼。

scripts.text: About the Queen of the Dead...
scripts.translation: 關於亡靈女王...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, if you ever
need my help, please
don't hesitate to ask.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
嗯，如果你需要我的幫助，
請儘管開口，不要客氣。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
The Queen of the Dead?
Why, she's the ruler of Niflheim.
As Loki and Angrboda's last child, she was given complete control of this realm by Odin.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
亡靈女王？
她是尼弗爾海姆的統治者。
作為洛基和安格爾伯達的最後一個孩子，
奧丁賦予了她對這個領域的完全控制權。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
She usually rules from her
castle, Hell, but sometimes she goes out to tour Niflheim. That's all I really know about her.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
她通常在她的城堡“地獄”中統治，
但有時也會外出巡視尼弗爾海姆。
關於她，我就只知道這些了。

scripts.text: About the Symbol of Nine Realms
scripts.translation: 關於九重世界的權威

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Oh that...?
Sometimes it's called
the Voucher of the Dead.
Odin gave it to the Queen
of the Dead to signify her
authority over Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
哦，那個...？
它有時也被稱為亡者的憑證。
奧丁將它交給亡靈女王，
以象徵她對尼弗爾海姆的權威。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
There are many rumors
floating around about that
symbol and its abilities, but
all we know for sure is that it can be used to command the dead...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
關於那個符號及其能力，
流傳著許多謠言，
但我們確切知道的只有，
它可以用來命令亡靈...

scripts.text: About Angrboda
scripts.translation: 關於安格爾伯達

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Angrboda...?
She's the mother of the
Queen of Hell, as well as
some of the most powerful
monsters in this universe.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
安格爾伯達...？
她是地獄女王的母親，
也是這個宇宙中最強大的魔物之一的母親。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
The gods feared her monstrous
children so much that they bound
them and sealed Angrboda away.
Nothing has been heard
of her since...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
眾神非常害怕她那些怪異的孩子們，
於是束縛了它們，並將安格爾伯達封印起來。
從那以後，就再也沒人聽說過她的訊息...

scripts.text: I was told by the Witch that you're...
scripts.translation: 女巫告訴我，你是...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Oh, the Witch was
talking about me? I'm
aware that she doesn't
think very highly of me.
Then again, it's not like
I can trust her either.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
哦，女巫在說我嗎？
我知道她對我評價不高。
不過話說回來，我也並不信任她。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, it can't be helped.
At least we both agree that
somehow I don't really belong
here in Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
嗯，沒辦法。
至少我們都同意，
我似乎並不屬於尼弗爾海姆這裡。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I'm sorry that I sort of
rambled on and on that last
time we spoke. Now that I think
about it, I didn't really give you any information that might have been very useful to you.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
很抱歉上次我們談話時，
我有點喋喋不休。
現在回想起來，
我並沒有給你提供任何可能對你很有用的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
But lately I've heard that the
Queen of the Dead is seeking her
mother, Angrboda. It's strange that even the queen, with all of her
power, is unable to find her.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
但最近我聽說，
亡靈女王正在尋找她的母親安格爾伯達。
奇怪的是，即使擁有如此力量的女王，
也無法找到她。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I have no idea how,
but it seems like Angrboda
has been sealed away in the
world of Midgard...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我不知道是怎麼做到的，
但似乎安格爾伯達被封印在了
米德加爾特...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I've told you
everything I know.
But if you want to learn more
about Angrboda, you probably need to talk to someone who actually communicates with the gods.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我已經把我知道的都告訴你了。
但如果你想了解更多關於安格爾伯達的事，
你可能需要去和那些真正能與神交流的人談談。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Perhaps Valkyrie
or someone who actually
lived in Asgard may know
more about where Angrboda
is sealed away.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
也許瓦爾基里，
或者那些真正生活在阿斯加德的人，
會知道更多關於安格爾伯達
被封印在何處的資訊。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Also, why would you want
the Symbol of the Nine Realms?
It's a very dangerous object that could cause a lot of trouble if it fell into the wrong hands...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
還有，你為什麼想要
九重世界的權威？
那是一件非常危險的東西，
如果落入錯誤的人手中，可能會引起很多麻煩...

scripts.text: What do you mean??
scripts.translation: 你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text: Don't worry, it won't.
scripts.translation: 別擔心，不會的。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
There are plenty of dead
people in Niflheim that are
driven by regret and despair.
The rage of being dead may result in some of them performing horrific deeds if they had the symbol.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
尼弗爾海姆有很多亡靈，
他們被悔恨和絕望所驅使。
死亡的憤怒可能會讓他們
在擁有該符號時做出可怕的舉動。

scripts.text: Then what should I do?
scripts.translation: 那我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text: Thanks for the concern, but I'm not worried.
scripts.translation: 謝謝關心，但我並不擔心。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I really think that you
should bring that symbol
to me before you show it to anybody else. Then, I want you to know why I really need its power.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我真的認為，
在你把它展示給其他人之前，
應該先把它交給我。
然後，我想讓你知道
我為什麼真正需要它的力量。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I can't explain myself
now, but I want to use the
power of the symbol to do
something really helpful
for you. You'll just need
to trust me on this.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我現在無法解釋，
但我想用符號的力量
為你做一件真正有幫助的事。
你只需要相信我這一點。

scripts.text: I'll think about it.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Then I will
wait for you here.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
那麼我會
在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Alright...
It's your decision.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
好吧...
這是你的決定。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Ah...
Alright, I suppose
that if you're worthy
of obtaining the symbol,
you should also be able
to protect it from abuse.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
啊...
好吧，我想
如果你配得上獲得這個符號，
你也應該能夠保護它不被濫用。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
If you obtain the
Symbol of Nine Realms,
please bring it to me
right away, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
如果你獲得了
九重世界的符號，
請立即把它交給我，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Yes...
This is the Symbol of the
Nine Realms. It only has enough
power for one use, but it's still not easy to get this. Now, what were you planning to use this for?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
是的...
這就是九重世界的符號。
它的力量只夠使用一次，
但獲得它並不容易。那麼，
你打算用它做什麼？

scripts.text: Tell her your story.
scripts.translation: 告訴她你的故事。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Ah, so you're here
in Niflheim to overcome
the ordeals of the gods and
prove your courage to Valkyrie.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
啊，原來你是來到尼弗爾海姆，
為了克服諸神的試煉，
並向瓦爾基里證明你的勇氣。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
So wait...
You've obtained that symbol
just for that witch? This may
seem rude, but I want to tell
you exactly how I feel about her.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
等等...
你只是為了那個女巫
才獲得那個符號的嗎？
這也許有點無禮，
但我想告訴你我對她的真實感受。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Isn't it suspicious that she
hasn't explained her intentions to you? The Symbol of Nine Realms
is one of the most powerful objects in Niflheim. Whatever she's planning has to be large scale.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
她沒有向你解釋她的意圖，
這難道不可疑嗎？
九重世界的符號是尼弗爾海姆
最強大的物品之一。
無論她在策劃什麼，規模一定很大。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Then, there's that Metz Brayde.
Do you really believe that after he completes his research, he'll just give it back to you? You can't just trust someone to hold an object of enormous power and give it back!
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
還有那個梅茨·佈雷德。
你真的相信他在完成研究後，
就會把它還給你嗎？
你不能把擁有巨大力量的物品
交給別人保管並指望他們歸還！

scripts.text: W-what should I do?
scripts.translation: 我...我該怎麼辦？

scripts.text: I can't believe this!
scripts.translation: 我無法相信這件事！

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, I can't really tell
you what to do, but I don't think it's a good idea to let that witch have the Symbol of Nine Realms. There's no telling what she'll
use its power for.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
嗯，我其實不能告訴你該怎麼做，
但我不認為讓那個女巫
擁有九重世界的符號是個好主意。
沒人知道她會用它做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Actually...
There is this rumor
going around, but I don't
know if you want to hear it...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
其實...
最近有個傳聞，
但我不確定您是否想聽...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I'm sorry if you were offended.
I know I can't really convince you to believe anything, but please understand that I just don't want anyone to take advantage of you. Forgive my rudeness.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
如果您感到被冒犯了，我很抱歉。
我知道我很難讓您相信我的話，
但請理解，我只是不想讓您被人利用。
請原諒我的失禮。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is only
a lingering trace
of Serin, a manifestation
of her definitive memory.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這只是賽琳殘留的痕跡，
是她最終記憶的顯現。^000000

scripts.text: Give Serin her ring.
scripts.translation: 把戒指還給賽琳

scripts.text: Keep the ring.
scripts.translation: 保留戒指

scripts.text:
[Serin]
....{0}.....
I don't want to forget you.
I can forget my obsession with
life and all my other memories,
But if I can keep just one memory, I want it to be of your kindness.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
....{0}.....
我不想忘記你。
我可以忘記我對生命的執念，
也可以忘記其他所有記憶，
但如果只能保留一段記憶，我希望那是你的善意。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Even now, you're still
so very kind to me. Thank
you for giving back my ring,
my most precious possession.
Thank you, thank you...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
即使現在，你依然對我如此溫柔。
謝謝你把戒指還給我，
那是我最珍貴的東西。
謝謝你，謝謝你...

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe sound of Serin's voice
softened and when it grew silent, her eyes blankly stared ahead as
if she were in a trance. It looks like she has already forgotten
everything...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF賽琳的聲音漸漸柔和下來，
當聲音歸於寂靜時，她的眼神空洞地凝視著前方，
彷彿陷入了恍惚。看起來她已經忘記了所有事情...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFBut Serin has also been able
to forget her sadness. The tears streaked across her cheeks and
the faint smile on her lips tell you that her memories of you
will always remain in her heart.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF但賽琳也忘記了她的悲傷。
淚水劃過她的臉頰，
嘴角那抹淡淡的微笑告訴你，
對你的記憶將永遠留在她的心中。^000000

scripts.text: Tell me the rumors about the witch.
scripts.translation: 告訴我關於女巫的傳聞

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, I've heard that the witch has been hiding deep in Niflheim and will only speak to those who pass her test. Apparently, she's been preparing some sort of ritual
to gain more power...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
嗯，我聽說女巫躲在尼弗爾海姆的深處，
她只會與通過她考驗的人對話。
顯然，她正在準備某種儀式
來獲取更多的力量...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
It's almost too horrible
to believe, but I think that
she's preparing the ritual to
summon Dark Lord, ruler of
the Realm of Fiends.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
這幾乎令人難以置信，
但我認為她正在準備儀式，
召喚暗黑之王，
魔界的主宰。

scripts.text: Dark Lord...?
scripts.translation: 暗黑之王...？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, most people don't
know this, but Dark Lord
comes from the Realm of Fiends.
In his own domain, he's so powerful that even the gods fear his might.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
嗯，大多數人不知道，
但暗黑之王來自魔界。
在他的領域裡，他強大到
連眾神都畏懼他的力量。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Now, sometimes Dark Lord can
enter the world of Midgard, but only in a manifestation that represents just a small portion
of his full power.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
現在，有時暗黑之王可以
進入米德加爾特，
但只能以顯現的形式，
那隻代表了他全部力量的一小部分。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
You see, it takes too much energy to travel from the Realm of Fiends to Midgard. And since the life force in Midgard conflicts with his powers, Dark Lord can't reach your world directly.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
你看，從魔界前往米德加爾特
需要消耗大量的能量。
而且由於米德加爾特中的生命力
與他的力量相沖突，
暗黑之王無法直接到達你的世界。

scripts.text: Wouldn't Lady Hell stop him?
scripts.translation: 地獄夫人不會阻止他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, Dark Lord only wants
Midgard, so the Queen of the Dead doesn't feel threatened about her control of Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
既然暗黑之王只想要米德加爾特，
亡者女王就不會感到威脅，
因為她對尼弗爾海姆的掌控依然穩固。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
In fact, I'm sure she's aware
that Dark Lord will cause thousands of deaths in Midgard, meaning that there would be thousands more souls for her to rule over. So it's not to her advantage to stop him.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
事實上，我相信她很清楚，
暗黑之王在米德加爾特會造成成千上萬人的死亡，
這意味著將有更多的靈魂供她統治。
所以，阻止他並不符合她的利益。

scripts.text: Then what should we do...?
scripts.translation: 那我們該怎麼辦...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
No matter what the cost,
we've got to stop her from
summoning Dark Lord in order
to protect Midgard from
total annihiliation.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
無論付出什麼代價，
我們都必須阻止她召喚暗黑之王，
以保護米德加爾特免於徹底毀滅。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I used to be a pretty
skilled Wizard, so I know
that she needs to draw a really huge magic circle in Niflheim if she wants to summon Dark Lord.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我曾經是一名相當出色的巫師，
所以我知道，如果她想召喚暗黑之王，
她需要在尼弗爾海姆畫一個巨大的魔法陣。

scripts.text: Can you tell me where?
scripts.translation: 你能告訴我地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Well, there are certain rules
and conditions to perform the summoning. There aren't any spaces wide enough in the Valley of Gyoll, and Niflheim's entrance is watched by too many people...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
嗯，進行召喚需要滿足特定的規則和條件。
鬼之峽谷沒有足夠寬敞的空間，
而尼弗爾海姆的入口又有太多人監視...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Now, if I were to summon
Dark Lord, I would probably
do it somewhere inside town
to avoid attention. Hmmm...
I'll send you there once I figure out where the circle might be.
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
現在，如果是我來召喚暗黑之王，
我可能會選擇城鎮內部的某個地方，
以避免引起注意。嗯...
等我確定魔法陣可能的位置後，我會把你傳送過去。

scripts.text:
[Serin]
I need to finish
my preparations to send
you to the magic circle,
so I need a little more time...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我需要完成將你傳送到魔法陣的準備，
所以我還需要一點時間...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Alright...
So are you
ready to leave?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
好了...
你準備好出發了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: Not yet
scripts.translation: 還沒

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Okay~
Let's go...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
好的~
我們走吧...

scripts.text:
[Serin]
My preparations
are taking longer
than I thought. Would
you wait a little while?
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
我的準備時間比預想的要長。
你能稍等一下嗎？

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is just a lingering
trace of Serin, an impression
of her soul and memories that
you can still sense somehow.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這只是賽琳殘留的痕跡，
是她靈魂和記憶的印記，
不知為何你依然能感知到它。^000000

scripts.text: Follow the trace.
scripts.translation: 追蹤痕跡

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text:
[Serin]
...
......
W-who...
Who are you?

^3355FFThis is just a lingering
trace of Serin, an impression
of her soul and memories that
you can still sense somehow.
What could have happened to her?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這只是賽琳殘留的痕跡，
是她靈魂和記憶的印記，
不知為何你依然能感知到它。
她究竟遭遇了什麼？^000000

scripts.text:
^33555FFSuddenly, Serin's
gold ring sparkled
with a soft glow and
faded away.^000000
scripts.translation:
^33555F突然，賽琳的金戒指
閃爍著柔和的光芒，
然後漸漸消失了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Serin]
Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[賽琳]
謝謝你...

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou returned
Serin's gold ring.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你歸還了賽琳的金戒指。^000000

scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您現在攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
That Witch's Medal...
You must be here to
help your friend take
care of Serin. Are you
ready to go, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
那枚魔女之證...
你一定是來幫你的朋友
處理賽琳的事的。{0}，
你準備好出發了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
That bastard stole
two spell books from me.
You've brought one of them
back, but the other book
is still missing.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
那個混蛋從我這裡偷走了兩本法術書。
你找回了其中一本，
但另一本仍然下落不明。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Some bastard stole
two of my spell books.
I'd be grateful if you can
find him in Niflheim and
bring my books back to me.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
有個混蛋偷走了我的兩本法術書。
如果你能在尼弗海姆找到他，
並把我的書帶回來，
我會非常感激。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Once that fool stole my spell
books, he was cursed after he
cast those spells without my
permission. I'm so relieved to
finally hold these in my
hands again.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
那個蠢貨偷了我的法術書後，
因為未經我允許就施放了法術，
結果受到了詛咒。
終於又能親手握住它們了，
真是鬆了一口氣。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hmm...?
Why haven't you
brought my books
back to me yet?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
嗯...？
你為什麼還沒有
把我的書帶回來？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
If you need to learn more
about Angrboda, why don't you
just ask around? I'm sure that
everyone is aware that the queen
is searching for her mother.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
如果你需要了解更多關於安格爾伯達的資訊，
為什麼不四處問問呢？
我相信大家都知道，
女王正在尋找她的母親。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I almost hate
suggesting it, but
I think Serin might
have some information
on Angrboda's whereabouts.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
我幾乎不想建議這樣做，
但我覺得賽琳可能
知道安格爾伯達的下落。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
It may be almost
impossible to obtain
the Symbol of Nine Realms.
Still, you and I both need it.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
獲得九界之印
可能幾乎是不可能的。
不過，你和我都需要它。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
The Symbol of Nine Realms?
How were you able to get that?!
Ah, you must have found the Queen of the Dead's mother, Angrboda, right? Great work~
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
九界之印？
你是怎麼拿到它的？！
啊，你一定找到了亡靈女王
的母親安格爾伯達，對吧？
幹得漂亮~

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
This is Serin's gold ring?
Excellent, this has been
strongly infused with her
vibes. It's really tough to find something like this that resonates so strongly with its owner.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
這是賽琳的金戒指？
太好了，它強烈地
蘊含著她的氣息。
要找到能與主人如此
強烈共鳴的物品真的很難。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hmm, you don't have
anything related to Serin.
This isn't good. She's hid
herself already and it might
be too late to find any trace of her. I'll have to do something...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
嗯，你身上沒有
任何與賽琳相關的東西。
這不好。她已經藏起來了，
可能已經太遲了，
找不到她的蹤跡了。
我得做點什麼...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now that the potion I'm
making is being processed,
I can finally tell you what
I've been trying to do with
the objects I've asked you
to get for me.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
既然我正在製作的藥水
已經處理好了，
我終於可以告訴你，
我讓你去收集那些物品
是為了做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
The potion is finally
completed. Now, take this
and command Serin to drink it.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
藥水終於完成了。
現在，拿著這個，
命令賽琳喝下去。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Please wait
a bit. I'm still
trying to finish
these preparations...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
請稍等。
我還在努力
完成這些準備工作...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You're finally
back. We might not
have enough time to
stop her, but we have
to try. Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
你終於回來了。
我們可能沒有足夠的時間
阻止她，但我們必須嘗試。
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
We've got to
stop Serin before
she does something
truly horrible. Are
you ready to go?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
我們必須在賽琳做出
真正可怕的事情之前
阻止她。
你準備好出發了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hmmm...?
Where are all the
vouchers I've lent to you?
Please retrieve them all
before coming back to me.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
嗯...？
我借給你的那些憑證
都在哪裡？
請把它們全部取回，
然後再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You've done well.
Without her memories of her
previous life, Serin can remain
here in Niflheim peacefully.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
你做得很好。
沒有了前世的記憶，
賽琳可以平靜地
留在尼弗海姆了。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I'm so relieved that
my expectations about
you weren't wrong.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
很高興我對你的
期望沒有落空。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
How could you fail when
the stakes are so high?
Serin almost summoned
the Dark Lord, but luckily,
somebody else stopped
her in the nick of time.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
在如此重大的關頭，
你怎麼能失敗呢？
賽琳差點召喚出了暗黑之王，
幸好，有人在千鈞一髮之際
阻止了她。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hmpf.
I don't really
want to talk to
you anymore.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
哼。
我真的不想
再和你說話了。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You've got to hurry
and stop Serin!
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
快一點，
去阻止賽琳！

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hm? Still exploring
Niflheim? Although you're
strong enough to survive,
I still think you're risking
your life by remaining here
when you don't have to.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
嗯？還在探索尼弗海姆？
雖然你有足夠的實力生存，
但我覺得你沒必要留在這裡，
這樣是在拿生命冒險。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Not yet...
scripts.translation: 還沒...

scripts.text: Go directly to Serin
scripts.translation: 直接去找賽琳

scripts.text: Path Towards Serin
scripts.translation: 前往賽琳的路

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Thank you
for your help.
Serin's threat may
be too much for just
one adventurer alone...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
謝謝你的幫助。
賽琳的威脅可能
對單個冒險者來說
太過沉重了...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Thank you
for your help.
Serin's threat may
be too much for just
one adventurer alone...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
謝謝你的幫助。
賽琳的威脅可能
對單個冒險者來說
太過沉重了...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Please hurry...
Time is of the essence...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
請快點...
時間緊迫...

scripts.text:
That bastard stole
two spell books from me.
You've brought one of them
back, but the other book
is still missing.
scripts.translation:
那個混蛋偷走了
我的兩本法術書。
你找回了其中一本，
但另一本
還是下落不明。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Would you please
retrieve my other
spell book for me,
adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
冒險者，
請幫我找回
另一本法術書，好嗎？

scripts.text:
Some bastard stole
two of my spell books.
I'd be grateful if you can
find him in Niflheim and
bring my books back to me.
scripts.translation:
有個混蛋偷走了
我的兩本法術書。
如果你能在尼弗海姆
找到他，並把書還給我，
我會非常感激。

scripts.text:
Once that fool stole my spell
books, he was cursed after he
cast those spells without my
permission. I'm so relieved to
finally hold these in my
hands again.
scripts.translation:
那個蠢貨偷了我的法術書，
他在未經我允許的情況下
施放了那些法術，結果受到了詛咒。
我很慶幸終於
能再次把它們握在手中。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now mortal...
Why is it that
you've come to see me?
I'm sure that there must
be something you want.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
凡人...
你為何前來見我？
我相信你一定
有什麼想要的東西。

scripts.text: He asked me to see you for....
scripts.translation: 他讓我來找你，為了....

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
As I expected,
there is something behind
all of this. Now, you may
know where you are, but
do you understand why
the dead are here?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
果然，
這一切背後另有隱情。
現在，你可能知道
自己身在何處，
但你知道死者為何
會在這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
This realm is a place
for warriors that have failed
to prove their courage. Keep in
mind that it's not too late for
you to join their ranks.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
這片領域是
那些未能證明勇氣的
戰士的歸宿。請記住，
你現在加入他們的行列
還來得及。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
The realm of Niflheim
is ruled by the Queen of the
Dead. Sometimes she appears
in her shining armor and makes the rounds. Everyone who sees her is stunned by the image of authority.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
尼弗海姆由
亡者女王統治。
有時她會身著
閃亮的盔甲巡視。
所有看到她的人
都會被那威嚴的形象
所震懾。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now...
What I need you to do is
ask the Queen of the Dead
for the Symbol of Nine Realms.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
現在...
我需要你做的是
向亡者女王
索要“九界之證”。

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
The symbol acts as
a voucher of the queen's
authority and represents her
undeniable right to rule over
the dead. But right now, I can't
explain why I need it.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
這個符號是
女王權威的憑證，
代表著她統治死者
無可置疑的權利。
但現在，我無法解釋
為什麼需要它。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I'll tell you why I need
it once you bring me the
queen's symbol. Now, please
keep this secret and tell no one that I asked you to bring the symbol to me.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
等你把女王的符號
帶給我之後，
我會告訴你為什麼需要它。
現在，請保守這個秘密，
不要告訴任何人
是我讓你帶符號來的。

scripts.text: How am I supposed to get the symbol?
scripts.translation: 我該怎麼拿到那個符號？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Taking the symbol
by force is out of the
question. Not even the gods
would consider battling the
Queen of the Dead.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
強行奪取符號
是絕對不可能的。
即使是神明
也不會考慮
與亡者女王開戰。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You will need to
earn the queen's favor
in order to even have
a chance of obtaining
the Symbol of Nine Realms.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
你需要獲得女王的青睞，
才有機會得到
九界之符。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, there is a rumor
that the Queen of the Dead
is searching for her lost mother, Angrboda. Now, if you could find where Angrboda has been
sealed away...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
現在，有傳聞說
亡者女王正在尋找
她失散的母親安格爾伯達。
如果你能找到
安格爾伯達被封印的地方...

scripts.text:
Hmm...?
Why haven't you
brought my books
back to me yet?
scripts.translation:
嗯...？
你為什麼還沒
把我的書還給我？

scripts.text:
If you need to learn more
about Angrboda, why don't you
just ask around? I'm sure that
everyone is aware that the queen
is searching for her mother.
scripts.translation:
如果你需要了解更多
關於安格爾伯達的資訊，
為什麼不四處打聽一下呢？
我相信大家都知道
女王正在尋找她的母親。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Once again, don't let
anyone know that I've asked
you to bring me the Symbol of
the Nine Realms. I especially
don't want Serin to find out.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
再次強調，不要讓任何人知道
是我讓你帶九界之符給我的。
我特別不希望賽琳知道這件事。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
If I can help it,
I won't tolerate
Serin's presense here
in Niflheim. If I could
banish her, I'd do it!
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
如果可以的話，
我絕不容忍賽琳
出現在尼弗爾海姆。
如果能將她放逐，
我會毫不猶豫地這麼做！

scripts.text:
I almost hate
suggesting it, but
I think Serin might
have some information
on Angrboda's whereabouts.
scripts.translation:
我幾乎不想建議這樣做，
但我覺得賽琳可能
掌握著安格爾伯達
下落的一些資訊。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
But remember to be
careful around her.
Something about that
Serin isn't quite right...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
但記得在她身邊
要小心。
那個賽琳身上
有些不對勁...

scripts.text:
It may be almost
impossible to obtain
the Symbol of Nine Realms.
Still, you and I both need it.
scripts.translation:
獲得九界之符
可能幾乎是不可能的。
儘管如此，
你和我都需要它。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I hope you understand
that the symbol is more
than just a mere voucher.
It actually contains
enormous power...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
我希望你能理解，
這個符號不僅僅是一張憑證。
它實際上蘊含著
巨大的力量...

scripts.text:
The Symbol of Nine Realms?
How were you able to get that?!
Ah, you must have found the Queen of the Dead's mother, Angrboda, right? Great work~
scripts.translation:
九界之符？
你是怎麼拿到它的？！
啊，你一定找到了
亡者女王的母親安格爾伯達，對吧？
幹得漂亮~

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, if you'll just
hand me the symbol, I'll tell
you what we need to do next.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
現在，只要你把符號交給我，
我就告訴你接下來
我們需要做什麼。

scripts.text: Give the symbol.
scripts.translation: 交出符號

scripts.text: Don't give the symbol.
scripts.translation: 不交出符號

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Listen carefully.
Since you were actually
able to get the symbol, I believe that you're the only person capable of performing this next task.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
仔細聽著。
既然你真的拿到了符號，
我相信你是唯一有能力
完成下一個任務的人。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
We're going to use this
symbol to create something,
but we need one last item.
I need you to find something
imbued with Serin's vibes.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
我們要用這個符號
製造某樣東西，
但我們還需要最後一件物品。
我需要你找到一件
帶有賽琳氣息的東西。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Serin's already hid herself
deep within Niflheim, but I'm
sure you can find something
if you can find any remaining
trace of her.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
賽琳已經深深藏匿在
尼弗爾海姆之中，
但如果你能找到她留下的
任何痕跡，
我相信你能找到那件東西。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Huh...?
Don't tell me that
you've taken that wench's
side! Well, I won't take the
symbol against your will, but
you better think this over...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
哈...？
難道你站到了
那個女人的那邊！
好吧，我不會違揹你的意願
強行拿走符號，
但你最好好好想想...

scripts.text:
This is Serin's gold ring?
Excellent, this has been
strongly infused with her
vibes. It's really tough to find something like this that resonates so strongly with its owner.
scripts.translation:
這是賽琳的金戒指？
太好了，這件物品
強烈地浸染著她的氣息。
很難找到像這樣
與主人如此共鳴的物品。

scripts.text:
Hmm, you don't have
anything related to Serin.
This isn't good. She's hid
herself already and it might
be too late to find any trace of her. I'll have to do something...
scripts.translation:
嗯，你身上沒有
任何與賽琳相關的東西。
這不好。她已經藏起來了，
可能已經太遲了，
找不到她的痕跡了。
我得想想辦法...

scripts.text:
Now that the potion I'm
making is being processed,
I can finally tell you what
I've been trying to do with
the objects I've asked you
to get for me.
scripts.translation:
現在，我正在製作的藥水
已經進入了處理階段，
我終於可以告訴你，
我讓你收集那些東西
究竟是為了做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I didn't explain the
reason I wanted the Symbol
of Nine Realms to prevent Serin
from getting suspicious and forcing you to reveal my plans. You see, Serin isn't fit for Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
我之所以沒有解釋
想要九重世界的權威
的原因，是為了防止賽琳
起疑心，逼你透露我的計劃。
你看，賽琳並不適合尼弗爾海姆。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Although she's in the
world of the dead, Serin
has never accepted death and
has desired to return to life. Of course, that's the natural response for everyone that comes here...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
雖然她身處死者的世界，
但賽琳從未接受死亡，
一直渴望重返人間。
當然，對於所有來到這裡的人來說，
這都是很自然的反應...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
However, unlike the others
who have despaired, lost
hope and accepted their fate,
Serin has never given up her hope to return to life. With her hope, she retains her beauty and light.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
然而，與其他那些
陷入絕望、失去希望
並接受命運的人不同，
賽琳從未放棄重返人間的希望。
憑藉這份希望，
她保留了自己的美麗與光輝。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
But she's only denying
the fate she deserves.
What she's trying to do
is wrong and we need to
stop her before it's too late.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
但她只是在否認
她應得的命運。
她想要做的事情是錯誤的，
我們需要在一切為時已晚之前
阻止她。

scripts.text: What does she want?
scripts.translation: 她想要什麼？

scripts.text: What is she going to do?
scripts.translation: 她打算做什麼？

scripts.text: What should I do?
scripts.translation: 我該做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Make no mistake:
Serin wants the Symbol
