of the Nine Realms.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
不要搞錯了：
賽琳想要的是
九重世界的權威。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, if she could use it
multiple times, she could just
command the guards of Niflheim
to just let her pass and re-enter the world of the living. But your symbol can be used just once...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
現在，如果她能多次使用它，
她就可以命令尼弗爾海姆的衛兵
放行，讓她重新進入生者的世界。
但你的符號只能使用一次...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I believe Serin is going to
summon the Dark Lord. Since
she used to be a great wizard,
it's entirely possible. However, she might need the Symbol of the Nine Realms in order to do it.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
我相信賽琳打算
召喚暗黑之王。
由於她曾是一位偉大的巫師，
這完全有可能。
不過，她可能需要九重世界的權威
才能做到這一點。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, you may believe that
Dark Lord can be defeated by
humans, but what you might not
know is that the manifestation of Dark Lord in your world is limited to a fraction of his true power.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
現在，你可能認為
暗黑之王可以被人類擊敗，
但你可能不知道的是，
暗黑之王在你們世界的顯現
僅限於他真正力量的一小部分。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Sometimes Dark Lord can
cross over into Midgard,
but traveling from his world into
ours takes vast amounts of energy. Also the life force in your world conflicts with his dark powers.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
有時，暗黑之王可以
跨越到米德加爾特，
但從他的世界來到我們的世界
需要消耗大量的能量。
此外，你們世界的生命力
與他的黑暗靈魂之力相沖突。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, if Dark Lord were
summoned into Niflheim,
he would have easy access
to Midgard and the use
of all of his destructive power.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
現在，如果暗黑之王
被召喚到尼弗爾海姆，
他將能夠輕鬆進入米德加爾特，
並動用他所有的破壞力。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Serin plans to strike
a deal with Dark Lord:
In exchange for summoning
him to Niflheim, Serin will
be brought back to life.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
賽琳計劃與暗黑之王
達成交易：
作為將他召喚到尼弗爾海姆的交換，
賽琳將被複活。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Although you've found
favor with Lady Hell, she
will probably not stop Dark
Lord's approach. Dark Lord
only wants Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
雖然你獲得了地獄夫人的青睞，
但她可能不會阻止
暗黑之王的到來。
暗黑之王只想要米德加爾特。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now that I think about
it, massive death would
actually increase Lady Hell's
sphere of influence. I don't think she'll help Dark Lord, but she
also won't get in his way.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
現在仔細想想，
大規模的死亡實際上
會增加地獄夫人的勢力範圍。
我不認為她會幫助暗黑之王，
但她也不會阻礙他。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I need you to take
this tonic and have
Serin drink it. This
special potion will erase
most of her memories.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
我需要你帶上
這瓶藥劑，讓賽琳喝下去。
這種特殊的藥水
會抹去她的大部分記憶。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Without her memories,
Serin should also lose
her twisted ambitions.
Now, with the Symbol of Nine Realms, Serin cannot refuse drinking this potion.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
沒有了記憶，
賽琳應該也會失去
她那扭曲的野心。
現在，憑藉九重世界的權威，
賽琳無法拒絕喝下這瓶藥水。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
That's why having the
symbol is so crucial.
Serin is clever enough
to avoid drinking this
for quite a while now...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
這就是為什麼擁有
這個符號如此關鍵。
賽琳足夠聰明，
已經設法避免喝下它
相當長一段時間了...

scripts.text:
The potion is finally
completed. Now, take this
and command Serin to drink it.
scripts.translation:
藥水終於
製作完成了。
現在，帶上它，
命令賽琳喝下去。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Luckily, I was able to
use Serin's gold ring to
trace her location. I'm going
to send you there, so please
do whatever it takes to stop her.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
幸好，我能夠利用施琳的金戒指追蹤到她的位置。我會把你傳送過去，請務必不惜一切代價阻止她。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I'm not exactly sure
where Serin is hiding,
but I'll send you to her
general location. Do
everything in your
power to stop her.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
我不太確定賽琳具體藏在哪裡，但我會把你傳送到她的大致位置。請竭盡全力阻止她。

scripts.text: [Kirkena]
scripts.translation: [柯爾凱娜]

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Please take these with you
as they'll probably be useful
when you deal with her. As for
these vouchers, give them to your allies. They'll send them straight to where Serin is located.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
請帶上這些，它們在對付她時可能會有用。至於這些憑證，請交給你的盟友。我會直接把他們傳送到賽琳所在的位置。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
When you're finished
dealing with Serin, don't
forget to bring back all
of the vouchers I've
given you, alright?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
等你處理完賽琳的事情後，別忘了把我給你的所有憑證都帶回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, I'm lending you
these Witch's Medals. You
may lend these to your allies
to help you deal with Serin.
Remember, if they carry more
than one, they won't work.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
現在，我把這些魔女之證借給你。你可以把它們借給你的盟友，協助你應對賽琳。記住，如果一個人身上攜帶超過一枚，它們將不會生效。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Let your allies know
that they have to take
the secret passge through
the right side of the portrait
on the castle's second floor.
Then, I can send them to Serin.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
告訴你的盟友，他們必須穿過城堡二樓右側肖像畫後的秘密通道。這樣，我就可以把他們傳送到賽琳那裡。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
When you're finished
dealing with Serin, don't
forget to bring back all of
the Witch's Medals that
I've lent to you, alright?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
等你處理完賽琳的事情後，別忘了把我借給你的所有魔女之證都帶回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
Please wait
a bit. I'm still
trying to finish
these preparations...
scripts.translation:
請稍等。
我還在努力完成
這些準備工作...

scripts.text:
You're finally
back. We might not
have enough time to
stop her, but we have
to try. Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
你終於回來了。
我們可能沒有足夠的時間
阻止她，但我們必須試一試。
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hurry up, then!
There's no time
to waste!
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
那就快點！
沒有時間浪費了！

scripts.text:
We've got to
stop Serin before
she does something
truly horrible. Are
you ready to go?
scripts.translation:
我們必須阻止賽琳，
以免她做出真正可怕的事情。
你準備好出發了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Okay then.
Good luck,
{0}...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
那麼，就這樣吧。
祝你好運，
{0}...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hurry up, then!
There's no time
to waste!
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
那就快點！
沒有時間浪費了！

scripts.text:
Hmmm...?
Where are all the
vouchers I've lent to you?
Please retrieve them all
before coming back to me.
scripts.translation:
嗯...？
我借給你的那些憑證呢？
請在回來找我之前
把它們全部取回。

scripts.text:
You've done well.
Without her memories of her
previous life, Serin can remain
here in Niflheim peacefully.
scripts.translation:
你做得很好。
沒有了前世記憶的賽琳，
可以平靜地留在尼弗爾海姆了。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Although she failed to return to life, I'm sure she is glad to have met you. I think she's also started to learn that life's meaning is not in living alone...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
雖然她沒能重返人間，但我相信她很高興能遇見你。我想她也開始明白，生命的意義不僅僅在於活著...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Once again, thank
you so much for your
help. Once you finish here,
please visit our queen, Lady Hell. I believe she wants to see you for some reason, {0}...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
再次非常感謝你的幫助。等你在這裡辦完事，請去拜訪我們的女王，地獄夫人。我相信她因為某種原因想見你，{0}...

請在回來找我之前
把它們全部取回。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]

scripts.translation:

雖然她沒能重返人間，但我相信她很高興能遇見你。我想她也開始明白，生命的意義不僅僅在於活著...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Once again, thank
you so much for your
help. Once you finish here,
please visit our queen, Lady Hell. I believe she wants to see you for some reason...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
再次非常感謝你的幫助。等你在這裡辦完事，請去拜訪我們的女王，地獄夫人。我相信她因為某種原因想見你...

scripts.text:
I'm so relieved that
my expectations about
you weren't wrong.
scripts.translation:
我對你的期望沒有落空，
這讓我鬆了一口氣。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You've done well.
Without her memories of her
previous life, Serin can remain
here in Niflheim peacefully.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
你做得很好。
沒有了前世的記憶，
賽琳可以平靜地
留在尼弗海姆了。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Although she failed to return to life, I'm sure she is glad to have met you. I think she's also started to learn that life's meaning is not in living alone...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
雖然她沒能重返人間，但我相信她很高興能遇見你。我想她也開始明白，生命的意義不僅僅在於活著...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Once again, thank
you so much for your
help. Once you finish here,
please visit our queen, Lady Hell. I believe she wants to see you for some reason...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
再次非常感謝你的幫助。等你在這裡辦完事，請去拜訪我們的女王，地獄夫人。我相信她因為某種原因想見你...

scripts.text:
How could you fail when
the stakes are so high?
Serin almost summoned
the Dark Lord, but luckily,
somebody else stopped
her in the nick of time.
scripts.translation:
在如此緊要關頭，
你怎麼能失敗呢？
賽琳差點就召喚出了暗黑之王，
幸好，有人在千鈞一髮之際
阻止了她。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Fortunately, there are many people who are coming to Niflheim as part of the ordeals set before them by the gods. It looks like you just failed that ordeal, and Valkyrie will choose someone else.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
幸運的是，有許多人為了完成眾神賦予的試煉而來到尼弗海姆。看來你剛剛失敗了，瓦爾基里會另選他人。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
It's over. You failed.
Still, consider yourself
lucky. Your soul could have
been bound to Niflheim if it
weren't for Serin's wish for
you to remain free.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
結束了。你失敗了。
不過，你還算幸運。如果不是賽琳希望你保持自由，你的靈魂可能已經被束縛在尼弗海姆了。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You really should thank
her for that. Though, it's
ironic that you failed your
ordeals for her sake...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
你確實應該為此感謝她。雖然諷刺的是，你為了她而失敗了試煉...

scripts.text:
Hmpf.
I don't really
want to talk to
you anymore.
scripts.translation:
哼。
我不想再和你
說話了。

scripts.text:
You've got to hurry
and stop Serin!
scripts.translation:
你必須趕緊
阻止賽琳！

scripts.text:
Hm? Still exploring
Niflheim? Although you're
strong enough to survive,
I still think you're risking
your life by remaining here
when you don't have to.
scripts.translation:
嗯？還在探索
尼弗海姆？雖然你強得
足以生存，但我認為
在沒有必要時留在這裡
還是在拿命冒險。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
W-what's this?
Why is it that
you have one of
my lost spell books?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
這...這是什麼？
為什麼你會有
我遺失的一本
魔法書？

scripts.text: From a cursed soul...
scripts.translation: 來自一個被詛咒的靈魂...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Oh. That bastard must have
stolen my spell books and got cursed when he cast the spells without my permission. Still, it's a relief to have my spells back.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
哦。那個混蛋一定是偷了我的魔法書，然後在我沒允許的情況下施法被詛咒了。不過，能找回我的法術還是鬆了口氣。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
So mortal...
You must be here for
some reason. Speak
your mind.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
凡人...
你一定是因為
某種原因才在這裡的。
有話直說。

scripts.text: Send me back to my world.
scripts.translation: 送我回我的世界。

scripts.text: There's a lost child here that I want to help...
scripts.translation: 這裡有個迷路的孩子，我想幫幫他...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Understood.
Let me send
you back to the
realm of the living
where you belong...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
明白了。
讓我送你回
你所屬的
生者世界...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
There's a living child?
Here in Niflheim? That's
most peculiar. Well, let me
give you this. It will send
a living human back to one
of the towns in your realm.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
有個活著的
孩子？
在尼弗海姆？這太
奇怪了。好吧，給你
這個。它能把一個
活人送回你世界
的某個城鎮。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
A mortal? What are you doing
here? I'm not sure how more
of you are able to get here,
or your reasons for coming,
but this place is dangerous
for the living.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
凡人？你在這裡
做什麼？我不確定
為什麼還有更多
人能來到這裡，
或者你們來的原因，
但這裡對活人
來說很危險。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I'm sending you back
to the realm of the living.
If you can help it, you should
probably avoid coming back
to Niflheim...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
我要送你回
生者世界。
如果可以的話，
你最好避免
再回到尼弗海姆...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You lost the wing?
Here, let me give you
my last one. Now, hurry
up and save that lost child!
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
你弄丟了翅膀？
給你，這是我
最後的一隻。現在，
快去救那個迷路的孩子！

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I just gave you
that wing, right?
Hurry and save that
poor child stuck in
Niflheim!
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
我剛剛才給你
那隻翅膀，對吧？
快去救那個
被困在尼弗海姆的
可憐孩子！

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Hmm...
If you don't have
anything important to
accomplish in Niflheim,
you should probably return
to the realm of the living...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
嗯...
如果你在尼弗海姆
沒有重要的事情
要做，你應該
回到生者世界...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
So did you already
use the wing to save
that poor, lost child?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
所以，你已經
用翅膀救了
那個可憐、迷路的孩子嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
What...?!
It didn't work?
That's impossible!
Wait, give me a moment to
think. What could be wrong?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
什...？！
沒有效果？
這不可能！
等等，讓我想想。
到底哪裡出了問題？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Alright.
Now I understand
why the wing didn't
work for that poor girl...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
好了。
我現在明白
為什麼翅膀
對那個可憐的女孩
沒有用了...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
She's so young that
she doesn't even know
that she's dead. It's tragic,
but there's no way for her
to get out of here...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
她還太小，
甚至不知道自己
已經死了。這很悲慘，
但她沒有
離開這裡的方法...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
When people don't fully
know the situation that
they're in, they become more
willing to take their chances.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
當人們
不完全瞭解
自己所處的
處境時，他們
更願意去冒險。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
When people don't fully
know the situation that
they're in, they become more
willing to take their chances.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
當人們
不完全瞭解
自己所處的
處境時，他們
更願意去冒險。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
As I expected,
there is something behind
all of this. Now, you may
know where you are, but
do you understand why
the dead are here?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
果然，
這一切背後另有隱情。
現在，你可能知道
自己身在何處，
但你知道死者為何
會在這裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
This realm is a place
for warriors that have failed
to prove their courage. Keep in
mind that it's not too late for
you to join their ranks.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
這片領域是
那些未能證明勇氣的
戰士的歸宿。請記住，
你現在加入他們的行列
還來得及。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
The realm of Niflheim
is ruled by the Queen of the
Dead. Sometimes she appears
in her shining armor and makes the rounds. Everyone who sees her is stunned by the image of authority.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
尼弗海姆由
亡者女王統治。
有時她會身著
閃亮的盔甲巡視。
所有看到她的人
都會被那威嚴的形象
所震懾。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now...
What I need you to do is
ask the Queen of the Dead
for the Symbol of Nine Realms.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
現在...
我需要你做的是
向亡者女王
索要“九界之證”。

scripts.text: What is that?
scripts.translation: 那是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
The symbol acts as
a voucher of the queen's
authority and represents her
undeniable right to rule over
the dead. But right now, I can't
explain why I need it.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
這個符號是
女王權威的憑證，
代表著她統治死者
無可置疑的權利。
但現在，我無法解釋
為什麼需要它。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I'll tell you why I need
it once you bring me the
queen's symbol. Now, please
keep this secret and tell no one that I asked you to bring the symbol to me.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
等你把女王的符號
帶給我之後，
我會告訴你為什麼需要它。
現在，請保守這個秘密，
不要告訴任何人
是我讓你帶符號來的。

scripts.text: Alright, I understand.
scripts.translation: 好的，我明白了。

scripts.text: How am I supposed to get the symbol?
scripts.translation: 我該怎麼拿到那個符號？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Taking the symbol
by force is out of the
question. Not even the gods
would consider battling the
Queen of the Dead.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
強行奪取符號
是絕對不可能的。
即使是神明
也不會考慮
與亡者女王開戰。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You will need to
earn the queen's favor
in order to even have
a chance of obtaining
the Symbol of Nine Realms.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
你需要獲得女王的青睞，
才有機會得到
九界之符。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, there is a rumor
that the Queen of the Dead
is searching for her lost mother, Angrboda. Now, if you could find where Angrboda has been
sealed away...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
現在，有傳聞說
亡者女王正在尋找
她失散的母親安格爾伯達。
如果你能找到
安格爾伯達被封印的地方...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
When you need to meet
me from now on, go ahead
and take the ^FF0000secret passage
through the right side of the
portrait on the second floor^000000
of this castle, {0}.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
以後你要見我，
請走^FF0000城堡二樓
畫像右側的
秘密通道^000000，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
If you use that piano
to find me, I'll probably
mistake you for one of the
humans that need guidance
out of Niflheim. So don't
forget to use that passage.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
如果你用那架鋼琴
來找我，我可能會
把你當成
需要指引離開
尼弗海姆的凡人。
所以別忘了走那條通道。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Did you need my help?
I know that I'm one of the few in Niflheim that are sympathetic with mortals, I've got a problem of my own that I need to deal with...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
你需要我的幫助嗎？
我知道我是尼弗海姆
少數同情凡人的存在，
但我自己也有
需要處理的問題...

scripts.text: Never mind, sorry!
scripts.translation: 算了，抱歉！

scripts.text: What happened...?
scripts.translation: 發生什麼事了...？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
...
Hrrmmmpf...

[Kirkena]
Recently, I've found that
two of my spell books are
missing. They contain some
pretty potent spells that
could cause disaster in
incompetent hands...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
最近，我發現
我的兩本魔法書
不見了。裡面記載著
威力強大的咒語，
落入不稱職的人手中
可能會造成災難...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
I'm pretty sure they
were stolen, so if you'd
retrieve them for me from
the thief, I'd be truly grateful. Then, I'd have my hands free
to give the help you came for.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
我確信它們
是被偷了，如果你能
從盜賊那裡
把它們取回來，
我會非常感激。那樣，
我就能騰出手來
幫你解決你來的目的了。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Oh, and next time you come
to see me, go ahead and use
the passage to the right of the portrait on the second floor
of the castle.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
哦，下次你來見我，
請走城堡二樓
畫像右側的通道。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
...Hm?
Is there
something that
you need to ask me?
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
...嗯？
你有
什麼需要
問我的嗎？

scripts.text: How can I get the symbol?
scripts.translation: 我怎樣才能獲得那個符號？

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Taking the symbol
by force is out of the
question. Not even the gods
would consider battling the
Queen of the Dead.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
強行奪取符號
是絕對不可能的。
即使是神明
也不會考慮
與亡者女王開戰。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
You will need to
earn the queen's favor
in order to even have
a chance of obtaining
the Symbol of Nine Realms.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
你需要獲得女王的青睞，
才有機會得到
九界之符。

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
Now, there is a rumor
that the Queen of the Dead
is searching for her lost mother, Angrboda. Now, if you could find where Angrboda has been
sealed away...
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
現在，有傳聞說
亡者女王正在尋找
她失散的母親安格爾伯達。
如果你能找到
安格爾伯達被封印的地方...

scripts.text:
[Kirkena]
When you need to
meet me from now on,
go ahead and take passage
through the right side of the
portrait on the second
floor of this castle.
scripts.translation:
[柯爾凱娜]
以後你要見我，
請走城堡二樓
畫像右側的通道。

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717You wish to have
an audience with the
Queen of the Dead without
invitation? Insolent mortal!
Go back to where you belong!^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717你想在沒有
邀請的情況下
覲見亡靈女王？
無禮的凡人！
回到你該去的地方！^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717I have been told
by Ganglati that you
are the mortal that has
guided Mother's soul to me.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717岡拉蒂告訴我，
你就是那個
將母親的靈魂
引導到我這裡的凡人。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Greetings, mortal.
Make sure that you
use the power of the
symbol wisely. You will
be responsible for the
consequences...^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717你好，凡人。
務必要明智地
使用那個符號的力量。
你要為後果
負責...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Ah.
You are the
mortal called
{0}, are you not?
Yes, you are known to me.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717啊。
你就是那個
名叫{0}的凡人，
對吧？
是的，我認識你。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717As queen of this realm,
I am unaccustomed to labor.
But give me a moment to finish
my work on this priceless
artifact, mortal.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717身為這一界的女王，
我不習慣從事勞作。
不過，凡人，
請給我一點時間，
讓我完成這件
無價之寶的修復工作。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Greetings, mortal.
Is the realm of the living
that boring and tedious?
Ha ha ha! Well, there shall
always be a place for you
here in Niflheim.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717你好，凡人。
生者的世界
就那麼枯燥乏味嗎？
哈哈！
不過，在尼弗爾海姆，
永遠都會有你的容身之處。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Do not fear me,
hero of Midgard.
You have won the favor
of the Queen of the Dead
and may ask me of any
reward if I deem it fair.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717不要害怕我，
米德加爾特英雄。
你已贏得亡靈女王的青睞，
若我認定合理，
你可以向我索取任何獎勵。^000000

scripts.text: The Symbol of the Nine Realms...
scripts.translation: 九重世界的權威

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717The true Symbol of the
Nine Realms cannot be freely
given or lent. However, I sense
your purpose and will give you
a symbol imbued with enough
power to be used only once.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717真正的九重世界的權威
不能隨意贈予或出借。
不過，我感知到了你的目的，
我會給你一枚蘊含足夠力量、
僅能使用一次的權威。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717With the symbol I give you,
you can command the dead to
carry out your will without
question. However, keep in
mind that after one use,
its power will be consumed.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717憑藉我給你的這枚權威，
你可以命令死者
無條件地執行你的意志。
但請記住，
使用一次後，
它的力量就會耗盡。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717I have also decided
to reward you with one
more special permission.
You may now freely draw
water from the fountain
in my mansion, brave hero.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717我還決定
額外獎勵你一項特殊許可權。
勇敢的英雄，
你現在可以自由地
從我府邸的噴泉中取水了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou received the
Symbol of the Nine Realms.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你獲得了九重世界的權威。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717I've wanted to see you
as I've sensed that you
carry something which feels
very familiar to me. Do you
have something extraordinarily
special in your possession?^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717我一直想見你，
因為我感覺到你身上
帶著某種讓我
非常熟悉的東西。
你身上是否帶著
什麼特別非凡的物品？^000000

scripts.text: The Sign
scripts.translation: 標示

scripts.text: Sobbing Starlight
scripts.translation: 星淚石

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717The Sign...?
Hmm, no, that's not
what I sensed. It's actually
something quite different...^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717標示...？
嗯，不，
那不是我所感知的東西。
實際上是
完全不同的東西...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Yes, that's it!
I never expected a mortal
to have such an interesting
artifact in {0} possession.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717沒錯，就是它！
我從未想過凡人
竟會持有如此有趣的
物品，{0}。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717As queen of Niflheim,
I command you to lend the
Sobbing Starlight to me! Fear
not, I shall quickly return it. For a mortal, it must have
taken great pains to obtain this...^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717作為尼弗爾海姆的女王，
我命令你將星淚石借給我！
別怕，我會很快還給你的。
對於凡人來說，
獲得這件物品一定
費了不少力氣...^000000

scripts.text: Please take it...
scripts.translation: 請拿去吧...

scripts.text: N-no! Don't take it!
scripts.translation: 不！別拿走！

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Thank you mortal.
Now, I shall show
you something truly
interesting...^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717謝謝你，凡人。
現在，我要向你展示
一些真正有趣的東西...^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Ha ha ha!
You amuse me,
mortal! To think,
you even have courage
to refuse the queen of
Niflheim! Ha ha ha!^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717哈哈！
你逗樂我了，凡人！
沒想到，
你竟然有勇氣
拒絕尼弗爾海姆的女王！
哈哈！^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Mercy is not a quality
that I am known for, but
since you are my favored
mortal, I shall not kill you.
Still, it would be unwise
to displease me~^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717仁慈並非
我所擅長的品質，
但既然你是我的寵幸凡人，
我就不會殺了你。
不過，惹怒我
可是很不明智的~^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717It is done.
This is the true
form of the object
you humans call the
Sobbing Starlight.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717完成了。
這就是你們人類
稱為星淚石之物的
真正形態。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717Although you may also know
this object as God's Tear Drop, keep in mind that history, as you humans know it, may actually be different than the truth.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717雖然你們可能也將此物稱為“神之淚滴”，但請記住，你們人類所知的歷史，可能與真相大相逕庭。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717In other words, there
are some older tales about
the gods and their enemies that
may have been confused and twisted as they were handed down from generation to generation.^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717換句話說，關於眾神及其敵人的古老傳說，在代代相傳的過程中，可能已經被混淆和扭曲了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Lady Hell]
^8C1717That is all I can tell
you for now, mortal. It will
be your job to discover the
truth of the legends...^000000
scripts.translation:
[地獄夫人]
^8C1717目前我只能告訴你這些，凡人。去發掘傳說的真相，是你的任務...^000000

scripts.text:
[????]
Leave me be,
ruffian! I'm disinclined
towards conversation
at the moment.
scripts.translation:
[????]
別煩我，無賴！
我現在沒心情
跟你說話。

scripts.text:
[????]
Don't go judging
people based on just
how they look. Try to look
inside and find the truth
within their hearts.
scripts.translation:
[????]
不要僅憑外表
去評判一個人。
試著去窺探內心，
尋找他們心中的真相。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You lookin' for
something? Crayu
must have sent you.
Alright then, let's get
straight to the point.
scripts.translation:
[根]
你在找什麼？
肯定是克拉尤派你來的。
好吧，那我們
直奔主題。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
So, why is it that you
wanna become one
of Valkyrie's chosen?
scripts.translation:
[根]
那麼，為什麼你
想成為瓦爾基里
的選中者？

scripts.text: To prove my courage
scripts.translation: 為了證明我的勇氣

scripts.text: For honor
scripts.translation: 為了榮譽

scripts.text: To help people
scripts.translation: 為了幫助他人

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Alright...
Now, did Crayu
tell you why I'm here?
scripts.translation:
[根]
好的...
那麼，克拉尤
有沒有告訴你
我為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Good, then you
already know what
you need to do. Now go
see the witch of Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[根]
很好，看來你
已經知道該做什麼了。
現在去見見
尼弗爾海姆的女巫吧。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
And, off the record,
I think you should be
really careful if you find
yourself dealing with Serin...
scripts.translation:
[根]
還有，私下說，
如果你要和賽琳打交道，
一定要非常小心...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You know, I was an
adventurer myself. In fact,
I even came here to Niflheim
for the ordeals set by the gods. However, I failed and ended up being bound to this realm...
scripts.translation:
[根]
你知道嗎，我
曾經也是一名冒險者。
事實上，我也曾來到尼弗爾海姆，
為了完成眾神設定的試煉。然而我失敗了，最終被束縛在這個領域...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
I just wanted to warn you.
Be careful and don't justify
your greed for any sort of reward using the excuse that you're just gonna prove your courage.
That's what I did...
scripts.translation:
[根]
我只是想警告你。
小心行事，不要以“證明勇氣”為藉口，
來合理化你對任何獎勵的貪婪。
我就是這麼做的...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Anyway, I've already talked
too much. First, go and see
the witch and ask her to
help you out, okay?
scripts.translation:
[根]
總之，我已經
說得夠多了。首先，
去見見女巫，
請求她的幫助，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gen]
One last thing. Off the
record, I think you should
be really careful if you find
yourself dealing with Serin.
She seems nice enough, but
something's weird about her.
scripts.translation:
[根]
最後一件事。
私下說，如果你要和賽琳打交道，
一定要非常小心。
她看起來人還不錯，
但總覺得哪裡不對勁。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
She's awfully persuasive,
and the fact that she used
to be a great wizard when she
was alive bothers me. She's a lot different than the rest of the guys stuck in Niflheim...
scripts.translation:
[根]
她極具說服力，
而且她生前曾是一名偉大的巫師，
這讓我很不安。她和尼弗爾海姆裡其他被困的人很不一樣...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Are you here
to prove your
courage to the gods?
scripts.translation:
[根]
你是來這裡
向眾神證明
你的勇氣的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You know, I was an
adventurer myself. In fact,
I even came here to Niflheim
for the ordeals set by the gods. However, I failed and ended up being bound to this realm...
scripts.translation:
[根]
你知道嗎，我
曾經也是一名冒險者。
事實上，我也曾來到尼弗爾海姆，
為了完成眾神設定的試煉。然而我失敗了，最終被束縛在這個領域...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
I just wanted to warn you.
Be careful and don't justify
your greed for any sort of reward using the excuse that you're just gonna prove your courage.
That's what I did...
scripts.translation:
[根]
我只是想警告你。
小心行事，不要以“證明勇氣”為藉口，
來合理化你對任何獎勵的貪婪。
我就是這麼做的...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Anyway, I've already talked
too much. First, go and see
the witch and ask her to
help you out, okay?
scripts.translation:
[根]
總之，我已經
說得夠多了。首先，
去見見女巫，
請求她的幫助，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Huh... I hear you're
looking for something
pretty important. It's going
to be a dangerous search.
scripts.translation:
[根]
嗯...聽說你
在尋找一件
非常重要的東西。
這將是一次危險的搜尋。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
They are plenty of
other parties that are
interested in the thing
which you're seeking...
scripts.translation:
[根]
還有很多其他隊伍
也對您尋找的東西
很感興趣...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You must be a very
resourceful mortal.
Not even Lady Hell, with
all her power, could find
the soul of her mother
for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[根]
您一定是一位
非常有能力的凡人。
就連擁有強大力量
的地獄夫人，
也花了很長時間
才找到她母親的靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
There's no need
for me to hide my
true identity any longer.
My real name is Ganglati,
servant of Lady Hell, the
ruler of Niflheim.
scripts.translation:
[根]
我不再需要
隱藏我的真實身份了。
我的真名是甘拉提，
是尼弗爾海姆統治者、
地獄夫人的僕人。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Her highness would
have words with you.
Shall I send you to her
mansion, Eljudnir,
right now?
scripts.translation:
[根]
殿下有話
想對您說。
我現在就送您去
她的宅邸，
埃爾朱德尼爾，
好嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Remember to be
careful and especially
polite when you speak to
Lady Hell. Otherwise, the
consequences will be severe...
scripts.translation:
[根]
記得在與地獄夫人
對話時要格外小心
並保持禮貌。
否則，後果將非常嚴重...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
I understand.
Meeting with a deity is
no small matter. However,
I advise you to make haste
as her highness is eager
to see you soon.
scripts.translation:
[根]
我明白了。
與神明會面
絕非小事。不過，
我建議您儘快行動，
因為殿下很急切
地想見到您。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You must be most favored
to receive the Symbol of the
Nine Realms. Of course, it
can be used only once, but
it is still a great honor.
scripts.translation:
[根]
您一定深受眷顧，
才能獲得九界之符。
當然，它只能使用一次，
但這依然是一份
莫大的榮譽。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Once again, I ask that
you be on guard against
Serin. She may already be
aware of what you plan to
do with this symbol...
scripts.translation:
[根]
再次提醒您，
要提防賽琳。
她可能已經察覺
到您打算
用這個符號做什麼了...

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You must hurry and
stop the summoning
before your world in
cast into immense peril!
scripts.translation:
[根]
您必須趕快
阻止召喚儀式，
否則您的世界
將陷入巨大的危機！

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Although Lady Hell
is being rather blase
about this matter, I beseech
you to do what you can for
the realm of the living!
scripts.translation:
[根]
雖然地獄夫人
對此事表現得
相當漫不經心，
但我懇請您
為活人的世界
盡您所能！

scripts.text:
[Gen]
I should have
known you couldn't
stop her. Still, I had
a little hope that you'd
be able to do it.
scripts.translation:
[根]
我早該知道
您無法阻止她。
不過，我曾抱有一絲希望，
以為您能做到。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Perhaps I expected
far too much of you.
Goodbye for now, mortal.
scripts.translation:
[根]
也許我對您
期望過高了。
再見了，凡人。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
You've done a great
job of stopping Serin.
Excellent! Such great
service on behalf of
the realm of the living!
scripts.translation:
[根]
您成功阻止了賽琳，
幹得漂亮！
太出色了！
這是對活人世界
巨大的貢獻！

scripts.text:
[Gen]
I'm pleased to inform
you that you've been
invited to Lady Hell's
mansion once again.
Are you ready to go?
scripts.translation:
[根]
我很高興地通知您，
您再次收到了
地獄夫人宅邸的邀請。
您準備好出發了嗎？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Gen]
I see.
Well then, come
back to me when you
feel fully prepared.
scripts.translation:
[根]
我明白了。
那麼，當您
完全準備好時，
再回來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Gen]
Good, good.
Don't forget to
speak to her highness
with the utmost respect!
scripts.translation:
[根]
很好，很好。
別忘了對殿下
保持最高的敬意！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
What? I look familiar to you?
Eh, you know what they say.
Everyone has a lookalike in the
world somewhere. Am I right
or am I right?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
什麼？我看起來
很面熟嗎？
呃，你知道人們怎麼說的。
世界上總有
長得像的人。
我說得對吧？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Niflheim ain't such a bad
place to live. Sure, Asgard's
all pretty and stuff, but there's too many rules. In this place, you
can enjoy a lot more freedom. After you get used to all the stink.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
尼弗爾海姆
並不是個壞地方。
沒錯，阿斯加德
確實很漂亮，
但規矩太多了。
在這裡，你可以
享受更多的自由。
只要你習慣了
這裡的臭味。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Angrboda...?
Yeah, yeah!
I remember hearing something
about her when I usedta hang
with the gods up in Asgard.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
安格爾伯達...？
對，對！
我記得以前在阿斯加德
和眾神混在一起時，
聽說過關於她的事。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Oh yeah, about those
directions I gave you
last time? They work, but
you gotta know what I mean
by 'big' or 'small' whatever
o' clock means. That's right...
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
哦對了，關於我上次
給你的那些指示？
它們管用，但你得
明白我說的
“大”或“小”
以及“點鐘”是什麼意思。
沒錯...

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Oh yeah. Uh, I forgot to tell
you that Angrboda's soul pieces are sealed with the power of the gods. You can't just smash them open.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
哦對了。呃，我忘了告訴你，安格爾伯達的靈魂碎片是被眾神的力量封印的。你沒法直接把它們砸開。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Dude, Niflheim rocks.
It's like, a million times
better than that boring
old Asgard. Hell yeah!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
哥們，尼弗爾海姆太棒了。
比那個無聊的阿斯加德
好上一百萬倍。
沒錯！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Whoa...
.................
My freakin' head hurts.

[Laichin]
Did I say 'stink?'
I meant... 'fragrance.'
Alright, so the gods expelled
me, but I really oughtta thank
'em for sending me here!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
我說“臭味”了嗎？
我是說...“香氣”。
好吧，雖然眾神把我趕出來了，
但我真該感謝他們把我送到這裡！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
What's that look for...?
What, you can't believe
that someone like me used
to live in Valhalla? Me neither! They really made a mistake when they put me up to live in Asgard!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
你那個眼神是什麼意思...？
什麼，你不相信像我這樣的人
以前住在瓦爾哈拉？我自己也不信！
他們當初讓我住在阿斯加德，
真是犯了一個大錯誤！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Yeah, those guys were pretty
gangster about it. I mean, they took her soul, broke it in four pieces and stashed them in the deepest hole in Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
是啊，那幫傢伙幹得挺狠。
我是說，他們奪走了她的靈魂，
把它碎成四塊，
然後藏在了米德加爾特的
最深處的洞裡！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Sure, she was a giant, but
they were pretty scared of her.
All her children ended up to be legendary monsters! Well, I'm
not sure if Lady Hell counts.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
沒錯，她是個巨人，
但他們還是很怕她。
她的孩子們全都成了
傳說中的魔物！
嗯，我不確定地獄夫人算不算。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
That's pretty harsh.
I mean, even if you die,
your soul has no place to
rest. Angrboda's soul is
all cut up and stuff!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
這太殘酷了。
我是說，即使你死了，
你的靈魂也沒有安息之地。
安格爾伯達的靈魂
全被切碎了！

scripts.text: So where are the soul pieces again?
scripts.translation: 靈魂碎片在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
What...? I just said,
the deepest underground
place in Midgard.
It's a dangerous joint
protected by gangs
of monsters.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
什麼...？我剛才說了，
米德加爾特最底下的地方。
那是個危險的地方，
由一群魔物把守。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Wait, you tellin' me
that you're gonna find
all of Angrboda's soul?!
You're crazy! If they end up
missing, the gods'll know I was
the one who tipped you off!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
等等，你是說
你要找到安格爾伯達
所有的靈魂碎片？！
你瘋了吧！如果它們丟了，
眾神就會知道
是我給你透露訊息的！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
If I was gonna risk my soul,
I'd wanna enjoy the rest of my
afterlife as my much as I could
before the gods offed me. Man,
I'd need at least 40,000 Zeny to even have a decent time...
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
如果我打算冒這個險，
我想在眾神幹掉我之前，
儘可能享受剩下的來世。
天哪，我至少需要40,000 Zeny
才能過得像樣點...

scripts.text: Pay Laichin 40,000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 付給萊金 40,000 Zeny

scripts.text: Don't pay Laichin.
scripts.translation: 不付錢給萊金。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Hey...
This is sooo
not enough money
for me to enjoy myself
if my soul ends up getting
busted by the gods.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
嘿...
這點錢根本不夠我
在靈魂被眾神
搞砸之前好好享受的。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Now we're talkin'!
You're a true hero!
Right, you gotta go to the
lowest part of Glast Heim to
find Angrboda's soul pieces.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
這才像話！
你真是個英雄！
沒錯，你得去葛拉斯特海姆
最底下的地方
尋找安格爾伯達的靈魂碎片。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Check out the
big 1 o' clock,
big 5 o' clock,
big 7 o' clock and
the small 6 o' clock.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
去檢查
大1點鐘，
大5點鐘，
大7點鐘
和小6點鐘。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Check out the
big 4 o' clock,
big 10 o' clock,
small 6 o' clock and the
very small 11 o' clock.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
去檢查
大4點鐘，
大10點鐘，
小6點鐘
和極小11點鐘。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Check out the
big 5 o' clock,
small 11 o' clock,
small 6 o' clock and the
very small 11 o' clock.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
去檢查
大5點鐘，
小11點鐘，
小6點鐘
和極小11點鐘。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Check out the
big 4 o' clock,
big 5 o' clock,
big 10 o' clock and
the small 11 o' clock.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
去檢查
大4點鐘，
大5點鐘，
大10點鐘
和小11點鐘。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Her soul pieces are really
well hidden, so you gotta look around, even if you know the general location. And don't
tell anyone else about these locations or there'll be trouble.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
她的靈魂碎片藏得很隱蔽，
所以即使你知道大概位置，
也得四處找找。
而且別把這些位置告訴別人，
不然會有麻煩的。

scripts.text: I promise.
scripts.translation: 我保證。

scripts.text: What do you mean by big and small?
scripts.translation: 你說的大和小是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Alright, kid.
Have fun!
[Laichin]
Heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
好了，小傢伙。
玩得開心！
[萊金]
嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Alright, kid.
Have fun!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
好了，小傢伙。
玩得開心！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
What do I mean by
big and small? Hey man,
the answer to that is worth
at least... 20,000 Zeny.
If you wanna know,
cough up the cash!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
大和小是什麼意思？嘿，夥計，
這個問題的答案至少值...
20,000 Zeny。
想知道的話，
就把錢交出來！

scripts.text: Don't pay him.
scripts.translation: 不給他錢。

scripts.text: Pay him.
scripts.translation: 給他錢。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Fine, fine.
Just don't come
crawling back when
you can't figure out
where the soul pieces are!
[Laichin]
Hehehehe~
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
行吧，行吧。
要是找不到靈魂碎片的位置，
可別哭著回來找我！
[萊金]
嘿嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Fine, fine.
Just don't come
crawling back when
you can't figure out
where the soul pieces are!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
行吧，行吧。
要是找不到靈魂碎片的位置，
可別哭著回來找我！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
What is this?
You tryin to welch
me or somethin'?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
這是怎麼回事？
你想賴賬嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Alright, listen up.
Big, small and very small
mean the distances from the
center of the map. So for big,
I mean look near the border of
the map. Easy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
聽著。
大、小和極小
指的是距離地圖中心的遠近。
所以“大”的意思
是去地圖邊緣附近找。
很簡單吧？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
When I say small, you
gotta look in areas closer
than the borders of the map.
For very small, you gotta
look near the center. Got it?
[Laichin]
Eh heh
heh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
我說“小”的時候，
你得去比地圖邊緣更靠近中心的地方找。
“極小”的話，
就得在中心附近找。明白了嗎？
[萊金]
呃嘿嘿
嘿嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
When I say small, you
gotta look in areas closer
than the borders of the map.
For very small, you gotta
look near the center. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
我說“小”的時候，
你得去比地圖邊緣更靠近中心的地方找。
“極小”的話，
就得在中心附近找。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Huh...?
Okay pal.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
嗯...？
好吧，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Matter of fact, I'll
tell you all about it.
Right after you pay me,
oh, I don't know, ^FF000020,000 zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
其實，我可以全都告訴你。
在你付給我
^FF000020,000 Zeny^000000之後。

scripts.text: Pay him.
scripts.translation: 給他錢。

scripts.text: Don't pay him.
scripts.translation: 不給他錢。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
What is this?
You tryin to welch
me or somethin'?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
這是怎麼回事？
你想賴賬嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Alright, listen up.
Big, small and very small
mean the distances from the
center of the map. So for big,
I mean look near the border of
the map. Easy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
聽著。
大、小和極小
指的是距離地圖中心的遠近。
所以“大”的意思
是去地圖邊緣附近找。
很簡單吧？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
When I say small, you
gotta look in areas closer
than the borders of the map.
For very small, you gotta
look near the center. Got it?
[Laichin]
Bwahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
我說“小”的時候，
你得去比地圖邊緣更靠近中心的地方找。
“極小”的話，
就得在中心附近找。明白了嗎？
[萊金]
哇哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
When I say small, you
gotta look in areas closer
than the borders of the map.
For very small, you gotta
look near the center. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
我說“小”的時候，
你得去比地圖邊緣更靠近中心的地方找。
“極小”的話，
就得在中心附近找。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Whatever, dude!
Freakin' cheapskate...
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
隨便你，傢伙！
真是個小氣鬼...

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
...Or maybe you could.
Anyway, it'll be better
if you had a weapon that
was solid, heavy and powerful.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
...或者也許你可以。
總之，如果你有一把堅固、沉重且威力強大的武器，
情況會好得多。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
But yeah, think about
what it means to break
a godly seal. Remember there's
^FF0000some kinda rule^000000 that the gods imposed which you gotta follow
to release Angrboda's soul.
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
但是，想想打破神聖封印意味著什麼。
記住，神定下了^FF0000某種規則^000000，
你必須遵守它才能釋放安格爾伯達的靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Ah, right. If you wanna
try different weapons for
breaking those seals, make
sure you got 'em in your
inventory and that they're
not equipped, alright?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
啊，對了。如果你想嘗試不同的武器
來打破那些封印，
確保它們在你的背包裡，
並且沒有裝備，好嗎？

scripts.text: Thanks~!
scripts.translation: 謝謝~！

scripts.text: Where am I supposed to go again?
scripts.translation: 我到底該去哪裡來著？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Oh no...
Thank you for all
of this zeny! Money
might not be able to
buy happiness, but it
sure comes real close!
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
噢不...
謝謝你給我這麼多Zeny！
錢也許買不到幸福，
但它絕對很接近了！

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Hey... You gotta
go to the lowest part
of Glast Heim to find all
of Angrboda's soul pieces.
Once you get there...
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
嘿... 你得去葛拉斯特海姆的最底層
才能找到安格爾伯達的所有靈魂碎片。
一旦你到達那裡...

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Check out the
big 1 o' clock,
big 5 o' clock,
big 7 o' clock and
the small 6 o' clock.
And break those seals
in that order, okay?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
檢視大的1點鐘方向，
大的5點鐘方向，
大的7點鐘方向
和小的6點鐘方向。
並按順序打破那些封印，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Check out the
big 4 o' clock,
big 10 o' clock,
small 6 o' clock and the
very small 11 o' clock.
And break those seals
in that order, okay?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
檢視大的4點鐘方向，
大的10點鐘方向，
小的6點鐘方向
和極小的11點鐘方向。
並按順序打破那些封印，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Check out the
big 5 o' clock,
small 11 o' clock,
small 6 o' clock and the
very small 11 o' clock.
And break those seals
in that order, okay?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
檢視大的5點鐘方向，
小的11點鐘方向，
小的6點鐘方向
和極小的11點鐘方向。
並按順序打破那些封印，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Check out the
big 4 o' clock,
big 5 o' clock,
big 10 o' clock and
the small 11 o' clock.

in that order, okay?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
檢視大的4點鐘方向，
大的5點鐘方向，
大的10點鐘方向
和小的11點鐘方向。

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
And break those seals
in that order, okay?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
並按順序打破那些封印，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Big, small and very small
mean the distances from the
center of the map. So for big,
I mean look near the border of
the map. Easy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
大、小和極小
指的是距離地圖中心的遠近。
所以“大”的意思
是去地圖邊緣附近找。
很簡單吧？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
When I say small, you
gotta look in areas closer
than the borders of the map.
For very small, you gotta
look near the center. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
我說“小”的時候，
你得去比地圖邊緣更靠近中心的地方找。
“極小”的話，
就得在中心附近找。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Eh, I don't even wanna
know if you manage to
find all of Angrboda's soul
pieces, but if you do, don't
go bringin' close to me. If the
gods find out you have 'em...
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
呃，我甚至不想知道
你是否能設法找到安格爾伯達的所有靈魂碎片，
但如果你做到了，
別靠近我。如果神發現你擁有它們...

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
But for the sake of
argument, let's say you
do happen to get them all.
In that case, you oughta get
Angrboda's soul to the Queen
of Hell right away, alright?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
但為了爭論起見，假設你
碰巧得到了它們全部。
在這種情況下，你應該立即
將安格爾伯達的靈魂交給地獄女王，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
Ooh.. But not just any
yahoo can waltz up to her.
The best thing would be to
give it to one of her really
trusted retainers, I guess.
Now, who was he again?
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
噢... 但並不是任何人都能
隨意走到她面前。
最好的辦法大概是
把它交給她非常信任的侍從之一。
現在，他是誰來著？

scripts.text:
[Laichin]
I know he's always in
disguise as some sorta
really ^666666despressing guy^000000
and I can't remember his
name for the life of me, but
he's around here somewhere...
scripts.translation:
[萊金]
我知道他總是偽裝成
某種^666666令人沮喪的傢伙^000000，
我拼命也記不起他的名字，
但他就在這附近某處...

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
Leave now, or I will
remove you by force....
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
現在離開，否則
我將強行驅逐你....

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
....And...
....Whatever you do...
....Do NOT touch my books...
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
....還有...
....無論你想做什麼...
....都絕對不要碰我的書...

scripts.text: Pick up the 2nd book.

scripts.text: Pick up the 3rd book.

scripts.text:
[Ashe Bruce]
...!...
How dare you touch my books

'Don't touch my books!'
scripts.translation:
[阿什·布魯斯]
...！...
我明明特意說了

你竟敢碰我的書

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:

你竟敢碰我的書？！

Niflheim is commonly
known as the city of the
dead, but it's also the
resting place of warriors
who failed to enter Valhalla.

尼弗爾海姆通常被稱為亡者之城，

戰士們的安息之地。

scripts.text:

Some heroes may think
of Niflheim as the tragic end,
but it really all depends on
your point of view.

有些英雄可能會認為尼弗爾海姆是悲劇的終結，
